tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa dge legs nor bu'i phreng ba gsang sngags mdzes rgyan bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ā nan+dha pu ṇ+ye ye/ /rig sngags rin chen gos kyi lhab lhub 'chang / /man ngag nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i tog /kun dga'i bsod nams mi nub yu ba brtan/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal yon bzang por 'dud/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gos dkar lcang lo'i skur/ /legs bzhengs sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen gsung las/ /dges rdor sgrub thabs rnam bshad mdor bsdus 'bri/ /de la 'dir/ rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga'i mtshan can gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i/ dpal kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi sgrub thabs phyi nang gi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnam par bshad pa dges rdor chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las/ 'dir dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad mdor bsdus kyi sgo nas brjod pa la don lnga ste/ gang gi bsgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag gang du nyams su len pa'i gnas/ nam gyi tshe nyams su len pa'i dus/ ji lta bu'i bsam pas nyams su blangs pa/ de lta bu nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor dngos so/ /dang po ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i rgyud sbyong ba kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'dod pa/ bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas dngos dang / der spyod lam ji lta bur sgom pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la las dang po pa'i gnas/ ting nge 'dzin cung zad brten pa'i gnas/ ting nge 'dzin cher brten pa'i gnas dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang po goms par byed dus kyi/

/gnas ni gang du bsngags pa'i sems/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ chos ldan gyi rgyal pos bde bar sa skyong ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'gal rkyen chung zhing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa rang gi sgrub khang du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa yin te/ der bsgom pas ro la sogs pa mthong bas 'chi ba mi rtag pa gsal 'debs shing lta ba bdag med la bogs 'don/ mi ma yin drag po rgyu bas brtson 'grus la ched du bya ba yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin cher brten pa'i gnas la/ gang zag gi ngos nas brten pa dang / lha yi ngos nas brten pa gnyis/ dang po ni yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa phyogs med du myul ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ snying rje chen po kyai rdo rje/ /nga ni dur khrod chu 'gram dang / /zhes pa nas/ dngos grub rdo rje rnams ster ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa/ der spyod lam ji lta bus bsgoms pa'i tshul ni/ bsam gtan gyi khang par byi dor dang chag chag bya/ dri zhim po byugs shing me tog sil ma bkram/ rdo rje'i mtshan ma bris pa'i steng du rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan par gnas nas bsgoms la/ 'dug stangs kyi khyad par ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pa'o/ /kha lta phyogs ni/ spyir las bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ zhi ba shar/ rgyas pa byang / dbang nub/ drag po lhor lta ba yin no/ /lha yi dbang du byas na/ bde mchog dang / 'jigs byed sogs lho/ dpal mchog nub/ rnam sras la sogs byang du lta bar bshad kyang 'dir shar la lta ste/ lam 'dir gtso bor sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phyir nyams su len pa yin pas/ shar nas nyi zla la sogs pa'i gza' skar mang du 'char ba ltar/

sgrub pa po'i rgyud la rtogs pa khyad par can mang du 'char ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /gsum pa dus nam gyi tshe nyams su len pa'i dus la/ las dang po pa'i dus/ sems cung zad brtan pa'i dus/ sems cher brtan pa'i dus dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshan dus su/ zhes pa ltar/ mtshan mo skye bo rnams nyal ba'i dus su nyams su len pa yin te/ dus der rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi 'gal rkyen nyung ba dang / mthun rkyen mang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ thun gsum du ni byin brlabs te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thun gsum mam/ rdo rje gur las/ thun tshod bzhir ni byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thun bzhi'am/ saṃ bu ṭar/ nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dus drug tu bsgom mo/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rkang pa 'khrud dang bza' ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ rnal 'byor ma ni nges par bsgom/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa ltar/ dus nges pa med par bsgom pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ji lta bu'i bsam pas nyams su len pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bdag nyid grub pa'i sems kyis ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe 'di'i 'jigarten chos brgyad kyi rtog pa la sogs pa dgos med kyi bsam pa thams cad ring du dor/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing / rnyed dka'i dal ba yun ring du mi gnas pa dang / lam phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal ba ches cher dka' ba'i ngang tshul sems te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du tshe 'dir zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ bar chad 'byung ngam mi 'byung / 'grub bam mi 'grub la sogs pa'i the tshom yid gnyis log lta thams cad spangs nas sems rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya'o/ /lnga pa de ltar nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor dngos la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ 'dir rje btsun rin po ches mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing du don gsum du bsdus nas gsungs pa ltar bshad na/ sngon 'gro'i cho ga dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor/ rjes rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag dang gsum mo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyas pa dang / 'bring dang / bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa tshogs zhing mchod pa/ gur gyi dgongs pa yan lag bdun pa bya ba/ saṃ bu ṭi'i dgongs pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba/ rgyud gsum thun mong gi dgongs pa tshad med bzhi/ ye shes tshogs bsags bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar gyi de nyid kyi steng nas bsrung 'khor bsgom pa 'dor ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bsod nams tshogs bsags tshad med bzhi bsgom pa la bsdus nas/ ye shes tshogs bsags stong nyid bsgom pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ dang po rgyas pa la gsum ste/ rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa yan lag bzhis bcing ba/ gur gyi dgongs pa yan lag drug gis bcing ba/ saṃ bu ṭa'i dgongs pa ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis bcing ba'o/ /gnyis pa 'bring po ni/ yan lag bzhi'i bcings nas mchod bstod mi byed par bzlas pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gsum pa bsdus pa la gnyis te/ bsdus pa'i rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa'i bsdus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dam tshig gi sems dpa' rigs bdag rang chas su bskyed nas skye mched byin rlabs mi byed par gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes pa dngos su gzhug pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dam tshig gi sems dpa' rigs bdag rang chas can du bskyed pa tsam mo/ /gsum pa rjes rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ dang po ni/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor brgyad tshang bar nyams su len pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni sngar gyi de nyid kyi steng nas khrus dang rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor dor ba'o/

/gsum pa ni/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor tsam la bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ rje sa chen gyi mngon rtogs tshigs bcad mar/ de la mngon rtogs rnam gnyis te/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam bzhag bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis dang / /ma bzhag rnam pa brgyad yin te/ /nyal dang ldang dang bzlas pa dang / /khrus dang kha zas gtor ma dang / /spyod lam rjes chags rnal 'byor brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bshad na/ 'di la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ dang po la bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ dang po la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / khyad par gyi sngon 'gro gnyis/ dang po la thog mar sngon du 'gro ba bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ de ltar byas pas dgos pa gsum dang / dang po ni/ sgrub pa po'i rgyud dam tshig dang sdom par mi ldan par bskyed rdzogs kyi lam ji tsam nyams su blangs kyang ye shes mi skye bas/ rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa ni mi dgos kha med kyi lam gyi gzhi chen po yin no/ /de ltar na sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i gang zag des bskyed rdzogs kyi lam nyams su len pa'i tshe/ rang rgyud kyi sdom pa gsum gyi nyes skyon thams cad dag par bya dgos la/ nyes pa chen po rnams ni slar sdom pa blang zhing phyir bcos pa'i sgo nas sbyongs/ thun bar gyi nyes pa phra mo rnams ni sngon 'gro 'di gsum gyis sbyong ba yin te/ de yang so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed pa dang / sngags kyi thun bar gyi nyes pa phra mo rnams sbyong zhing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / ltung ba chen po rnams phyir mi 'phel bar bya ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su len pa yin no/

/gnyis pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ skyabs 'gro'i rnal 'byor/ sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang gsum/ dang po la nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten gyi gang zag ngos bzung ba/ rgyu gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba/ dus nam gyi bar du skyabs suྎ yul gang la skyabs suྎ tshul ji ltar skyabs suྎ ched du bya ba gang gi phyir du skyabs su 'gro ba/ mthar dngos grub blang ba dang bdun/ dang po ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dang rang nyid do/ /gnyis pa la 'jigs pa/ dad pa/ snying rje dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa/ rang don yid byed kyi 'jigs pa/ tha mal snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa/ tha mal snang byed kyi 'jigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa dad pa ni/ skyabs yul de rnams kyis sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i gnas tshul dang / de las skyobs pa'i thabs mkhyen pas mkhyen pa'i yon tan/ bskyab par bzhed pa'i thugs rje/ bskyab par nus pa'i nus mthu gsum mthong nas dad pa'o/ /gsum pa snying rje ni/ sems can thams cad 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la mi bzod pa'i snying brtse ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ji srid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang ma thob bar du'o/ /bzhi pa yul ni/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo gtso bo he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam pa ni/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin la/ de dag gi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i bde stong gi ye shes gsung rab po ti brtsegs pa'i rnam par shar ba gtso bo dang bait+ta li'i bar na bzhugs pa ni chos dkon mchog yin/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bye ba phrag brgyad cu/ rnal 'byor ma ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa/ gzhan yang sngags kyi lam la zhugs pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa yan chad kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i ngo bo lha mo brgyad ni dge 'dun dkon mchog yin no/

/lnga pa tshul ji lta bus skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la 'dren pa/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam dngos/ dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i grogs zhus nas mtho gtong dma' gtong ci mdzad khyod shes kyi tshul du skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /drug pa ched du bya ba gang gi phyir du skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'o/ /bdun pa mthar dngos grub blang ba ni/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol dkyus bzhin brjod pas dge 'dun dkon mchog gi ngo bo lha mo brgyad 'od zer dkar po zhu nas spyi bo nas thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byas/ chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo gsung rab po ti rnams 'od zer dmar por zhu nas mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byas/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo gtso bo yab yum 'od zer sngon por zhu nas snying gar thim pas yid kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag par byas nas rdo rje gsum mam bzhi'i go 'phang thob par bsam pa yin la/ gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ 'di yi skabs kyi sbyang gzhi ni spyir ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad khyad par 'jig rten gyi dpon po/ lha klu bdud btsan mthu bo che dang / tshangs pa dbang phyug la sogs pa skyabs su 'gro bar mi 'os pa la skyabs su song ba dang / bla ma dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa'i skyabs su 'gro bar 'os pa'i yul la skyabs su ma song zhing / ma dad pa dang ma gus pa bgyis pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni sbyang byed kyi lam/ de gnyis dbyer med du nyams su len pa ni skyabs 'gro 'khor 'das dbyer med yin la/ de'i don sbyang gzhi de dag skyabs 'gro byed mkhan sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi rgyud sems nyid skad cig ma gcig gi rnam 'phrul du shes par byas/

de nyid gsal rig tsam du gtan la phab nas/ de nyid kyi ngo bo ci yang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgom pa de'i ngang nas ma g.yos bzhin du rig pa mdangs 'gal med du skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro ba po/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul rnams gsal btab ste zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i don yin no/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor la/ nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rang gi pha ma ma byas pa med cing / de yang lan gcig min par lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas shing / pha ma nam byas res kyis phan btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas/ 'di rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba snying rje snyam pa yang yang du bsgom pa'o/ /'di lta bu sngon du ma song na sems bskyed rnal ma mi skye ste/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'o/ /des na rgyu snying rje chen po sngon du song nas 'bras bu sems bskyed pa dngos ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ thob nas kyang sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de yi phyir du 'di lta bu'i lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du bsgom mo/ /de'i dang po smon pa sems bskyed/ phyi ma 'jug pa sems bskyed yin la/ de yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems thams cad smon 'jug gnyis su 'dus pa yin no/ /'di yi skabs kyi ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni/ rje btsun rin po ches bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du kyai rdo rje'i zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'am/ yang na mngon rtogs dkyus bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ 'di skabs kyi spyir btang gi sbyang gzhi ni sngar dang 'dra la/ khyad par gyi sbyang gzhi ni tshe thog ma med pa nas gzhan la bsam ngan bsgom pa dang / sems bskyed par mi 'os pa bskyed pa dang / bskyed par 'os pa ma bskyed pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad ni sbyang gzhi 'khor ba yin la/ sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ni sbyong byed mya ngan las 'das pa yin cing / de gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa ni sems bskyed 'khor 'das dbyer med yin no/ /gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor la/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba/ bshags sdom bya ba/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul dang bzhi/ dang po la bsgom bya'i lha/ lha gnas gang du bsgoms pa/ der bsgoms nas sdig sgrib sbyong tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ a bhi dha na las/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka yab yum bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid las/ phyi dang nang gi sku khrus bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don spyi bor bsgom par bzhed/ gsum pa ni/ mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /thams cad snying khar brten byas te/ /bsgoms la thams cad brtan par 'gyur/ /zhes a bhi dha na las gsungs pa ltar rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad spyan drangs shing / 'dren tshul la lha'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang / yig 'bru'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang / bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang gsum las/ 'dir phyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ de yang bdud rtsi kha dog dkar po la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa spyan drangs la/

he ru ka yab yum gyi sku zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsgom/ bdud rtsi 'bab tshul ni/ a bhi dha na las/ rnal 'byor ma yi dbang yang bskur/ /zhes pa'i don/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas 'bab par bzhed/ babs nas sdig sgrib sbyong tshul la/ thun mong dang thun mong min pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub thabs kyi dkyus na bzhugs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa 'khor lo'i gnas su bdud rtsi byon pas dbang bzhi thob par bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa sngags bzla ba la/ bzla ba'i dus/ bzlas pa'i grangs/ bzlas pa'i dgos pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi snying po yin tshul/ bzlas bya'i sngags kyi don dngos bshad pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ thog mar rgyud sbyong ba'i phyir bzlas pa/ bar du lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir bzlas pa/ mtha' mar lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir bzlas pa dang gsum las/ 'dir dang po nyid gtso bor gzung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa nas re re bzla/ /zhes dang / 'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas gyur na/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni a bhi dha na las/ gang du dam tshig nyams pa la/ /sbyor ba 'di ni sbyin par bya/ /zhi bar gyur na bla med pa/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /'di ni kun gyi sngags yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha de yang sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin la/ lnga pa ni/ oṃ ni mchog gi dngos grub ster ba/ shrī ni dpal 'byor rgyas pa/ badz+ra he ru ka ni rdo rje khrag 'thung / sa ma ya dam tshig ma nu pā la ya bdag rjes su skyongs shig gang gis na rang bzhin nges don gyi he ru kas skyong ba'o/ /tshul ji ltar na he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ khrag 'thung bdag la nye bar mnos pa de rang gi bsam pa bzhin du'o/ /gang bsam na dṛ ḍho me bha wa bdag la brten pa'i rang bzhin du'o/

/su to ṣ+yo me bha wa bdag la dga' ba'i rang bzhin du'o/ /a nu rak+to me bha wa bdag la rjes su chags pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /su po ṣ+yo me bha wa bdag la mdzes pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha ni bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol cig sarba karma su tsa me ni bdag la las thams cad stsol ces pa'o/ /bskyangs nas ci byed na/ tsit+taṃ shri yaṃḥku ru bdag la gnas par mdzod/ gang gnas na hūm̐ ni 'gyur ba med pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ ha bzhi ni ye shes gzhan bzhi/ ho ni dbyer med pa/ mdor na dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i nges don gyi he ru ka bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod/ de la tha snyad du mtshan ci zhig brjod na bha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khrag 'thung zhes bya/ des bdag ni nam yang gtong bar ma mdzad ces gsol ba ni ma me muñtsa bdag ma gtong zhig ces pa'o/ /he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa khrag 'thung gi rang bzhin dam tshig sems dpa' chen po zhes ched du 'bod pa'o/ /a ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pas chos thams cad kyi sgo ste/ lha dang sngags dang sgrub pa po rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig pa'o/ /hūm̐ ni don lnga la 'jug pa las 'dir spangs bya 'joms pa la sbyor/ phaṭa ni don gsum la 'jug pa las/ 'dir nyes pa dag pa'am gzhig pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gsum pa bshags sdom bya ba ni/ a bhi dha na las 'byung ba/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa bstan/ de yi rjes su 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sku gsung thugs lhug pa'i don sngags kyi dam tshig thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig tu 'dus pa'am/ yang na rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig tu 'dus pa yin te/ sdig pa ni nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa/ sgrib pa ni shes bya'i sgrib pa/ nyes pa ni rang bzhin gyi nyes pa/

ltung ba ni bcas pa'i ltung ba/ grib ma ni gnas kyi grib ma la sogs pa drug go /bzhi pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ spyir nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa thams cad ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed ni rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin no/ /sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed de yi ngo bo snang ba bsgyur nas nyams su len pa ni sbyong tshul 'khor 'das dbyer med yin no/ /gsum pa de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sdom pa gsum gyi nyes pa phra mo sbyangs nas/ rang rgyud kyi sdom pa gsum yongs su dag par byas pa la ni dgos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod do/ /bshes springs las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang gsum/ dang po yul dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags pa/ yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags pa/ zhar byung de dag gi dgos pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la gang gis tshogs bsags pa'i rten/ gang la tshogs bsags pa'i yul/ ji ltar tshogs gsog pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po la lus byin gyis brlabs pa/ yid byin gyis brlab pa/ de gnyis kyi dgos pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ snying po kyai rdo rje yin la/ de yang zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa rgyas pa nyid lam 'di'i bsgrub bya'i gtso bor ston pa yin pas/ de sgrub pa la ldang ba'i rnal 'byor nas/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor gyi bar du 'di nyid kyi nga rgyal gyis nyams su len dgos te/ slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang pos/ zhal brgyad nga rgyal bdag bsgom ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/

/sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su las bsags pa'i rten rigs drug gi lus ji snyed cig blangs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na las bsags pa'i rten rigs drug gi lus ji snyed cig len par 'gyur ba dang / da ltar gyi las gsog pa'i rten ma dag pa'i lus kyi snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa de nyid sbyong byed/ kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ ḍom bhi was/ paṃ pad raṃ nyi gzhom med las/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ paṃ las pad+ma de yang lha dbang du sdud pa mtshon pas kha dog dmar po/ de yi steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de yi steng du sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas ni rang gi snying kha ste rang gi lus kyi dbus nu ma gnyis kyi bar thad/ sgal tshigs la cung nye ba'i gnas su bsgom mo/ /de yang hūm̐ gi gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes mtshon pa yin no/ /sbyang gzhi rang gi sems kun gzhi/ de las 'phros pa'i sems byung gi rgyu ba sna tshogs pa bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyang byed kyai rdo rje'i thugs gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam pa hūm̐ yig cha lnga pa'i rang bzhin du gyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhis nyams su len pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos/ tha mal rnam rtog blo bzlog dang / /bar chad bgegs las bsrung ba dang / /lha yi lha la tshogs bsags pas/ /tshogs myur rdzogs pa'i dgos pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa gang la tshogs bsags pa'i yul ni/ ci'i phyir tshogs zhing zhes bya snyam na/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad du zhing las lo thog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba ltar yul de la brten nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i lo thog phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i zhing yin pas na de ltar du brjod pa yin la/

des na 'di la/ gang gis spyan 'dren pa/ gang nas spyan 'dren pa dang / gang spyan 'dren pa dang gsum/ dang po la ting nge 'dzin/ sngags/ phyag rgya dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar byas/ sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig tu 'od zer sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'phros 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas/ tshogs zhing rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu 'od zer sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ bar du gnas pa dang mnyam du 'od zer rnams snying kha'i hūm̐ las thim par bsam mo/ /'od zer ni kha dog sna lnga rtse mo lcags kyu'i rnam par bsgom mo/ /de yang hūm̐ gi rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / 'od zer 'phros pas rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs mtshon no/ /'od zer kha dog sna lngas rang gi rnam par shes pa'i bzhon par gyur pa'i 'byung ba lnga yi rlung sbyong / spro bsdus las rlung ldog 'jug gnas gsum sbyong / gnyis pa sngags ni/ rdo rje gur las/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pa/ oṃ mchog ster ba/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ sa mā dzaḥni 'dus zhes pa'i don yin no/ /gsum pa phyag rgya ni/ slob dpon lha yi rigs kyi blo gros kyis/ /rdo rje se gol sbyar ba yis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya'o/ /gnyis pa gang nas spyan 'dren pa la longs sku'i zhing khams dang / sprul sku'i zhing khams rnams nas spyan 'dren par bshad pa yod kyang 'dir rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ sangs rgyas rnams ni chos sku spros bral du bzhugs pa'i 'od zer des bskul bas sangs rgyas rnams gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa'am/ yang na nam mkhar bzhugs pa la rang gi sgrib pas bsgribs nas ma mthong ba/ 'od zer des sgrib pa rnams bsal nas mthong bar byed pa tsam la spyan 'dren par bzhed do/

/gsum pa gang spyan 'dren pa ni/ rje btsun rin po ches pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du lha dgu'i gtso bo'i gtsug tu ting nge 'dzin brtan pa'i ched du/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa la spyan 'dren pa tsam bshad pas 'dir de ltar du bzhed pa'o/ /sbyang gzhi rang gi skye ba snga phyi rnams su ma dag pa'i las gsog pa'i yul gyi snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed kyai rdo rje lha dgu bla ma dang bcas pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas nyams su len pa'o/ /gsum pa/ ji ltar tshogs bsags pa'i tshul la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa 'bul ba/ rgyun bshags bya ba/ sdom pa bzung ba/ gnang ba nos pa dang lnga/ dang po la/ don dngos bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ gang gis phyag 'tshal ba/ gang la phyag 'tshal ba/ ji ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i kyai rdo rje bla ma dang bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa la ting nge 'dzin/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang gsum/ dang po ni/ tshogs zhing de rnams kyi yon tan mthong nas dad pa shugs 'byung gis kun nas bslangs te sems rtse gcig pas 'dud do/ /gnyis pa sngags ni/ na moḥni phyag 'tshal ba/ gu ru ni bla ma/ bh+yeḥni rnams so/ /yang na mo ni phyag 'tshal ba/ shrī he badz+ra ni dpal kyai rdo rje/ maṇ+ḍal ni dkyil 'khor/ bh+ye ni rnams so/ /gsum pa phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje thal mo'o/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ rang gis skye ba snga phyi rnams su phyag 'tshal bar mi 'os pa rnams la 'tshal ba dang / 'tshal bar 'os pa rnams la ma btsal ba la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dad pa shugs 'byung gi kun nas bslangs te/ sgo gsum gyi phyag tu bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul pa la don dngos bshad pa dang /

sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ gang gis mchod pa/ gang la mchod pa/ ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ /zhes pa'i don chos sku skye ba med pa las skye ba'i rnam 'phrul gzugs kyi skur ston pa/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su kyai rdo rje lha dgu bla ma dang bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa la mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ gnyis pa la gsang ba'i mchod pa/ phyi yi mchod pa/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lngas bstan te/ lha mo dkar mo ni gau rī ste/ phyag na ri dwags kyi mtshan ma zla ba'i brdas bstan pa ste byang sems dkar pos gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo chom rkun ma tsau rī ste phyag na bdud las rgyal ba'i nyi ma'i brdas bstan pa rak+tas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ro langs ma ni bait+ta lī ste dri chus gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ghasma rī ni phyag na gsang ba'i sman 'dzin pa ste dri chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /puk+ka sī ni phyag na rdo rje ste sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan te/ ri khrod ma ni phyag na ro ste bcud len grub pa'i dngul chus gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bcud len ni sngon bskal ba bzang po'i dus su yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems lus la reg na skra dkar dang gnyer ma mi 'byung zhing / btung na tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa zhig la zer ro/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u ste skyes pho mo'i thod pa ltag sprod la mi lpags kyis g.yogs rnge'u chung bzung ba'o/

/gsum pa ni/ 'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa'i/ /g.yung mo sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas bstan to/ /lha mo g.yung mo ni rlung mtshams kyi grwar gnas nas 'khyud pa'i stangs ka byas pas lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud zag med ye shes kyi bde bas tshim pa'o/ /yang na g.yung mo rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma la thim nas lha thams cad rjes su chags pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsam mo/ /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ 'di rnams kyi ni gtso bo mchod/ /ces pas bstan no/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi ni rang gi skye ba snga phyi rnams su mchod par 'os pa la ma mchod pa dang / mi shes pa'i dbang gis mchod par mi 'os pa la mchod pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed skabs 'dir mchod pa'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gsum pa rgyun bshags bya ba la/ de yi don bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs kyi don yan lag bdun pa bstan te/ de yang tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis bshags pa'i yan lag bstan la/ de la stobs bzhi tshang dgos pas/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras las skyobs par nus pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo tshogs zhing lha dgu bla ma dang bcas pa ni rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la khog tu dug btung pa lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag po byed pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid do snyam pa'i bshags pa byed pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ sdig pa dag par nges shes bskyed cing dga' ba khyad par can bsgom pa ni sor chud pa'i stobs te/ gsum po de tshig rkang phyi ma'i dngos shugs ci rigs pas bstan no/ /de nas tshig rkang gcig gi rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag bstan te/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i dge rtsa la phrag dog mi byed cing rjes su yi rang ba bsgom pa'o/

/de nas tshig rkang gcig gis don dam sems bskyed kyi yan lag bstan/ de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis skyabs 'gro'i yan lag bstan te/ de yang 'jig rten pa'i skyabs 'gro/ nges 'byung gi skyabs 'gro/ khyad par gyi skyabs 'gro/ bla na med pa'i skyabs 'gro dang bzhi las/ 'dir phyi ma nyid yin no/ /de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis smon pa sems bskyed kyi yan lag bstan te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du nges par thob par bya'o snyam du bsgom pa'o/ /de nas tshig rkang gsum gyis 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i don du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab cing / khyad par du rim pa gnyis la nan tan du bgyid snyam du bsgom mo/ /de nas tshig rkang gcig gis bsngo ba'i yan lag bstan te/ tshogs bsags pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas par bsngo bar bya'o snyam du bsgom mo/ /'di la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum du phye na/ dang po la gnyis te 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyang ba dang / mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de'i dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum la zhes pas sdig bshags/ 'gro ba'i dge la zhes pas rjes yi rangs/ dngos gzhi la bzhi ste yan lag phyi ma bzhi'o/ /rjes ni 'gro la zhes pas bsngo ba/ de dag gi don dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams lan gsum gyi bar du brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyang gzhi rang gi skye ba snga phyi rnams su rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i nyes pa chen po dang / gzhan gyi dge ba la phrag dog dang bar chad bgyis pa dang / gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu bzung ba dang / skyabs dam pa ma bsten pa dang / gzhan don du sems ma bskyed pa dang / sbyor ba phyin ci log tu bstan pa dang /

dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsngos pa dang / bsngos kyang phyin ci log pa dang / dman par bsngos pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed yan lag bdun pa'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /bzhi pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba la/ gang la bzung ba'i yul/ gang gis bzung ba'i rten gyi gang zag dus ji tsam gyi bar du bzung ba/ ji ltar sdom pa bzung tshul dngos bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas tshig rkang gcig gis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ de nas tshig rkang gnyis kyis bstan/ bzhi pa ji ltar sdom pa bzung ba'i tshul la/ rigs lnga spyi'i sdom pa bzung ba/ so so'i sdom pa bzung ba/ don bsdus te dam bca' ba'i tshul gyis bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis smon pa sems bskyed bstan/ de nas tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan la/ de yang rang gis khas blangs pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi spang bya thams cad spong ba ni nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang lam rim pa gnyis la nan tan du slob pa ni dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ bsdu dngos bzhi dang phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ /gnyis pa ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /zhes sogs sh+lau ka lngas rim pa bzhin du bstan/ de yang sh+lau ka dang pos phyi brda'i dkon mchog gsum dang nang don gyi dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig tu bstan pa yin/ de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam par snang mdzad de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin cing / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba yang sdom pa'i tshul khrims thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/

de nas sh+lau ka gcig gis rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu gsung gi dam tshig phyag rgya sku yi dam tshig de gsum ston pa'i slob dpon dang bcas pa bzhi po bzung ba ni mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig tu bstan la/ de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mi bskyod pa'i sbyang gzhi rnam g.yeng yin la/ de ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyong dgos shing / de bzhi bsgoms pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sh+lau ka gcig gis/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin pa ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig tu bstan pa yin la/ de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sbyang gzhi ser sna yin la/ de sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas sh+lau ka gcig gis phyi bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud/ theg pa gsum ste/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams te mdor na dam pa'i chos ma lus pa bzung ba ni 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig tu bstan la/ de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'od dpag med ni gsung rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin cing / dam pa'i chos kyang gsung gi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas sh+lau ka gcig gis khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba dang / mchod pa'i las ci nus byed pa ni don yod grub pa'i dam tshig tu bstan pa yin la/ de der 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ don yod grub pa ni phrin las kyi ngo bo brtson 'grus yin cing / las de rnams kyang brtson 'grus la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa don bsdus te dam bcas pa'i tshul gyis bzung ba ni/ sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstan te/ de yang sh+lau ka dang po'i tshig rkang dang po gnyis kyis smon pa dang / tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis kyis 'jug pa sems bskyed mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bstan pa yin no/

/sh+lau ka phyi ma'i don ni nyan rang shes bya'i sgrib pa las ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / ngan song gsum gyi sems can dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / mthar sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la 'god par bya ba'am/ yang na rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa las ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa las ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbyung ba'o/ /sbyang gzhi ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa'i rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa ma bzung ba dang / bzung kyang de las nyams pa'i snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong byed sdom bzung gi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /lnga pa snang ba nos pa ni/ tshogs zhing de rnams kyi zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod gnas pa 'di la legs par gnas na tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur bas lam rim pa gnyis sgoms shig ces gsungs shing / rang nyid kyis kyang de ltar du khas blangs par bsam mo/ /de nas tshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa dang / mi dmigs par bya ba dang / rang nyid la bstim pa dang gsum las 'dir bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rten 'brel du phyi ma nyid phyag len la mdzad do/ /gnyis pa yul ma dag pa la brten nas tshogs bsags pa la/ don dngos bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang thun mong du sgom tshul dang / thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgom tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos bstan gyi tshig don bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pa'i sna las lha mo puk+kā sī 'od zer sngon po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa'i rgyu bcas dang ldan par byas/ byams pa tshad med kyi ngo bo lha mo puk+ka sī ste sbos mo'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam/ de bzhin du rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sna las lha mo ri khrod ma 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu bcas dang bral bar byas nas snying rje tshad med kyi ngo bo sha ba rī ste ri khrod ma'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam/ de bzhin du rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa'i sna las lha mo gdol pa mo 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu bcas dang bral bar byas nas bde ba rgyu bcas dang mi 'bral bar byas/ dga' ba tshad med kyi ngo bo gdol pa mo'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam/ de bzhin du rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sna tshogs pa spros pa'i sna las lha mo g.yung mo 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa dang ldan par byas/ btang snyoms tshad med kyi ngo bo g.yung mo'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha mo mi spro bar 'od zer spro ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyang gzhi mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag sbyong byed tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor bsgyur nas sbyangs 'bras dag pa'i lha mo bzhis rgyas btab nas nyams su len pa'o/ /tshad med bzhi la yang / 'jig rten pa'i/ nyan thos kyi/ theg chen thun mong ba/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i tshad med dang bzhi las/ 'dir phyi ma nyid gtso bor bzung ba'o/ /tshad med bzhi zhes pa'i don yul tshad med la blo tshad med kyi ngo bo tshad med bzhi bsgom pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i gnas zhes pa'i don ni/ de bsgoms pa la brten nas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu lha tshangs pa la sogs pa'i mtho ris kyi rten thob pa dang /

mthar thug gi tshangs pa sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas so/ /gsum pa de gnyis kyi dgos pa bshad pa ni/ zas bzang po blug pa'i sngon du snod dag par bya dgos pa bzhin du dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis sgom pa la sngon 'gros rgyud dag par bya dgos pa dang / sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas gzugs sku thob pa ltar/ rang nyid kyi gzugs sku thob pa la'ang bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa la/ don dngos bshad pa/ de sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul/ de'i dgos pa bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ ye shes tshogs bsags pa'i skabs 'dir snang ba rang bzhin med par bsgom pa dang / snang med du bsgom pa gnyis las/ 'dir snang med du bsgom pa yin zhing / de yang ma dag pa'i snang ba rags pa tsam bkag nas sems kyi gnas lugs gsal stong zung 'jug tu mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /de la'ang gang zag stong pa nyid la goms 'dris che chung gis stong nyid btsan thabs su bsgom pa dang / bshigs te bsgom pa gnyis las/ 'dir dang po yin te/ rje btsun rtse mos/ dang por sngags brjod de/ de yi don dran pas stong nyid btsan thabs su bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ oṃ shu n+yā tā zhes pas oṃ ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ shu n+yā tā ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ dz+nyā na ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ badz+ra ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ swa bhā wa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ at+ma ko3haṃ ni zhes pa ni nga'o/ /yang na oṃ ni sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa/ shu n+ya tā ni yul rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ dz+nyā na yul can rang bzhin rnam par dag pa/ at+ma ko3haṃ ni nga'o zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/

sbyang gzhi rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng na sngar shi ba/ ma 'ongs pa na 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i bag chags ji snyed pa dang / de bzhin du snod kyi 'jig rten sngar zhig pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'jig par 'gyur ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed ye shes tshogs bsag gi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pa la brten nas sbyangs 'bras chos sku 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa de yi dgos pa bshad pa ni/ ye shes tshogs gsog gis phyi srid sbyangs shing / thob bya chos kyi sku lam du byed pa yin no/ /gsum pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ kun rtog sbyong byed de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa ye shes tshogs bsags 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang las/ sngon gyi snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis kun rtog sbyong byed lha so so'i dag par ldang ba'i thog mar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa yin la/ de la thun mong ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ de gnyis kyi dgos pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la don dngos bshad pa dang / de sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gnyis/ dang po la bsrung 'khor gang las spro ba'i gzhi/ de las spro ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dngos/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan mtsho skyes lugs dang / man ngag lugs kyi yan lag bzhi pa'i skabs su nyi ma rkyang pa bsgom par bshad kyang / ḍom bhi ba'i lugs dang 'dir yan lag drug pa'i skabs su/ paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa rwa rnams phyogs mdog can/ lte ba gru bzhi mthing nag la kun gzhi'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa'i don ni kha dog sna tshogs su yod pa dang /

'od zer sna tshogs su 'phro ba dang / 'phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa dang / phyogs bcur rwa sna tshogs gyes pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang rje btsun gyis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo nyi shu 'joms par byed pa mtshon pas rwa nyi shu par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa de las spros pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dngos ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer nag po 'og tu 'phros pa las/ 'og thams cad rdo rje nag po'i sa gzhi nas thang brdal ba lta bu dang / phyogs mtshams su 'phros pa'i rdo rje nag po'i rtsig pa bar med pa'i rwa ba zlum po/ steng du 'phros pas rwa ba'i nang du rdo rje nag po'i gur rmog kha sbub pa lta bu'i rtse mor khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa kha gdengs pas mtshan pa/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me phung kha dog sna lnga pa g.yas skor du 'ur sgra dang bcas nas 'bar bar bsam/ de'i tshad ni/ blo la ji ltar 'tshams pa/ che ba ni tshad med/ chung ba ni dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tsam bsgom pa yin te rig pas shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten dang / rang gi chos sgrub pa'i bgegs dang bar chad la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed ye shes lnga yi ngo bo bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas bsgom pas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe srod la bdud 'dul ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /zhib tu na/ phyi'i bar chad gdon lnga/ nang gi bar chad nad lnga/ gsang ba'i bar chad nyon mongs pa dug lnga la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad rang gi sems nyid skad cig ma gcig gi rnam 'phrul du shes par byas nas/ rang nyid ye shes lnga yi ngo bo bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin te srung 'khor 'khor 'das dbyer med do/

/bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdams ngag ces bya'o/ /gsum pa sngags kyi byin gyi brlab pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod do/ /de'i don ni/ oṃ ni dpal te gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ rak+ṣa ni srungs shig gang bsrung na hūm̐ gsum gyi mtshon pa/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor ram/ yang na rang gi lus ngag yid gsum mo/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la/ bdag bsrung ba dang / gnod pa phyir bzlog pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khor lo'i dbus su rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad du bsgom/ gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba steng du bsgom/ khro bo gzhan rnams zhal nang du gzigs/ 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba la me 'bar bas dgra bgegs bsregs pas chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam/ sngags gzhan mi bzla bar rak+ṣa lan gsum gyis brtan par byed pa tsam mo/ /gnyis pa la rten bskyed pa/ brten pa bskyed pa/ las la sbyar ba dang gsum/ dang po la gnas gang du bsgom pa/ gdan gang gi steng du bsgom pa/ sa bon gang las bskyed pa/ ngo bo gang bskyed pa/ de sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ sngar gyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i sprul gzhir gyur pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba'i steng du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bsgom zhing / de yang sa bon paṃ dang raṃ las bskyed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bh+rūṃ las bskyed do/ /bzhi pa la kha dog bshad pa/ dbyibs bshad pa/ tshad bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ye shes thig le las/ rdo rje rwa ba'i nang du ni/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bzhi pa ni/ /rtsibs bcu pa la gser gyi mdog /khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo ste lte ba sum cha/ de nas sum cha rtsibs kyi sbom pa/ de nas rtsibs kyi rtse mo rno ba/ de yang dang po gnyis khog stong / phyi ma rtse mo shin tu rno ba ral gri so gnyis ma lta bu ste/

nā ro pa'i zhal lung las/ khog stong mi g.yo rab tu 'khor/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa tshad ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dpag tshad brgya yi tshad tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa de sngags kyis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ ni sngar dang 'dra la/ badz+ra rdo rje/ tsakra 'khor lo/ rak+ṣa bsrung ba/ hūm̐ gnyis bdag dang bsrung bya gzhan/ bh+rūṃ ni dgra yi stobs 'phrog pa'o/ /gnyis pa brtan pa bskyed pa la/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa gnyen po'i yan lag skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag ye shes pa dgug cing gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag dbang bskur zhing rgyas 'debs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag dang bzhi/ dang po la gnas gang du bskyed pa/ sa bon gang nas bskyed pa/ de ltar bskyed pa'i lha'i ngo bo bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'khor lo'i lte bar steng 'og bar gsum du/ lte ba dang rtsibs kyi rtse mo'i bar/ 'og phyogs mu khyud la cung zad ma reg pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ hūm̐ ni bcu yi sbyor ba yis/ /khro bo bcu ni rim gyis dgod/ /ces gsungs pas phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo bcu'i sa bon bstan/ gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba sa bon gang las bskyed snyam na/ ḍom bhi bas/ bh+rūṃ ser po las gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba zhes gsungs pas bh+rūṃ las bskyed do/ /gsum pa de ltar bskyed pa'i lha yi ngo bo bshad pa la phal cher sgrub thabs dkyus bzhin las/ zhal phyag dang phyag mtshan gyi khyad par ni rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje khro bo skyes bu che/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /snying khar mnan pa'i khu tshur mdzub/ /g.yas pas rang gi mtshon cha 'phyar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i yan lag ni/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs rgyas pa'i skabs yin pas/

mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dang / spyi bor sku rdo rje ma la sogs pa thams cad bsgom mo/ /gsum pa ye shes pa dgug cing gzhug pa sgrub pa'i yan lag ni/ sgrub thabs dkyus bzhin no/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur zhing rgyas 'debs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ni/ phal cher dkyus bzhin la rgyas 'debs la mi 'dra ba mang na'ang / 'dir gur gyi dngos bstan las/ mtshams kyi khro bo cher gnag cing / /spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzin/ /gshin rje'i gshed ni rnam snang ste/ /pad ma'i khro bo rnam gzigs te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' thal sbyor la'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa las la sbyor ba la/ zab pa'i gnad lnga nyams su len pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul/ dmod pa 'dor zhing brtan par bya ba dang gsum/ dang po la gtso bo 'pho ba'i gnad/ bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad/ lha'i rnam pa'i gnad/ 'khor lo 'khor zhing byad ma bsgral ba'i gnad/ sngags bzla ba'i gnad dang lnga/ dang po ni/ sngar bskyed pa ltar hūm̐ mdzad steng du bsgoms nas/ dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur bar bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la lus sba ba/ ngag sba ba/ yid sba ba/ go bgo ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i phyi la uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i sngags tshar gsum gyis bskor ba'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po'i steng gi klad kor gyi nang du bla ma/ mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su bu dang chung ma/ g.yon du spun zla/ 'og tu nor rdzas rnams gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi lce rdo rje dkar mo rtse lnga pa me 'bar bar bsam zhing / bsrung bya rnams kyi ming yig dang po ngag gi ngo bo yig 'bru'i rnam pa hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i nang du tshud par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi sems dang gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/

mdangs 'gag med hūm̐ yig gi rnam pa gsal 'debs shing 'dzin med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi lus la go mtshams med par rdo rjes gtams pas rdo rje'i go khrab du gyur par bsam/ gsum pa lha'i rnam pa'i gnad ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi bar thad/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang nag de yi steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar nag de'i steng du dgra bgegs rnams lus rid pa/ nyam thag pa kha nas khrag skyug pa/ skra yags pa spyi bo tshugs su 'dug par bsam pa yin la/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las khro bo lcags kyu thogs pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ phyi rol gyi dgra bgegs thams cad bkug nas de rnams la thim par bsam/ 'di yang rtsa rgyud las/ khrag ni skyugs pa nyid dang yang / /'dar zhing mgo skyes grol ba dang / /kha ni 'og tu lta ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba shin tu khros nas/ zhabs brkyang bskum bsgyur/ zhal nas hūm̐ gi sgra chen po brjod de khro bo rnams la cher gzigs pas/ khro bo gzhan rnams kyang cher khros pas steng 'og gi khro bo zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur/ gzhan rnams zhal phyir gzigs par bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa 'khor lo 'khor zhing byad ma bsgral ba ni/ 'khor lo shugs drag pos g.yon du 'khor me rlung gis dgra bgegs rnams steng du bteg pas rkang mthil nas spyi bo'i bar rim pa bzhin du gtubs/ lhag ma rnams mes bsregs/ rlung gis rjes med du btang nas chos nyid kyi ngang du thim parabasam mo/ /lnga pa sngags bzla ba'i gnad ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ zhes pa nas tsakra bar+dha'i bar gtso bo rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur bar gsal 'debs shing / zhar byung khro bo gzhan rnams dang 'khor lo dran pa tsam byed do/

/sarba yan+t+ra nas sarban+tu zhes gsungs pa'i bar gyis bsgrub bya gsal 'debs/ tshin+dha nas ma ra yas 'khor los dgra bgegs gtubs par bsam mo/ /hūm̐ bcus khro bo bcu gsal 'debs/ phaṭa gsum gyis steng 'og bar gsum gyi+i khro bo rnams ched du gsal 'debs so/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ ni kun nas dwang bas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ na maḥs man+ta dhar+m+ma naṃ ni kun nas dwang bas chos la phyag 'tshal/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ gha naṃ ni kun nas dwang bas dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal/ ces brjod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dpung bzang las/ srid pa gsum ni dkon mchog gsum po gtso/ /srid gsum bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin phyir/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gsang sngags mgo 'don no/ /bsod nams che dang log 'dren rmongs bya'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /oṃ ni skal ba bzang po'o/ /si tā ta pa tre ni gdugs dkar po can/ oṃ 'dra/ bi ma la dri ma med pa/ oṃ 'dra/ shaṃ ka ra ni 'byung gnas/ pra t+yaṃ gi ra badz+ra ni tshul min pa brlag pa'i rdo rje/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti ni gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ sarba thams cad/ yan+t+ra 'phrul 'khor/ man+t+ra sngags/ mu la karma ni rtsa ba'i sngags/ ban+dha naṃ ni 'ching ba/ tā ḍa ni bzlog pa/ kī la nāṃ wa ni phur bus btab/ ma ma bdag tri ta byas pa/ ye na gal te/ ke na byed na/ tsit+ta sems/ kri tan+ta de dag sarban+tu thams cad/ tshin+dha gnyis gtubs gnyis/ bin+dha gnyis phug gnyis/ tsi ri gnyis phye mar gyis gnyis/ gi ri gnyis gyis shig gnyis/ ma ra gnyis sod cig gnyis/ hūm̐ bcu chos kyi dbyings la yul yul can cung zad med pa mtshon/ phaṭa gsum ni ngan song gsum gyi nyes pa 'joms pa/ zhes pa'i don no/ /bha ya nāṃ sa ni ma ha ma ya'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las bshad pas/ 'dir rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro gang yang rung ba'i sngags kyi sham bu la btags te bzlas na sngags de nyid kyi nus pa stong 'gyur du 'gro bar bshad pas bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la tshar gsum tsam bzla bar mdzad do/

/gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi ni ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten bag chags pa dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rten bsrung ba'i 'khor los sbyongs/ bcud kyi sems can skye gnas bzhir skye ba blangs pa ni lha dam tshig pa bskyed pas sbyong / de nas lus yongs su rdzogs pa ni skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pas sbyong / de nas sems pa nar son pa ni ye shes pa dgug gzhug gis sbyong / de nas rang gi mnga' thang la dbang bsgyur ba ni dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pas sbyong / de nas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bya ba sna tshogs byed pa ni zab pa'i gnad lnga ldan gyis sbyong / gsum pa dmod pa 'dor zhing brtan par bya ba la/ dmod pa 'dor ba dang / brtan par bya ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ ngag gi sgo nas su gang dag sogs brjod cing / lus kyi sgo nas thal mo lan gsum tsam brdab/ yid kyi bsam pas rang gi lag mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje ri rab tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtshan pa re re bsam/ de gnyis kyi bar du dgra bgegs rnams nyer gyis 'tshir nas mthar gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan par bsam pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ hūm̐ gi drag chas phyag rgyas btab/ /rdo rje 'tshir ba'i bde ba nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bstan par bya ba ni/ ngag tu hūm̐ ring po brjod pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi khro bo rnams zhal nang du gzigs/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yon brkyang du mdzad/ khro bo rnams bdag dang bsrung bya la zhi ba'i lta stangs kyis gzigs shing / 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ rak+ṣa gsum brjod pas srung 'khor gyi bsgom bzlas nyams su blangs pa'i byin rlabs thams cad brtan par bya'o/ /de dag ni drang don gyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yin la/

nges pa'i don du na rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su gzhan gyis dge ba bsgrub pa la bar chad byas pa'i las gzugs phyi rol du dgra bgegs kyi rnam par snang ba yin te/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ rang sems bdud du snang ba de/ /bgegs kyang rang gi sems yin no/ /de'i gnyen po rang gi sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas de'i gnyen por rang gi sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid yin zhing / de'i shes rab stong pa'i cha rdo rje gur dang mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i rnam par shar ba dang / bgegs rnams tshar bcad nas chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ rnam par rtog pa chen po 'joms par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa de gnyis kyi dgos pa bshad pa ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /de dag gi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos rnams bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ma lus pa rnam par bzhag pa dang / yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor pas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yan lag drug gi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa la sbyang gzhi dang sbyang 'bras kyi chos rnam drug tu 'du ba las/ sbyong byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug tu nges pa yin te/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ khams drug yul drug dbang po drug /rnam shes drug dang nyon mongs drug /kha dog drug dang rigs drug dang / /phung po dbyings dang bcas pa drug /sbyangs nas rgyal ba rigs drug go /thob byed yan lag drug po yi/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul la/ de'i gnas tshul shes dgos pas skabs 'dir sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad na spyir 'khor 'das kyi snang ba thams cad bsdu na ma dag pa'i snang ba/

nyams kyi snang ba/ dag pa'i snang ba gsum du 'dus pas/ de'i dang po ni 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng du bag chags kyi tshul du yod pas/ de'i bag chags nang rdo rje'i lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du tshang / de rnams kyi nang du rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gdugs nam mkha' la 'phyar bas grib ma sa la 'byung ba bzhin/ phyi rol du 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs shar ba yin no/ /de yang phyi rol du snang tshad thams cad nang rdo rje'i lus la rtsa yi ge'i tshul du tshang / de thams cad gsang ba sems nyid kyi steng du bag chags kyi tshul du tshang bas/ rang gi sems nyid gcig pu rnam pa de dang der snang ba la/ 'di ni sems/ 'di ni lus/ 'di ni phyi rol gyi don zhes tha dad du go bar mi bya'o/ /yang dag par na lus sems gnyis gla ba dang gla ba'i ril ma'am/ me tog dang me tog gi dri ltar dbyer med gnas kyang / gnas skabs su lus rten sems brten pa/ khams gsum yul/ snang ba thams cad longs spyod kyi rnam par shar ba la thabs kyis zin pa dang ma zin pa'i bye brag gis 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi byed pa'i cha nas kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ces kyang bya/ lam gyis ma bsgyur bas ting nge 'dzin gyi 'char sgo dang bral ba'i cha nas ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes kyang bya/ gsal stong zung 'jug gsum dang lhan cig tu gnas pa'i cha nas gzhi lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum zhes kyang bya/ lam gyi sbyang ba'i gzhi yin pa'i cha nas sbyang gzhi zhes kyang bya/ glo bur gyi dri ma dang bcas pa'i cha nas sbyang bya zhes kyang bya/ sbyangs na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bor gyur pas na rigs sam rgyu zhes kyang bya ste mdor na 'di ni sems/ 'di ni lus/ 'di ni phyi rol gyi don zhes tha dad du btags kyang / snang ba'i gzhi dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems nyid gsal rig gcig pur shes par bya'o/

/gnyis pa nyams kyi snang ba ni/ sngar gyi sems gsal rig de nyid la smin byed kyi dbang bskur bas lha dang ye shes su bsgyur ba de nyid kyi don gtan la 'bebs pa yin la/ de yang rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng du sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i nus pa sa bon nam rgyu'i tshul du gnas pa dbang bskur la sogs pa lam gyi rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pa de nyid rtogs par byed pa'i thabs yin pas na lus thabs kyi rgyud dam/ bshad rgyud ces kyang bya/ de nyid kyi rgyun nyams su blangs pa la brten nas snang stong gsal stong la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes nas snang ba thams cad de'i ngo bor 'char bas na nyams kyi snang ba zhes kyang bya/ gsal stong zung 'jug gsum mngon du byed pas na lam lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum zhes kyang bya/ de ltar na lam la ming gi rnam grangs du mar btags kyang / lha dang ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa'i sems gsal rig gcig pu shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa dag pa'i snang ba ni/ sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyong byed bskyed pa'i rim pas lha khang gzhal yas khang du bsgyur ba dang / sbyang gzhi sems kun gzhi'i bag chags sna tshogs pa dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rdzogs rim gyis bde chen gyi ye shes su bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhis nyams su len pas de'i don lus la mngon du gyur pa ni phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud dam/ dag pa'i snang ba'am/ sbyangs 'bras zhes kyang bya'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyong tshul sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed lam gyi ngo bor snang ba bsgyur ba'i tshul du bsgom pas sbyangs 'bras dag pa'i snang ba gnas gyur gyi tshul gyis thob pa yin/ de bzhin du sbyang gzhi 'khor ba sbyangs 'bras mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo bor sbyong byed lam gyis bsres te dbyer med ro gcig tu nyams su len pa ni 'khor 'das dbyer med yin te/

rtsa rgyud las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid/ /rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas na/ /'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rje sa chen gyis/ bum dbang ngo sprod du/ rnal 'byor rtog pa ye shes kyi/ /dbang du gyur na 'khor ba med/ /ye shes rnam par rtog pa yi/ /dbang du gyur na grol ba med/ /ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin du phyi nang bsres te nyams su len pa dang / rgyu 'bras rgyas btab tu nyams su len pa dang / rigs bdag 'brel ba'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa la sogs pa mtha' dag la shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i lam dngos ji lta bus nyams su len snyam na lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len/ de yang gcig la mtshon na dper na sbyang gzhi gzugs kyi phung po/ sbyong byed gzhal yas khang gi rnam par nyams su len pa ni rnam pa lam byed/ de nyid rnam par snang mdzad du mos pas mos pa lam byed/ de yang 'bras dus kyi rnam par snang mdzad dngos yin snyam du bsam pa 'bras bu lam byed/ de la brten nas rang rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sdig sgrib dag par 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam byed ces bya/ de yang sbyang gzhi de la 'bras bur zhen nas sbyong byed lam gyis nyams su blangs pas rgyu 'bras 'brel pa bcas yin pas 'bras bu thob par nges pa yin te/ zhen pas zhugs na 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam zhes bya'o/ /de yang dper na nam mkha'i zla ba la zhen cing lta bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan la bltas pas/ nam mkha'i zla ba'i kha dog dang dbyibs la sogs pa tshul ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa nam mkha'i zla ba dang chu nang gi zla ba 'brel pa can yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong ba la bskyed rim gyi skabs su tshogs bshad kyi dbang du byas na mngon par rtogs pa la tshar gcig gi skye gnas phyed dang bzhi sbyong la/

slob bshad kyi dbang du byas na dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin re res kyang sbyong bar bzhed do/ /ljon shing las/ bskyed rdzogs kyang skye ba dang 'chi ba'am/ snang ba dang stong pa'i rtog pa mtha' dag sbyong ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag bdud rtsi myong ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag dang drug dang po la gzhi'i yan lag rgyu'i yan lag rkyen gyi yan lag gnas thabs kyi yan lag dang bzhi/ dang po la/ don dngos gtan la dbab pa dang / dang po la gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i dgos pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ming gi rnam grangs/ ming gi don/ rab tu dbye ba/ sa bon/ kha dog dbyibs/ mtshon tshul/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul dang brgyad/ dang po ni/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bha ga phyag rgya nam mkha'i khams rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i 'byung gnas yin pas na de skad ces bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ steng gi dbang du byas na zur gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug rnams so/ /bzhi pa sa bon ni/ mtsho skyes kyis/ shes rab e yi rnam pa can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa kha dog ni/ phyi dkar la nang dmar bar bzhed do/ /drug pa dbyibs ni/ steng du zur gsum 'og tu zur gcig dang bcas pas gtor ma gru gsum mgo mjug ldog pa'i nang brus pa lta bur bzhed do/ /bdun pa mtshon tshul ni/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba ni thabs shes mtshon/ steng gi zur gsum gyis sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum mtshon/ 'og gi zur gcig gis snying po kyai rdo rje mtshon/ rtsa ba phra la gdengs ka che ba ni las dang po pa nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bar gyi yon tan rnams gong nas gong du rgyas pa mtshon no/

/yang na steng gi zur gsum gyis rnam thar sgo gsum yang mtshon no/ /brgyad pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi rang gang du skye ba'i ma dag skye gnas te/ mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas na ma'i mngal/ sgong skyes kyi sgo nga / brdzus skyes kyi me tog la sogs pa/ drod gsher skyes la sa gzhi la sogs pa rang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba'i ma dag pa'i skye gnas sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong byed rnam thar sgo gsum kyi rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum du bsgyur nas bsgoms pas/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas pa'i rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa de'i nang du gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i dgos pa bshad pa ni/ gdul bya 'dod chags can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir rang chos sku skye ba med pa la skye ba'i rnam 'phrul ston pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa rgyu'i yan lag la/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dang / de byin gyis rlob byed kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po la don dngos bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul gnyis/ dang po la 'byung bzhi re re la sa bon gang yin pa/ ming gang yin pa/ kha dog gang yin pa/ dbyibs gang yin pa/ mtshan ma gang gis mtshan pa dang lnga lnga yod pa las/ dang po rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni rang rgyud la snang ba'i ma dag pa'i rlung gi sems snang bag chags bcas pa yaṃ yig gi rnam par shar ba ni sa bon/ de las byung ba'i ming ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ kha dog ni sngon po/ dbyibs ni gzhu lta bu/ mtshan ma ni 'chang bzung dang mchog ma la rlung gi rang bzhin ba dan g.yo bzhin pa yaṃ yig gis mtshan pa'o/ /de bzhin du de'i steng du raṃ yig gi rnam par shar ba'i raṃ yig ni sa bon/ ming ni me'i dkyil 'khor kha dog ni dmar po/ dbyibs ni gtor ma gru gsum mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu/ mtshan ma ni me'i rang bzhin raṃ yig gis mtshan pa'o/

/de'i steng du waṃ yig ni sa bon/ ming ni chu'i dkyil 'khor/ kha dog ni dkar po/ dbyibs ni zlum po/ mtshan ma ni bum pas mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du laṃ yig ni sa bon/ ming ni sa'i dkyil 'khor/ kha dog ni ser po/ dbyibs ni dpangs cung zad dang bcas pa'i gru bzhi/ mtshan ma ni lte bar laṃ yig zur bzhi la sa'i rang bzhin rdo rje rtse gsum pa phyed pas mtshan pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul la/ sbyang gzhi rnam bzhag sbyong byed ngos bzung ba/ de nyid ngo sprod de nyams su len pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten chags 'jig gnas gsum thams cad 'byung bzhi la brten nas byed cing / de yang chags pa'i thog mar 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung du 'byung ba yin no/ /bcud kyi sems can skye ba'i thogs mar mngal gyi sngon 'gro 'byung bzhi lugs ldog tu 'byung ba yin no/ /mngal gyi dngos gzhi ni 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung gi rim pa dang mthun pa yin la/ bcud kyi sems can lus gnas pa la yang / rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ 'byung bzhi lugs ldog gi rim pa dang mthun pa yin zhing / rten lus kyi dbang du byas na/ 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung gi rim pa dang mthun pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sbyong byed ngos bzung ba ni/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'am/ yum lnga'i bdag nyid kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i ngo bo 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par 'char ba ni sbyong byed yin no/ /gsum pa de nyid ngo sprod de nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ snod bcud kyi 'byung bzhi gang yin kyang 'dra/ lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog ji ltar yin kyang rung / sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i 'byung bzhir snang ba'i rtog pa thams cad sbyong byed rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bo 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin te/ de yang gcig la mtshon na ma dag pa'i rlung de lha mo g.yung mo'i sgrol ma'i ngo bo rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par sgom pa ni rnam pa lam byed/

de la lha mo de nyid du zhen pa ni mos pa lam byed/ de yang 'bras dus kyi lha mo dngos yin snyam du bsam pa ni 'bras dus lam byed/ de la brten nas bdag rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam byed yin no/ /de bzhin du 'byung ba 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /de yang 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog gang yin kyang skabs 'dir 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung du sgom pa sogs nas sbyong ba yin no/ /gnyis pa de byin gyis rlob byed kyi 'khor lo bsgoms pa la/ don dngos bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo/ /dang po la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa las/ dang po rgyas pa ni/ bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad bskyed pa dang / bsdus pa sa bon bh+rūṃ yig tsam las bskyed kyang 'dir 'bring po'i dbang du byas nas/ bh+rūṃ las chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ kha dog ni sbyangs 'bras rnams kyi sku mdog gi dbang du byas nas dkar po/ sbyang gzhi'i kha dog gi dbang du byas nas ser po/ rtsibs kyi grangs ni rje btsun rtse mos/ phyogs brgyad kyi dbang du byas nas rtsibs brgyad du bshad kyang / 'dir rje btsun rin po ches steng 'og gnyis kyi rtsibs bsnan pas bcur mdzad pa ltar yin no/ /mtshan ma ni 'khor lo'i lte bar bh+rūṃ yig ser pos mtshan pa'o/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi gzugs kyi phung po/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gzugs kyi khams so/ /sbyong byed rnam snang gi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i rnam par bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras rnam snang gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /'byung bzhi 'khor los byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos pa ni/ gzhal yas khang la rnam par snang mdzad kyi nga rgyal 'jog sla pa'i ched du'o/ /gsum pa rkyen gyi yan lag la/

don dngos nyams su len pa dang / de rkyen du 'gyur ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad/ nam mkhar rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim bzhin steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'i steng 'og tu hoḥyig dmar po gnyis kyi mtha' brten pa yin zhing / de yang sbyang gzhi rang gi sems nyid la ma dag pa'i bar dor snang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum sred len dang bcas pa sbyong byed kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs dang / thabs dang shes rab kyi ngo bo yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa de rkyen du 'gyur tshul ni/ rang gi bar do'i ngo bo nam mkha' las de 'dra ba'i yig 'bru lnga mar me gcig las gnyis mched pa'i tshul du byung nas 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la 'dres pa'i sa gzhal yas khang du grub par bsgom pa yin te/ de ltar du sgom pa'i dgos pa ni 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rang gi sems snang tsam du shes pa dang / de las gzhal yas khang yang gnyis med ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul du shes par bya ba'i phyir yin no/ /bzhi pa gnas thabs kyi yan lag la/ don dngos bshad pa/ zhar byung phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad bshad pa nang gi gdan bshad pa/ de dag la nga rgyal bzung ba'i tshul dang bzhi/ dang po la/ sdom tshig ni/ 'og gzhi logs dang steng thog dang / /sgo dang rta babs lnga yis bsdus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don lnga las/ dang po 'og gzhi'i rnam dag ni/ pad+ma'i lte ba'i rgya ni/ cha phran drug cu rtsa bzhi dbyibs zlum po/ kha dog ni bla ma gong ma'i bzhed pas/ lte ba ljang la ge sar ser/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ljang khur bzhed cing / 'dab ma'i grangs ni la li ta badz+ra gyis/ 'dab ma 'bum ldan de dbus su/

/zhes gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /kha dog ni sna tshogs pa/ zhes la cha phran gnyis pa'o/ /de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgya ni pad+ma'i lte ba dang mthun/ dbyibs zlum po/ kha dog dmar po/ bri cha ljang khur bzhed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rje btsun rin po ches gzhal yas khang rgyan du ma dang ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la shar bas kha dog sna tshogs pa mtshon pa'i don yin par bzhed/ yang na pad+ma'i lte ba ljang khur yod pa'i don yin te/ dper na dar ljang khu'i steng du nor bu me shel bzhag pa lta bu'o/ /de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje ni a bhi dha na las/ ka ba'i rtse nas 'thon rtse mo/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'od po che/ /zhes pa'i don/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa rgya cha chen bcu gnyis pa/ dpangs cha chen gcig pa/ phyogs kyi rwa rnams phyogs mdog can/ rtsa ba phra ba cha phran gnyis gnyis te/ de nas je sbom la song ba'i dbus rwa'i dkyil gyi sbom sa la cha chen gcig rwa rnams kyi sbom sa la cha phran gsum gsum/ rtse mo phra sa rnams la cha phran gnyis gnyis te dkyus ni cha chen gnyis so/ /de lta bu'i rwa lnga phyogs bzhir gyes tshul a bha ya ka ras/ rwa yi blor yang rwa gzhan no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ g.yas g.yon du rwa gnyis gnyis sbrags mar bshad pa yin no/ /kha dog ni zhal mdog tu 'dod pa dang / mdog gzhan du 'dod pa dang / phyogs mdog tu 'dod pa dang gsum las phyi ma nyid yin no/ /de yang 'og gzhi de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid de dag gi rnam par shar ba yin no/ /'og gi pad nyi ni thabs shes mtshon/ de'i steng gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba mthing nag gis chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mtshon la/ rwa rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa phyogs bzhir gyes pa 'dis chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la ye shes gzhan bzhi dang ldan pa mtshon pa yin no/

/gnyis pa la sogs la rgya phyed dpangs su 'dod pa dang / rgya mnyam dpangs mnyam du 'dod pa dang / dpangs su cha phran lnga 'dod pa la sogs pa yod kyang / rang lugs lnga gsum dpangs su bzhed pa yin la/ de yang gzhal yas khang gi rtsig pa'i rgyar cha phran sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa de'i lnga cha gsum ni cha phran bcu dgu dang cha phran gcig gi lnga cha yin la de nyid de'i dpangs su bzhed pa yin no/ /de lta bu la sogs kyi rnam gzhag gi sdom tshig ni/ logs la rtsig pa pha gu dang / /drwa phyed mda' yab pu shu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhal yas khang gi rtsig pa ni sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba nas cha chen bzhi gzhal ba'i phyi rol cha chen lnga pa'i dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab pa'i sar/ kha cig rtsig pa rim pa lnga ste steng nas steng du brtsegs par 'dod kyang / 'dir nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po rnams phyi nang sbrags te rtsig pa'i dpangs cha phran bcu drug yod pa/ de'i steng du pha gu ni kha cig dmar po 'dod kyang / 'dir ser por bzhed pa'i dpangs la cha phran gcig zhengs la cha phran gnyis nang rtsig pa'i ngos mnyam pa/ phyir cha phran phyed 'char ba'i gdong la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra tshom gyis spras pa/ de'i steng du drwa phyed kyi sa rin po che'i bre phul ni phyogs re rer brgyad brgyad/ mtshams bzhi re re steng kun dril bas sum cu rtsa drug ste/ de yang gcig la mtshon na bre phul bzhir brtsegs pa re re la dpangs cha phran gyi phyed yod pa/ zhengs la 'og ma cha phran gcig gong ma rnams rim pa bzhin cha phran phyed phyed ring du song ba/ de'i steng du gser gyi gdung leb bam ska rags ni dpangs la cha phran gcig gi lnga cha/ zhengs ni bre phul steng ma dang mnyam pa ste cha phran gcig de'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas mu tig gi drwa ba 'phyang ba ste slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis/

drwa ba ni mu tig gi chun 'phyang ste mchog dbus na yod pa'o/ /drwa phyed ni mchog mtha' na yod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'i steng du bya 'dab la thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i mda' yab dpangs su cha phran gcig yod pa'o/ /dbyibs ni nor bu mig gsum pa yu ba cung zad dang bcas pa'i mgo thur du bstan pa rus rgyan rnying ma'i za ra tshags sam spyi blugs mchu med mgo thur du bstan pa lta bu'o/ /de'i steng du rin po che'i pu shu gyen la langs pa dpangs su cha phran gcig dbyibs byang chub chen po'i mchod rten mgo thur du bstan pa lta bu'i khong bsengs pas khor yug tu bskor ba'o/ /gsum pa steng thog kha cig mchod rten gyi rnam par 'dod pa/ rgyal khab kyi rnam par 'dod pa yod kyang / 'dir thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud rtsa 'grel gyi dgongs pa thog phub rim pa gsum du gsungs pa ltar/ de'i sdom tshig ni/ steng thog ka ba shing brtsegs dang / /gdugs dang thog phub rim pa gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bshad na ka ba'i grangs ni/ rin po che las grub pa phyogs re re bzhin rtsig pa la brten pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad/ de'i tshad ni/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mtha' gcig ni rdo rje'i gdung la thug pa/ mtha' gcig ni gzhal yas khang gi lte ba la brten no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ming don ni rdo rje lta bu'i bsam pas/ dngos po thams cad sprul pas na/ /thams cad la rdo rje'i ming du sbyar bas/ rdo rje ka ba zhes bya'o/ /de yang gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam phyogs mdog can dpangs su cha phran gcig gi lnga cha yod pa'i steng du tshangs thig gi phyogs g.yas g.yon du cha phran lnga lnga gzhal ba'i rtsig pa la nye ba'i phyogs/ ka ba'i rnam pa sbom la cha phran gcig yod pa/ dpangs su cha phran bcu drug yod pa brgyad btsugs pa'i steng du gzhu ring thung gnyis la cha phran gnyis yod pa/

de'i steng du cha phran gcig yod pa'i sa rdo rje'i gdung zlum pos khor yug tu bskor ba'o/ /de dang gser gyi gdung leb mnyam pa'i steng du thog phub pa'i sne mor cha phran gnyis 'phyang ba'i bya 'dab can no/ /rdo rje'i gdung zlum gyi steng du rtsig pa zlum po phyogs mdog can dpangs su cha phran phyed drug yod pa/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran phyed/ de'i steng du drwa phyed kyi sa cha phran phyed/ de'i steng du dpangs cha phran gcig yod pa'i rdo rje'i thal gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bris pa/ phyogs mtshams kyi re'u mig rnams thog phub pa'i sne mor cung zad 'phyang ba'i bya 'dab can no/ /de'i dbus su rdo rje'i gdung gru bzhi pa'i steng du rtsig pa gru bzhi kha dog sngon po dpangs su cha phran bzhi la lnga chas dman pa/ de'i steng du pha gu cha phran gcig gi sum cha/ de'i steng du drwa phyed kyi sa cha phran gcig gi sum gnyis yod pa/ de'i steng du rgya phibs kyis phubs pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa nor bu'i tog gis spras pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang rdo rje'i gdung zlum gyi 'og ka ba'i bar gyi rdo rje'i rwa ba 'obs lta bur 'dod pa dang / thog thag tu 'dod pa dang / rwa ba tsam du 'dod pa dang / gsum las 'dir phyi ma ltar rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dpangs su cha phran gcig yod pa'o/ /thog phub 'og ma'i bya 'dab kyi 'og rtsig pa'i 'gram nas dpangs dang zhengs cha phran gnyis gnyis yod pa'i 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po sgo 'khyud nas sgo 'khyud kyi bar du song ba'i steng du phyogs re rer/ 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi bzhis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa'o/ /bzhi pa sgo'i rnam gzhag la gru gsum gcig tu 'dod pa/ zlum po gcig tu 'dod pa/ zlum po sgo brgyad 'dod pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhir 'dod pa dang bzhi las/

'dir phyi ma ltar gru bzhi sgo bzhir bzhed pa yin no/ /sgo'i zhengs tshad la gzhal yas khang lnga char 'dod pa/ dgu char 'dod pa/ bcu char 'dod pa sogs 'byung yang / grub chen kun snying gis/ sgo nas 'khor lo brgyad cha ste/ /sgo 'khyud kyang ni de yi tshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gzhal yas khang gi brgyad cha'o/ /dpangs la cha chen gsum du 'dod pa dang / gnyis su 'dod pa yod kyang 'dir rta babs snam bu bzhi'i dbang du byas pas cha phran gnyis char bzhed/ de nas sgo'i g.yas g.yon du rtsig pa cha chen re re mdun du 'then pa ni sgo 'khyud/ de nas g.yas g.yon du cha phran gnyis gnyis 'then pa ni sgo 'gram/ de nas mdun du cha phran gnyis 'then pa sgo la sogs so/ /de'i dpangs ni cha phran lnga yod pa/ sgo la sogs kyi sne mor cha phran gcig dma' ba'i sar rdo rje'i gdung cha phran phyed/ de'i steng du cha phran phyed rtsig pa/ de'i steng du thog phub pa'o/ /sgo glegs 'dzugs tshul ni/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ sgo rnams kun gyi nang du ni/ /sgo srung rnams ni dgod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgo 'khyud sgo 'gram gyi 'gram mtshams nas sgo glegs nyis hral phyogs mdog can 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rang rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa 'dzud pa'o/ /lnga pa rta babs la rgyal po'i rta babs/ mchod pa'i rta babs/ rgyan gyi rta babs dang gsum las 'dir phyi ma ltar gzhal yas khang mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan gyi rta babs yin te/ de yang dpangs su cha chen gsum du 'dod pa dang / gnyis su 'dod pa dang / gcig tu 'dod pa dang gsum las phyi ma ltar bzhed/ de la yang snam bu bcu gcig tu 'dod pa dang / bzhir 'dod pa dang gnyis las phyi ma ltar bzhed do/ /de nas sgo glegs g.yas g.yon du bar stong cha phran re yod pa'i phyi zur bzhir/ ka ba'i sbom du cha phran gcig dpangs su cha phran lnga lnga yod pa'i ka ba 'dzugs la/ ka rgyan ni ka ba'i logs su dar dpyangs kyi tshul dpangs zhengs ka ba dang mnyam pa 'phyang ba/
