de'i steng du rta babs bzhi ni thig shing brtsegs pa lta bu phyi ngos mnyam pa/ dpangs su cha phran re re yod pa/ srid du rta babs 'og ma la cha chen bzhi yod pa/ gong ma rnams la rim pa bzhin 'og ma las cha phran re res thung du song ba'o/ /kha dog ni/ bsam gtan dag pas rta babs nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bsam gtan dang po na rtog dpyod me lta bu yod pas rta babs 'og ma dmar po/ bsam gtan gnyis pa na dga' ba chu lta bu yod pas rta babs gnyis pa sngon po/ bsam gtan gsum pa na dbugs dbyung rngub rlung lta bu yod pas rta babs gsum pa ljang khu/ bsam gtan bzhi pa na ting nge 'dzin mi g.yo ba sa lta bu yod pas rta babs bzhi pa ser po/ glang rgyab ni rta babs kyi mdun ngos nas mig gsum har por brus pa'i bar drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ rta babs kyi snam bu gong ma'i steng gi dbus su pad+ma'i dpangs la cha phran gcig zhengs la cha phran gnyis yod pa 'dab ma bzhi'am brgyad kyi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo'i zhengs la cha phran gnyis/ dpangs la cha phran gcig rtsibs brgyad dam bcu gnyis yod pa gyen du langs pa'i steng du gdugs kyi yu ba dang dpangs la cha phran phyed phyed yod pa/ gdugs mgo'i zhengs la cha chen gcig gi rtse mor nor bu gcig pa'i tog gis spras pa/ pad+ma'i g.yas g.yon cha phran re re gzhal ba'i sar ri dwags bse ru ser po nyal nas mig chos 'khor la lta ba de rnams kyi g.yas g.yon la sogs pa'i khor yug tu bum pa la brten pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / rnga yab dang gos la sogs pa rnams kyis spras pa'o/ /gnyis pa zhar byung phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad bshad pa la/ de yi sgron/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul/ de ltar bsgom pa'i dgos pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ shwa ba pa ti zhes gsungs pa'i/ shwa ba ni ro/ pa ti ni gnas te ro'i gnas zhes bya'o/ /de'i bya ba byed tshul ni/

ro mgo bo bcad pas chags pa/ dpyangs pas langs pa/ bsnyal nas nyal ba/ gsal shing gis phug pas gdug pa'i bya ba byed pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi 'dzam bu gling gi dur khrod brgyad po dus ji tsam na byung snyam na/ rtsod dus 'og zug pa'i dus mi rnams mig ser gyis phan tshun bsad pa'i ro rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad du spungs pa la brten nas dur khrod brgyad byung ba yin no/ /de yang spyir 'dzam bu gling na rnal 'byor ma stong phrag bdun cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs pas de'i gnas de nyid la mtshon na stong phrag bdun cu rtsa bzhi yod la/ de bsdu na sum cu rtsa bzhi/ de yang bsdu na nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ de yang bcu gnyis/ de yang brgyad du 'du ba yin te dur khrod brgyad nyid do/ /de yang ha ri ki la zhes pa shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa'i yul lo/ /ha ri ta ke na'i shing zhes pa ni shi ri shing ngam/ a ru ra yi snying ste/ de gnas pa'i yul la shar phyogs gtum drag gi dur khrod ces bya ba/ 'og ma rnams la'ang rim pa bzhin rgyas par shes par 'dod na bde mchog mkha' 'gro'i le'u bco brgyad pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtso cher thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du bsgom par bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni sgrub thabs dkyus bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ lus dang srid pa yongs su sbyong ba/ lha dang 'byung po dbang du 'du ba/ gtor mgron gyi gnas nges pa/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum ro gcig tu bsres te nyams su len pa'i dgos pa rnams yod pa las/ de lta bu'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum bsres te nyams su len pa'i tshul cung zad bshad na dur khrod ni sbyang gzhi yang dag pa'i 'khor ba mtshon no/ /de'i nang du gzhal yas khang gi sbyong byed lam byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mtshon/ de'i nang du lha dgus ni sbyangs 'bras sku lnga ye shes lnga tshad med pa bzhi la sogs pa mtshon/

de lta bu'i dag bya dag byed zhib tu bshad na dag bya phyi nang gnyis las/ dang po phyi yi dag byed ni spyir ma dag pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ bye brag tu 'dzam bu gling gi phyi rol gyi dur khrod chen po brgyad/ nang gi dag bya sna bug gnyis gcig tu byas nas bu ga brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad/ de rnams na zug pa'i rtsa brgyad ni shing brgyad/ de la rgyu ba'i rnam shes ni phyogs skyong brgyad/ de rnams kyi bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung brgyad ni zhing skyong brgyad/ de dag la 'byung ba lnga yi rlung dang ldan pa ni ri dang mchod rten dang me dang rlung dang sprin sna tshogs pa mtshon/ de lta bu'i dag bya de dag par byed pa'i sbyong byed ni/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gyi dur khrod brgyad yin no/ /de dag kyang ma dag pa dang cha 'dra bar snang yang / ma dag pa dngos ma yin te/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i phyir/ sbyang gzhi sems nyid la sbyar na 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad sbyong / 'bras bu dang sbyar na dur khrod brgyad ni sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs gnas brgyad/ shing brgyad ni byang chub kyi shing brgyad/ chu brgyad dang sprin brgyad ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje chen po/ me brgyad ni gnyis med kyi ye shes/ phyogs skyong brgyad ni sangs rgyas rabs bdun byams pa dang brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad ni dgra bcom pa brgyad mtshon pa sogs slob dpon rnal 'byor pas dur khrod brgyad kyi rtog pa nas bshad do/ /gsum pa gdan bshad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'phar ma gcig dang zhes gsungs pa ltar gzhal yas khang gi nang du lha rnams mtho dman med pa phyogs mdog can cha chen gcig yod pa/ lte ba sngon po cha chen drug yod pa'i dbus su yu ba cha phran gcig yod pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang tshun chad khebs pa'o/ /kha dog ni rje btsun sku mched kyis lha mo brgyad kyi sku mdog

phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog la mtshams rnams mdzes tshon du bzhed do/ /pad+ma'i lte ba'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'dab ma brgyad zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re bsam/ gtso bo'i gdan ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ nyi mar bzhugs zhes dang / bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ lha'i bu yi bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud/ phung po'i bdud ste bdud bzhi'i ngo bo gzugs khams kyi tshangs pa/ lha yi dbang po brgya byin/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po bdud sdig to can/ drag po dbang phyug chen po rnams mgo g.yas su bstan pa/ gdong gyen du phyogs pa thal mo sbyar ba steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ /lha mo brgyad kyi gdan ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag /gshin rje dang ni nor bdag dang / /bden bral dang ni thag bzang ris/ /gau rī la sogs pa'i gdan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rim pa bzhin/ 'dod khams kyi tshangs pa/ shar phyogs kyi dbang po nye dbang / khyab 'jug dbang ldan gyi phyogs skyong drag po/ lho phyogs kyi phyogs skyong gshin rje/ byang phyogs kyi phyogs skyong nor bdag lho nub kyi phyogs skyong srin po/ nub kyi phyogs skyong lha ma yin gyi dbang po thag bzang ris rnams mgo bo g.yon du bstan/ gdong gyen du phyogs la thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /dgos pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud bzhi gdan du byas pa ni bdud bzhi rtsad nas bcom pa mtshon/ lha mo brgyad kyis dregs pa can brgyad gdan du byas pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ gdan brgyad bsgom pa bdud bzhi dang / /'byung bzhi'i rnam rtog spang rtags yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa de dag la nga rgyal 'dzin pa ni/ sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa gti mug gzugs kyi phung po sa yi khams/ mig gi dbang po mig gi rnam par shes pa/ ma dag pa'i snod kyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed rnam snang gi ngo bo gzhal yas khang du bsgyur nas bsgoms pas 'bras dus kyi gzhal yas khang thob par 'gyur te/

de yang 'khor 'das dbyer med du bsres te lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa 'bras dus kyi gzhal yas khang la nga rgyal 'dzin cing sngags bzla ba yin te/ sngags kyi don ni/ oṃ ni dam bca' ba/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ nī la ya ni pho brang / badz+ra ni rdo rje/ swa bhā wa ni rang bzhin/ at+ma ko3haṃ ni bdag a haṃ ni nga'o/ /zhes gsungs pas bstan no/ /gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam snang ni sangs rgyas kyi sku yi ngo bo yin la/ sku yis gsung dang thugs la sogs pa'i rten byed pa ltar gzhal yas khang pa'ang sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs pa'i gnas sam rten yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag la dam tshig bskyed pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgom pa/ snod bcud sbyong ba/ mig sogs byin gyis brlab pa/ ye shes pa bzhugs pa dang lnga dang po la/ mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bskyed pa/ bskyed nas 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum thig ler zhu ba/ zhu ba glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bzhengs pa/ de yi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gsal gdab pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa yi/ /rnam pa lnga po sgom pa nyid/ /ces pa'i don la mngon byang gi ngo bo bshad pa/ grangs nges bshad pa/ go rim bshad pa/ sgom tshul gyi gnad bshad pa/ rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro tshul/ de la dogs pa gcod pa dang drug dang po la/ mngon byang dang po gnyis kyis rgyud bshad pa/ de las byung ba'i mngon byang dang po gnyis bshad pa/ mngon byang phyi nang gsum so sor bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ grangs/ 'god tshul/ kha dog rgyu/ phrag gnyis sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan dang lnga/ dang po ni/ ā li bco lnga la ā tsheg drag can bsnan pa'i ā li bcu drug pa phrag gnyis/

kā li sum cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du ya ra la wa sogs yi ge drug bsnan pas kā li bzhi bcu phrag gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ ā li phrag gnyis te steng 'og mgo sprad sgom pa/ phyi nang rim bzhin g.yas skor g.yon skor du bsgom pa yod kyang / 'dir sbyang gzhi'i dbang du byas nas ā li bcu drug phrag gcig pas bskor phrag gcig g.yon bskor du bsgom pa yin la/ de yang a gnyis bdud kyi mgo bo 'joms pa/ a tsheg drag can gnyis bdud kyi rkang pa'i tshul du bsgom pa'o/ /ka li'i 'god tshul yang de bzhin shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ā li phrag gcig ni mu tig gi rdog ma'am nor bu chu shel ltar ches cher dkar zhing 'od 'phro ba'o/ /kā li phrag gnyis ni mar me'i phreng ba'am nor bu me shel ltar ches cher dmar zhing 'od 'phro bar bsam/ bzhi pa rgyu ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i nang gi khams dkar po ni a li'i rgyu'am sbyang gzhi yin la/ de bzhin du khams dmar po ni ka li'i rgyu'am sbyang gzhi yin no/ /lnga pa phrag gnyis sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan la ā li phrag gnyis sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnal 'byor pa'i rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas g.yon gnyis nas spyi gtsug gi bar zla ba yar ngo mar ngo la khams dkar po ā li bcu drug gi rnam pas rim bzhin 'pho ba bcu drug bcu drug yod pa'am yang na thabs dang shes rab gnyis gnyis kyis phye bas sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /kā li phrag gnyis sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de rnal 'byor pa'i nang gi khams dmar po la 'byung ba bzhi nam mkha'i khams dang lnga yod cing / 'byung ba bzhi po re re la'ang nang gses kyi dbye ba 'byung chung bzhi yod pa dang / nam mkha'i khams la dga' ba bzhi yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ bde ba nam mkha' nyid kyi khams/ /zhes dang / sdom byung las/ nang du gcig ni gnas pa der/ /bzhi po de nyid nye bar gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /nyi shu po re re la'ang rdul gyi cha dang khu ba'i cha dang gnyis gnyis phye bas bzhi bcu'o/

/bzhi bcu po re re la'ang shes rab stong pa'i cha/ thabs bde ba'i cha gnyis gnyis phye ba brgyad bcu'o/ /mdor na sbyang gzhi rnal 'byor pa'i khams dkar dmar la sum cu rtsa gnyis dang brgyad cur nges pas sbyangs 'bras la mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yod pa'i dbang gis sbyong byed yi ge la ā li sum cu so gnyis dang kā li brgyad cu yod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa de las byung ba'i mngon byang dang po gnyis bshad pa la/ mngon byang dang po bshad pa dang / mngon byang gnyis pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la gsum ste/ ci'i phyir me long lta bu zhes bya/ ci'i phyir rnam pa zla ba bsgom/ ci'i phyir rgyu ā li las skyed ce na dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ me long lta bu zhes bya'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ye shes de la chos thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang ba yin zhing / ye shes de gzugs kyi phung po dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa'i bdag nyid kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa rnam pa zla bar sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rnam pa zla ba sgom sla ba dang / zla ba dri ma dang bral bar mtshungs pa yin la/ gsum pa rgyu ā li las bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ ā li zla ba'i gzug kyis gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ye shes de gzugs kyi sku yi rnam par byung ba na mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan par 'byung ngo / /mngon byang gnyis pa bshad pa la yang gsum ste/ ci'i phyir mnyam pa nyid/ ci'i phyir nyi mar bsgom/ ci'i phyir rgyu kā li las bskyed ce na/ dang po ni/ de la mnyam nyid ces bya ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ye shes des chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir yin zhing /

ye shes de tshor ba'i phung po dang / nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur pa'i bdag nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa rnam pa nyi mar sgom pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ phyis nas bdud las rgyal bas mnan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyi mas mun pa sel cing sems can la phan 'dogs pa ltar/ ye shes des ma rig pa'i mun pa sel zhing sems can la chags pas rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa rgyu kā li las bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ka li'i gzugs kyis snang byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ye shes de gzugs sku'i rnam par byung ba na dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ldan par 'byung ste kha sbyor las/ sangs rgyas yon tan ka sogs kyi/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni 'jug par byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mngon byang phyi ma gsum so sor bshad pa la/ mngon byang gsum pa bshad pa/ bzhi pa bshad pa/ lnga pa bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mngon byang gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po so sor rtogs pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang lha'i phyag mtshan sa bon nyid/ /so sor rtogs par brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ye shes de rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i chos thams cad ma bsgrib par gsal bar mkhyen pa'i cha nas de skad ces gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa rnam pa phyag mtshan du bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ phyag mtshan de dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa ma 'dres par snang ba ltar/ ye shes des chos thams cad ma 'dres par rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /mngon byang gsum pa 'di la/ phyag mtshan bkod pa'i skabs su/ rtsa rgyud las/ dbus su thod pa dkar po ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa bri/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir hūm̐ las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa/ dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang / aṃ las gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la aṃ gis mtshan pa bskyed par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa mngon byang bzhi pa la gnyis las/

dang po bya ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ye shes de sangs rgyas thams cad mdzad pa ro gcig tu 'dres pas sems can gyi don grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rnam pa ma 'dres par bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan gong dang mtshungs so/ /gsum pa mngon byang lnga pa la gnyis las/ dang po chos dbyings ye shes gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdzogs pa chos dbyings dag pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ye shes de sgrib pa thams cad dang bral bas dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rnam pa lhar bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ lha yi rnam pa de la yan lag dang nying lag la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa ltar/ ye shes de la ye shes kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i lha'i sku mdog ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od ces pas bstan cing de'i phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa grangs nges bshad pa ni/ sbyong byed kyi lam mngon byang lngar grangs nges pa yin te/ sbyang gzhi phung po dang / nyon mongs pa dang / skye gnas bzhi'i rim pa la sogs pa re re la lnga lngar grangs nges pa'i phyir dang / sbyangs 'bras rigs lnga ye shes lngar grangs nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa go rim bshad pa ni/ skye gnas bzhi'i rim pa dang mthun par rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim gyi dbang du byas te bshad na/ de yang mngal skyes lta bu la mtshon na/ thog mar pha'i khams dkar po 'og tu 'phel ba ni mngon byang dang po zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa/ de'i steng du ma'i khams dmar po 'bab pa ni/ mngon byang gnyis pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa/ de gnyis kyi bar du bar do'i rnam par shes pa bzhugs pa ni mngon byang gsum pa la phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa bsgom pa/ khu khrag gnyis dang bar do'i rnam shes gcig tu 'dres pa ni mngon byang bzhi pa nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres par bsgom pa/

mngal gyi gnas skabs su yongs su rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa ni mngon byang lnga pa lha'i sku mdog yongs su rdzogs nas mtshon/ bzhi pa bsgom tshul gyi gnas bshad pa ni/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo sprod pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa yin la/ de yang thun mong ba tshogs bshad kyi dbang du byas na mngon byang dang po gnyis kyis pha ma'i pha ma sbyongs/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa ni rang nyid kyi mngal dngos sbyong ba'am yang na mngon byang dang po gnyis kyis mngal skyes dang drod gsher skyes sbyong / nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pas thig le gong bur gyur pas ni sgong skyes sbyong / de las lha'i skur skyes pa ni brdzus skyes sbyong ba yin no/ /thun mong ma yin pa slob bshad kyi dbang du byas nas zhib tu sbyar te bshad na sbyang gzhi phung po lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ lus ngag yid yon tan bya ba dang bcas pa/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dbyings dang bcas pa lnga tshan gcig tu byas pa/ nyon mongs pa lnga/ rlung lnga/ rtsa lnga/ yi ge lnga/ khams bdud rtsi lnga/ nad lnga/ gdon lnga/ skyes gnas bzhi po re re la'ang lnga lngar phye bas lnga tshan bco lnga la sogs pa ma dag pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed mngon byang lnga'i ngo bor sbyong tshul snang ba bsgyur ba'i tshul du bsgoms pas/ sbyangs 'bras rigs lnga ye shes lnga sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa gnas gyur gyi tshul du thob pa yin no/ /de yang gcig la mtshon na sbyang gzhi gzugs kyi phung po sa'i khams/ lus kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ nyon mongs pa gti mug mngal skyes kyi pha'i khams/ drod gsher skyes kyi gsher/ sgong skyes kyi pha/ brdzus skyes kyi stong pa'i cha la sogs pa sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed rnam pa zla bar sgom pa ni rnam pa lam byed/ de lta bu me long lta bu'i ye shes su sgom pa ni mos pa lam byed/

de yang sangs rgyas kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes dngos yin snyam du bsgom pa ni 'bras bu lam byed/ de la brten nas bdag rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa sbyang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam byed ces bya la/ de rnams sbyang gzhi de rnam pa zla ba/ ngo bo me long lta bu'i ye shes su zhen nas bsgoms pas zhen pas 'jug pa'i lam byed ces gsungs/ de'ang rgyu 'bras 'brel pa can yin pas 'bras bu nges par thob pa ni 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i lam byed ces bya'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyor tshul rnams 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du sbyang gzhi tshor ba'i phung po/ nam mkha'i khams/ yon tan/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid ser sna dang nga rgyal/ skye gnas bzhi'i mngal skyes kyi ma'i khams dmar po/ sgong skyes kyi ma'i cha/ drod gsher skyes kyi drod/ brdzus skyes kyi gsal ba'i cha rnams sbyong byed rin 'byung gi ngo bo rnam pa kā li las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /sbyang gzhi 'du shes kyi phung po/ me yi khams/ ngag yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags/ skye gnas bzhi'i skye ba len pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa'i cha rnams sbyong byed 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /sbyang gzhi 'du byed kyi phung po rlung gi khams/ bya ba sgo lnga'i rnam shes/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog skye gnas bzhir skye ba len tshul gyi mngal skyes dang sgong skyes kyi dbang du byas na bar do'i rnam shes dang khu khrag 'dres pa/ drod gsher skyes kyi drod gsher dang bar do'i rnam shes 'dres pa/ brdzus skyes kyi gsal stong tsam dang bar srid 'dres pa'i cha rnams sbyong byed don yod grub pa'i ngo bo rnam pa nyi zla sa bon dang bcas pa 'dres pa'i thig le'i gong bur bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len par byed do/

/sbyang gzhi rnam shes kyi phung po/ chu'i khams/ yid rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi chos nyid du 'dzin pa'i cha/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang / skye gnas bzhir skye ba blangs pa'i lus grub pa'i cha rnams sbyong byed mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du bskyed nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /de yang sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed rnams kyi rnam par bsgyur ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin sbyangs pa la brten nas sbyangs 'bras de rnams gnas gyur tshul gyi thob pa yin te/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed de rnams sbyangs 'bras de rnams kyi rigs sam rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na sems can thams cad la sbyang gzhi de rnams rang grub tu yod pas sems can thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams pa mi rigs snyam na/ thabs khyad par can gyis ma zin pas 'khyams pa yin la/ 'di lta bu'i thabs khyad par can gyis zin na grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa rdzogs rim gyis smin byed du 'gro ba'i tshul ni/ rang gi khams dkar dmar gnyis la brten pa'i rnam shes ro gcig pa'i tshul gyis lus la brten nas gnas pa la rgyu dus kyi dbang gis smin par byas/ lam dus kyi bskyed rim gyi skabs su mngon byang lngar bsgoms pas las rung du gyur nas rdzogs rim gyis smin byed du 'gro ba yin te/ rdzogs rim gyi gang la gnad du bsnun pa'i gzhi'i gtso bo ni khams dkar dmar gnyis rnam shes dang gsum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa de la dogs pa bcad pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i zla ba la sogs pa de rnams me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa yin pa sgom pa yin na grub zin sgrub pa yin la/ ma yin nas sgom na sprang po rgyal por rlom pa ltar bsgoms pas 'grub par mi 'gyur ro snyam na/ yin pa la chos nyid dam pa yin pa dang dngos yin pa gnyis las dang po ltar yin pas bsgoms pas kyang mi 'grub pa'i skyon med la/

dngos ma yin pas grub zin bsgrub par 'gyur ba'i skyon med do/ /gnyis pa bskyed nas 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba la/ sbyor ba 'du shes gsum ldan/ dngos gzhi lha mo spro ba/ rjes gsal btab pa dang gsum/ dang po lha'i 'du shes/ sngags kyi 'du shes/ chos kyi 'du shes/ zhar byung de gsum gyi dgos pa bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang rig ma bdag med ma'i nga rgyal brten cing rnam pa gsal bar bsgom pa yin la/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni tha mal gyi chags pa skye ba'i yul skyes pa dang bud med du snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ yum gyi mkha' stong pa'i ngang las sa bon a las thal rang rgyud pa'i 'dod chags kyis ma gos pad+ma/ snying rje chen pos sems can la rjes su chags pas na kha dog dmar po/ bsdu dngos bzhi dang tshad med pa bzhis mtshon pas 'dab ma brgyad/ yul rang bzhin gyi skye ba med pa mtshon pas ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa'o/ /de byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags don ni/ oṃ ni mchog ster ba/ pad+ma ni sgra ji bzhin pa/ su kha ni bde ba/ dha ra ni 'dzin pa/ ma hā ra ga ni 'dod chags chen po/ su ga dha ra ni bde ba ster ba/ tsa tur ā nan+da ni dga' ba bzhi/ bha ga ni pad+ma/ bi shwa ni sna tshogs/ hūm̐ gsum ni sku gsum/ kat+yaṃ ni bya ba/ ku ru ni mdzod/ ṣa me ni bdag gi'o/ /yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas stong pa'i ngang las sa bon hūm̐ las mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pas mi phyed pas na rdo rje/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas na kha dog sngon po/ sems pa lnga yi rang bzhin yin pas rtse lnga pa/ yul can gnyis med kyi ye shes mtshon pas na lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'o/

/de byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags don ni/ oṃ ni gong dang 'dra/ badz+ra ni rdo rje/ ma hā de ṣa ni zhe sdang chen po/ tsa tur a nan+da ni dga' ba bzhi/ da ya ke ni ster ba/ kha ka ni mkha' 'gro ma/ mu kha e ka ra swa ni gdong gcig pa/ nā tha ni mgon po/ hūm̐ gsum man sngar dang 'dra'o/ /de'i sbyang gzhi ni tha mal pa'i skye bo pho mo'i mtshan mar snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rdo rje dang pad+ma'i rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gsum pa/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba la brten nas lha mo brgyad byung ste sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa bsgrub par bya snyam du bsam pa yin la/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni tha mal pa'i 'dzag bde la zhen nas 'khrig pa spyod 'dod kyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed chos kyi 'du shes kyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ ji ltar 'du shes gsum bsgom pa/ /tha mal rnam rtog zhi byed de/ /lus dang bha ga bsam pa kun/ /mchog tu gyur pa byas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi lha mo spro ba la/ lha mo'i rgyu spyan 'dren pa/ de thig ler bskyed pa/ de sa bon brgyad du bsgyur ba/ de lha mo brgyad du bsgyur ba/ de mkha' nang nas spro ba dang lnga/ dang po la gang gis spyan 'dren pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rtsa sgo gnyis nas bde ba chen po'i sgra ha ha la sogs pa dang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis so/ /gang spyan 'dren pa na rigs lnga'i ngo bo 'od zer kha dog lngar spyan 'dren pa dang / yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang / rlung bcu'i ming can rigs lnga tsam spyan 'dren pa la sogs pa yod kyang / 'dir phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rigs lnga yab yum bcu'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa'o/

/lam gang nas spyan 'dren na yab yum kyi spyi bo dang / shangs bug g.yas g.yon/ gsang gnas la sogs pa nas spyan 'dren pa yod kyang / 'dir bar srid 'jug tshul dang mthun par yab kyi zhabs nas spyan 'dren pa yod kyang / 'dir bar srid 'jug tshul dang mthun par yab kyi zhabs nas spyan 'dren par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i rigs lnga yab yum rnams yab kyi thugs kar byon/ phyi nang gi yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas rjes chags kyi mes thugs kha'i rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu/ byang sems kyi dwangs ma dngul chu'i mdog lta bu sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ thig le cha brgyad du gyur par bsam/ gsum pa ni/ de rnams gaṃ tsaṃ la sogs pa'i sa bon brgyad du gyur par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ sa bon rnams lha mo brgyad du gyur par bsam/ lnga pa ni/ yum gyi mkha' nang gi lha mo rnams yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byung nas phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du 'khod par bsam/ sbyong byed de rnams kyi sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i spun zla dang ming sring du snang ba'i bag chags khu khrag 'dres pa mngal gyi gnas skabs ches cher 'phel ba dang / de las lus grub pa/ de phyir btsas pa la sogs pa rim bzhin sbyong ba yin no/ /gsum pa rjes de dag gsal gdab pa la/ don dngos/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul/ de la spros pa bcad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du gdan gyi snying khar lha mo rnams rim bzhin gsal 'debs pa yin te/ de yang shar du lha mo gau rī ste/ rang bzhin dag cing spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa mtshon pas dkar mo/ chos kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa mtshon pas sku mdog nag mo/ rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa bcad nas sems can gyi nyon mongs pa gcod pa mtshon pas g.yas gri gug

sems can rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las 'don pa mtshon pas g.yon nya ro hi ta ces pa dmar mo khrab can 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor tsau rī ste ser sna 'jur gegs kyis nor 'joms shing brku bas na chom rkun ma/ sems can la rjes su chags pas na sku mdog dmar mo/ sems can rnams gti mug gnyid las slong ba mtshon pas g.yas cang te'u 'dzin pa/ gti mug dang ldan pa'i sems can mtshon pas g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu lha mo bai tā li ste gzung 'dzin gyi srog song ba'i rjes su rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su longs pas ro langs ma/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pas sku mdog ser mo/ 'dod chags kyis gdungs pa'i sems can mtshon pas g.yas rus sbal 'dzin pa/ de zhi ba'i thabs g.yon du bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du lha mo ghasma rī ni gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa za bar phod pas na za phod ma/ 'phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas sku mdog ljang khu/ zhe sdang gis gzir ba'i sems can mtshon pas g.yas sbrul/ de zhi bar byed pa'i mtshon byed thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byang shar du lha mo puk+ka sī ni rnam par rtog pa'i ye shes kyi thugs rgyud gang bas lha mo sbos mo/ chos dbyings las mi 'gyur bas na lha mo sku mdog sngon po/ nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sems can mtshon pas na g.yas seng ge de gcod par byed pa'i g.yon dgra satwa kha bo che 'dzin pa'o/ /shar lhor lha mo sha ba rī ste gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas ring du dben pas na ri khrod ma dag pa gnyis ldan gyis sku mdog dkar mo bdag tu mi 'dzin pa g.yas dge slong / nyon mongs pa'i mdud pa las grol pa'i g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa'o/ /lho nub tu lha mo tsan+ḍa lī ste/ gzung 'dzin gyi srog gcod pas na gtum mo/ sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas na sku mdog sngo bsangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas g.yas 'khor lo/

nyon mongs pa'i thal ba rlog pas g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub byang du ḍoṃ bhi nī gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gis mi reg pas na g.yung mo/ phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa sku mdog sna tshogs pa/ de yang brla gnyis man chad zhabs gnyis ljang khu/ sum mdo dmar po/ lte ba dkar po/ brang ser po/ mgrin pa yan gyi dbu sngon po/ 'di ni nang gi 'byung bzhi rim pa dang mthun no/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ri bo nyi shu 'joms pas g.yas rdo rje/ gdug pa can gyi sems can bsdigs pas g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /lha mo thams cad kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas na zhal gcig pa/ bden pa gnyis thugs su chud pas na phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang brnyes pas spyan gsum pa/ sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pas dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral bas gcer bu/ rigs lnga'i ngo bo rnam par dag pas rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes lnga yongs su rdzogs pas mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan/ ā li kā li lnga bcu dbyings su dag pas na thabs kyi rang bzhin mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni sbyang gzhi/ gzugs/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed kyi phung po/ sa chu me rlung dang brgyad/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed me long lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid/ so sor rtogs pa/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ byams pa/ snying rje/ dga' ba/ btang snyoms tshad med pa dang brgyad kyi ngo bo lha mo brgyad kyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /sku mdog sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni sbyang gzhi zhe sdang ste sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo kha dog nag por bsdus nas nyams su len pa'o/

/de bzhin du sbyang gzhi gti mug nga rgyal/ ser sna/ 'dod chags/ phrag dog rnams sbyong byed me long lta bu'o/ /mnyam pa nyid/ so sor rtogs pa/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rnams kyi ngo bo kha dog dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu rnams bsgom mo/ /phyag mtshan sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni sbyang gzhi zhe sdang ste/ sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo gri gug rdo rje/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dgra satwa la sogs par bsgom/ sbyang gzhi gti mug sbyong byed me long ye shes kyi ngo bo 'khor lo la sogs par sgom/ sbyang gzhi nga rgyal dang ser sna/ sbyong byed mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo rin po che la sogs par sgom/ sbyang gzhi 'dod chags/ sbyong byed so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo pad+ma dang / thod pa/ lcags kyu la sogs pa sgom/ sbyang gzhi phrag dog sbyong byed bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pa'o/ /phyag mtshan gyi srog chags rnams ni sbyang gzhi phung po lnga dang / nyon mongs pa lnga la sogs pa sbyong byed sku lnga ye shes la sogs pa mtshon pas mtshon don ches cher zab pa yin no/ /rnam 'gyur ni mtshon bya 'khor ba/ mtshon byed mya ngan las 'das pa mtshon pas 'khor 'das dbyer med du nyams su len pa yin no/ /gsum pa spros pa bcad pa la/ rtsa rgyud las/ dkar mo dbang po'i phyogs phyung nas/ /shar gyi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du 'god par bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te rtsa rgyud las de ltar gsungs pa'i don ni sgo brgyad po so so'i thod kyi pad 'dab kyi steng du lha mo rnams 'god pa'i don yin te/ de ltar ma yin na phyag mtshan bkod pa'i skabs su lha mo brgyad kyi phyag mtshan pad 'dab kyi steng du 'god par bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/

/lha mo brgyad la gau rī la sogs pa'i mtshan 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na rgyu mtshan yod de/ sngon byung ston pa he ru kas gdul bya drag po dbang phyug 'khor bcas btul ba'i tshe/ rigs bzhi dang yum bzhi lha mo brgyad du sprul nas dbang phyug gi chung ma brgyad btul nas/ gdul bya de rnams kyi ming 'dul byed rnams la btags pa yin/ dper na 'jig rten na ri dwags gsod pa'i rngon pa la ri dwags pa zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /de yang a bhi dha na las/ gdul bya'i ming gi 'dul byed la grags 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gau rī dkar po/ tsau rī ser po/ bait+ta lī dmar po 'byung rigs pa las/ de ltar mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ rgyu mtshan yod de ye shes re re la'ang ye shes lnga lnga tshang bas nang tshan gyi ye shes so so'i kha dog ni rnam par shar ba yin cing / de yang gau rī me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ ye shes de'i nang tshan chos dbyings ye shes kyi kha dog nag por shar ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum thig ler zhu ba la/ rgyu gang zhu ba/ rkyen gang gis zhu ba/ rnam pa ji lta bur zhu ba/ de la nga rgyal bzung ba/ de dag gi dgos pa bshad pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched thams cad do/ /gnyis pa la/ bde ba skyes pa dang / dri za zhugs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dwangs mas sku yi cha shas thams cad yongs su gang bas thugs rgyud la zag med bde chen gyi ye shes skyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar skyes pa'i tshe/ rang bar srid kyi ngo bo nam mkha'i yig 'bru lnga yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs khar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku yi dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i rkyen gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched yig 'bru lnga dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las 'od du zhu ba'o/

/de dag gi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i sems snang pha ma nyal po sngar byas pa/ ma 'ongs pa na byed par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas sbyong / sbyang gzhi rang gis sngar byas pa ma 'ongs pa na byed par 'gyur ba'i bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum sred len dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed kyai rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs thabs shes kyi ngo bo yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par shar ba sbyongs/ sbyang gzhi rang gi bar srid dang pha ma'i khu khrag 'dres pa/ sbyang gzhi yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched dang yig 'bru lnga ro gcig tu 'dres pa 'od du zhu bas sbyong / gsum pa ni/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin thig le zlum po kha dog sngo skya bde ba'i cha yab zhu ba/ stong pa'i cha yum zhu ba dbyings yin te rje btsun rtse mos/ yab zhu ye shes yum zhu dbyings/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam pa thig le'i rnam par gnas pa la nga rgyal bzung nas de byin gyis rlob byed kyi sngags brjod de sngags don ni oṃ mchog ster ba/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ a nu rā ga ṇa ni rjes su chags pa/ badz+ra rdo rje/ swa bhā ba ni rang bzhin/ at+ma ko3 ni bdag nyid/ a haṃ ni nga zhes pa'o/ /de yi sbyang gzhi phung po lnga yi chos nyid du 'dzin pa/ yul drug gi nang nas chos/ dbang po drug gi nang nas yid kyi dbang po/ rnam shes drug gi nang nas yid kyi rnam par shes pa/ rigs drug gi nang nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs/ kha dog drug gi nang nas nag po la sogs pa'i ma dag pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad/ sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo thig ler bsgyur nas lam byed rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/

sbyangs 'bras rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ de ltar gnyis snang gi rtog pa thams cad bsdus nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro la/ 'bras bu'i dus su chos sku thob par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /bzhi pa zhu ba glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bzhengs tshul la/ gang la bskul ba/ gang gis bskul ba/ ji ltar bskul ba/ de ltar bskul ba'i dgos pa/ de las 'bras bu rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bzhengs pa dngos dang lnga/ dang po ni/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rnam pa thig le'i rnam par gnas pa de la'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ de nas lha mo rnams kyis bskul/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / lha mo gang gis bskul ba gsal bar bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mtshams kyi lha mo bskul nas ni/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang 'bras dus su sangs rgyas rnams chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par gzugs sku'i rnam par bzhengs nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni lam dus su tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa la brten nas 'byung ba yin la/ de bzhin du 'dir tshad med bzhi dag pa'i ngo bo mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi yin pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ sna tshogs glu yis mchod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar glus mchod pa'i tshul gyis bskul ba yin te/ de yang ngo bo bde chen gyi ye shes rnam pa glu yi gdangs kyi rnam par shar ba yin la/ glu yis mchod par gyur pa'i tshul ni/ thugs rgyud la bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i grogs su 'gyur bas so/ /glus bskul ba'i tshul ni rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa ltar na puk+ka sīs thugs rje chen po'i tshul gyis dang / sha wa rīs gnad la bor ba'i/ tsan+ḍa lis sngon gyis thugs dam bskul ba'i/

g.yung mos thugs dgongs yongs su mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis bskul ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ man ngag snye ma'i dgongs pa gnas skabs su gdul bya snod rung du gyur pa med na sangs rgyas rnams chos sku de bzhin nyid kho na'i ngang la bzhugs yod pa'i tshe sangs rgyas rnams gzugs sku'i rnam par bzhengs nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang / sgo bstun nas glus bskul bas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du bzhengs par bzhed do/ /de yang don la sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'gro don mdzad pa la bskul dgos pa yin te/ sangs rgyas rnams sems can rnams la dus drug tu ye shes kyi gzigs pa thogs med du 'jug pa'i phyir/ de yang glus ma bskul bas sangs rgyas rnams bzhengs su mi btub pa dang / de la yid chad pa la sogs pa med kyang / 'jig rten na che bar grags pa'i spyod pa la 'jig rten pa rnams mchog tu 'dzin pa dang / de dang sgo bstun nas de ltar tshul bstan pa yin no/ /de dag gi sbyang gzhi mngal gyi gnas skabs su sas brten/ chus sdud/ mes smin/ rlung gis rgyas par byed pa ni/ sbyong byed 'byung gzhi rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis glus bskul nas sbyong ngo / /mngal gyi gnas skabs su mer mer po dang / nur nur po dang / tar tar po dang / gor gor po dang / 'khrang gyur po rnams ni sbyong byed thig le la sa bon du gyur pas sbyong / mngal gyi gnas skabs su lus yongs su rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa ni sa bon las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs pas sbyong ngo / /lnga pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ hūm̐ dang oṃ ni rdo rje che/ /khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhabs rnams sa la rdeb pa dang / /lha dang lha min bsdigs par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar glus bskul bas sngon gyi thugs bskyed pa dang smon lam rjes su dran pa'i tshul gyis thig le cha gnyis su gyur/

de las 'bras bu rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du gyur pa'o/ /lnga pa sku mdog dang zhal phyag gi rnam pa gsal gdab pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug dag gis brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ sku mdog sogs gsal gdab pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu gsal gdab pa/ yum gsal gdab pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ he ni snying rje chen po ste/ /badz+ra shes rab brjod par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bde stong dbyer med dam thabs shes zung 'jug gi bdag nyid nges don gyi kyai rdo rje 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du bzhengs pa ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum thabs kyi mtshon don gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ de yang sku mdog sngon po ni chos kyi dbyings las 'gyur ba med pa/ zhal brgyad ni rnam par thar pa brgyad/ dag pa 'di la rdo rje snying 'grel gyi yig sner/ sngon drag po dbang phyug gi 'khor rnams la sa yi zhal dang / de bzhin du chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / drag po'i zhal rnams yod pas de dag gis nga rgyal bcog pa dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis rnam rtog 'joms par bshad do/ /rtsa zhal sngon po mdun du gzigs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du chags pa'i zhal gsum gsum/ de yang dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag cing / spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral bas g.yas zhal dang po dkar po/ thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas g.yon zhal dmar po/ chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas zhal lhag ma rnams bung ba ltar gnag pa/ thabs gnyis su med pas steng zhal dud kha mgrin pa dang bcas pa mdun du gzigs pa/ khams gsum la gzigs shing dus gsum mkhyen pas zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'i spyan dbus ma'i g.yon gyen du langs pa'o/

/sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong du byas pa ni dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa la dpa' bas mche ba'i myu gu bzhi gtsigs pa'o/ /phyag gi gyes tshul la kha cig steng 'og tu rim bzhin brtsegs par 'dod pa ni/ rtsibs ma'i logs la phyag skyes pa'i skyon yod do/ /kha cig phrag pa dang 'brel ba'i dpung pa gnyis/ de re re la phyag gnyis gnyis yod par 'dod pa ni dus 'khor gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i brda khyad yin pas 'dir 'brel cung zad kyang med do/ /des na rang lugs ni kha che rin chen rdo rjes/ phyag bzhi pa la dpung pa bzhi/ /zhes pa ltar mgrin pa dang 'brel ba'i sog pa bcu drug de dang 'brel ba'i phyag yongs su rdzogs pa bcu drug ste rim pa bzhin du mdun rgyab tu brtsegs nas yod par 'dod/ phyag bcu drug ni stong nyid bcu drug des bzung ba'i thod pa bcu drug gi mtshon don shes rab dang sbyar na stong nyid mi rtog pa'i ye shes te yul dang yul can zung du 'jug pa'o/ /thabs dang sbyar na dmigs med kyi snying rje bcu drug mtshon pas thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams kyis bzung ba'i thod pa'i nang gi srog chags brgyad ni/ rdo rje gur las/ glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ /khong skem mdze dang bi tsi ka /mchin pa mtsher pa'i nad rnams la/ /glang po la sogs rim shes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nad brgyad dag pa mtshon/ sngon byung la sbyar na bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi nad zhi bar byed pa yin pas/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis de ltar du nyams su len dgos/ srog chags rnams kha nang du lta ba ni sems can rnams kyi nad rang nyid la len par mtshon/ thod pa'i nang du chud pa ni/ de ltar bsdus pa de bde chen gyi ye shes su bsgyur ba mtshon/ g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad kyis bzung ba'i thod pa'i nang gi lha brgyad ni/

gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa sgron gsal las/ sku yi dbang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun tu 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kar dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod phrin las yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang phyug gi don brgyad mtshon/ sngon byung la sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dgos pa sgrub pa yin pas rjes 'jug rnams kyang de ltar du nyams su len dgos/ sems can rnams la dbang phyug gi don stsol ba'i phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon skyabs sbyin mdzad pa'o/ /ye shes lnga yongs su rdzogs pas mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan/ ā li kā li lnga bcu'i dbyings su dag pas shes rab kyi rang bzhin mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ phar phyin drug dag pas rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi mtshon pas zhabs bzhi pa/ de'i bzhugs tshul la/ dpyi gnyis la zhabs gnyis gnyis mdun rgyab tu yod pa'i g.yas gnyis brkyang ba'i brla la/ g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo gtad pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa gar gyi nyams dgu gsal gdab pa la/ sku'i nyams/ gsung gi nyams/ thugs kyi nyams dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /ces gsungs pa ltar la/ sgeg pa ni sku la mtshan dpes spras shing lta bas chog mi shes pas gdul bya 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed/ dpa' ba ni bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du sku brjid cing che bas gdul bya zhe sdang can 'dul bar byed/ mi sdug pa ni zhal mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur du mas gti mug 'dul bar byed/ gnyis pa gsung gi nyams ni/ rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /zhes gsungs pas/

rgod pa ni rab tu dges pa chags pa'i bzhad sgras 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed/ drag shul ni rab tu gtul ba'i hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa'i drag shul gyi nga ros zhe sdang can 'dul bar byed/ 'jigs su rung ba ni bdag tu 'dzin pa 'jigs pa'i phyir grags stong skye ba med pa'i sngags kyi nga ros gti mug can 'dul bar byed do/ /gsum pa thugs kyi nyams ni/ snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pas snying rje ni sems can rnams rjes su 'dzin par bzhed pa'i thugs brtse ba chen pos 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed/ rngam pa ni byams pa chen pos thugs khros shing zhe sdang can 'dul bar byed/ zhi ba ni rig stong dbyer med kyi ngang nas log lta dang ldan pa'i gti mug can 'dul bar byed/ gsum pa yum gsal gdab pa ni/ rdo rje ni stong pa/ bdag med ma ni chos dang gang zag gi bdag gis stong pas na bdag med ma ste/ de'i phyag mtshan gsal 'debs pa ni mngon rtogs dkyus bzhin no/ /mtshon don ni gong gi lha mo brgyad kyi bshad pa dang mtshungs so/ /bzhi pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ lha yi sku mdog sbyang gzhi dang / /sbyong byed 'phros pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo sprod pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa yin la/ de yang sbyong byed zhal brgyad kyis sbyang gzhi rnam shes tshogs brgyad sbyongs/ phyag bcu drug gis 'pho ba bcu drug gam/ skye mched bcu gnyis/ skye rga na 'chi dang bcas pa bcu drug sbyong / spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis ni dbang po nyer gnyis gsal stong dang bcas pa sbyong / zhabs bzhis ni skye gnas bzhi sbyong / zhal gyi mche ba zla ba phyed pas bdag tu 'dzin pa sbyong / mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal ni nyer len gyi phung po lnga la brten nas sdug bsngal gyi phreng ba 'khor mar 'byung ba sbyong /

mdor na sbyang gzhi 'khor ba/ sbyong byed mya ngan las 'das pa ste dbyer med du nyams su len pa dang / rnam 'gyur la sogs pa dug gsum sbyong tshul yang gong du bshad pa ltar skabs 'dir yang sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs sgom tshul ni/ rdo rje gur las/ thams cad kyi ni sngags 'di yis/ /snying khar ye shes gnas su 'god/ /ces dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sems kyi rnam par bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du yod pa las/ dang po rgyas pa ni/ rang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon las phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs khar sa bon gyis mtshan pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ 'bring po ni/ sa bon las byung ba'i phyag mtshan ye shes sems dpa'/ de las mtshon pa'i sa bon ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ste 'di gnyis rje btsun chen po'i yum gyi sgrub thabs su gsungs so/ /bsdus pa ni/ rang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs khar rang rang gi sa bon ye shes sems dpa' de'i steng gi thig le ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ste/ de ltar gsum las 'dir phyi ma nyid yin no/ /de'i sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum/ sbyong byed sku gsum gyi ngo bo sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi rnam par bsgyur nas sbyong ngo / /gsum pa snod bcud sbyong ba ni/ rdo rje gur las/ spro ba dang ni bsdus pa las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /zhes dang / slob dpon rtse mos/ de nas lha dgu'i thugs ka nas/ /rang rang sa bon las 'od 'phros/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtso 'khor rnams kyis rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rnam par rlung 'gyus nas phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig sna bug g.yas nas 'phros pa snod bcud la phog pas snod gzhal yas khang dang bcud lha dgur gyur nas rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu 'od zer rnams sna bug g.yon nas zhugs rang rang gi sa bon la thim par bsam/

sbyong byed 'dis sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyong ba yin no/ /bzhi pa mig sogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /zhes pa nas/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i don la/ gang la dgod pa'i gzhi/ gang 'god pa'i grangs/ ji ltar 'god pa'i tshul/ de ltar bkod pa'i dgos pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul dang lnga/ dang po ni/ dam tshig pa lha dgu la 'god/ de yang gtso bo'i rtsa zhal gyi spyan g.yas g.yon la sogs pa dbang po drug gi sgo dang / gnas gsum du 'god par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ skye mched drug gi lha mo dang rdo rje gsum ste dgu bsgom par bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang sbug rnams stong par sbyangs nas/ rang rang gi ming yig thig les brgyan pa las bskyed par bzhed do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de ltar go cha bkod pa yis/ /dgos pa rnam pa gsum yin te/ /tha mal rnam rtog blo bzlog dang / /mngon shes lnga ni 'char ba dang / /bar chad bgegs las bsrung phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa ni/ sbyong byed de rnams kyis sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i skye mched drug dang / gnas gsum du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong ngo / /lnga pa ye shes pa gzhug pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ dam tshig 'khor lo 'bar chen der/ /ye shes 'khor lo myur gzhug bya/ /zhes pa'i don la/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa/ de la mchod bstod bya ba/ dgug gzhug bya ba/ de'i dgos pa/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul dang lnga/ dang po la gang gis spyan 'dren pa/ gang nas spyan 'dren pa/ gang spyan 'dren pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin/ sngags dang / phyag rgya gsum gyis te/ gong du tshogs zhing gi skabs su rgyas par bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren te/ de'i ngos 'dzin yang tshogs zhing gi skabs su bshad zin to/

/gsum pa la gzhan rgyud la grub zin pa'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang / rang rgyud la 'byung 'gyur gyi ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa gnyis las 'dir dang po ltar bzhed de/ de la yang / nam mkha' gang ba'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa dang / rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma ltar bzhed de/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan 'dren pa yin no/ /gnyis pa de la mchod bstod bya ba la/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang / bstod pa bya ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod de gong du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ khyod kyi rnal 'byor ma sogs yan lag bdun ldan gyis bstod/ de 'og nas rgyas par 'chad do/ /gsum pa dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ rdo rje gur las/ lcags kyu nyid kyis dgug bya zhing / /zhags pa nyid kyis gzhug par bya/ /lcags sgrog dag gis zhabs dag cing / /dril bu dkrol bas dbang du bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ ting nge 'dzin/ sngags/ phyag rgya dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i sna las lha mo gau rī nag mo lcags kyu thogs pa 'phros pas lha rnams kyi thugs kar reg pas skad cig gi ye shes pa rnams bsrung 'khor gyi nang du spyan drangs par bsam mo/ /lha mo tsau rī dmar mo zhags pa thogs pa spros pas lha rnams kyi mgrin par reg pas ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa'i smin mtshams su thim par bsam/ lha mo bait+ta lī ser mo lcags sgrogs thogs pa spros pas lha rnams kyi zhabs la reg pas ye shes pa dam tshig dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ lha mo ghasma rī ljang khu dril bu thogs pa spros pas dril bu 'khrol ba'i sgras dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis byang chub ma thob bar du mi 'bral bar gnas par bsam mo/

/gnyis pa sngags ni/ rdo rje gur las gsungs ba'i gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥl sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa phyag rgya ni/ yo ga de nyid 'dus pa dang rdo rje gdan bzhi nas bshad pa gnyis las/ 'dir dang po nyid phyag len la mdzad do/ /bzhi pa dgos pa ni/ dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi dngos po yis/ /lcags ni gser du byed pa ltar/ /ye shes sems dpa' bcug pa yis/ /mi yi lus la sangs rgyas byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni/ sbyong byed de rnams kyis sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa sbyong ba yin no/ /de dag gi ni phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnam par bshad pa bstan zin nas/ nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom tshul la/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag dus nam gyi tshe nyams su len pa/ ji ltar nyams su blangs pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs par thob cing / phyi bskyed rim gyi bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad pa/ bcad don gyi sems 'dzin la nan tan byas nas nang du myong ba cung zad skyes nas zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs par thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas 'bring gang yang rung ba'i mngon rtogs dam tshig pa bskyed cing mig sogs skye mched byin gyis brlabs pa tshar ba'i dus su'o/ /gsum pa la zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ bskyed pa de gsal gdab pa/ gsal btab pa de la sems 'dzin pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa rgyas 'bring gang yang rung ba'i dam tshig pa bskyed pa nas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan no/ /gnyis pa la/ rten gsal gdab pa dang / brten pa gsal gdab pa gnyis/ dang po la yang bsrung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang gnyis kyi dang po ni/

spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas 'khor lo zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan no/ /de yang phyi'i bar chad gdon gsum/ nang gi bar chad gdon gsum/ gsang ba'i bar chad gdon gsum la sogs pa'i ma dag pa'i rtog pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong ba'i phyir dang / sbyang gzhi rang gi tha mal pa'i spyi bo la sogs par zhen cing chags pa'i rtog pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ sbyong byed ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsgom/ rkang pa'i mthil pags pa'i 'og sha rus rtsa rgyus rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed gnas de nyid du rdo rje'i sa gzhi sngon po nas 'bras brdal ba lta bur sgom/ rtsibs ma ring thung rnams kyi rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed rdo rje'i rwa ba pho mo'i rtsibs ma so so'i dbyibs dang mthun par bsgom/ lus kun g.yogs pa'i pags pa rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed rdo rje'i gur dang bla re phyi mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin du gnas pa/ nang ri mor bris pa lta bu me long nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar sgom/ rtsa bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi'i sgor zug pa'i ye shes kyi mda' ltong nang du bstan pa/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pa'i mde'u byas pa phyir bstan pa bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi sgom/ nying lag gi sen mo nyi shu rgyur byas pa las gnas de dag tu sbyong byed sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba la nang ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i rnam par bsgom/ gnyis pa gzhal yas khang gsal gdab pa ni/ rkang mthil rlung zhes pa nas/ rkang rnams ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor re zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ de yang rang gi rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang khro bo gnod mdzes kyi bar na sbyang gzhi rkang pa 'degs 'jog la sogs pa g.yo ba'i las byed pa'i sbyang gzhi rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i rlung /

gnas de nyid du sbyong byed don grub pa'am dam tshig sgrol ma'i ngo bo rnams rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po 'od ma'i gzhu lta bu rlung gi rang bzhin yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ sbyang gzhi sum mdor rang bzhin drod gsher gnas kyi me sbyong byed gnas de nyid du 'od dpag med dang gos dkar mo'i ngo bo/ rnam pa me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ sbyang gzhi lto ba zlum po chu'i dbyibs su gnas pa sbyong byed gnas de nyid du mi bskyod pa'am mā ma kī'i ngo bo/ rnam pa chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po bum pa chus gang bas mtshan pa/ snying khar sbyang gzhi rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sa gru bzhi pa'i rnam par gnas pa sbyong byed gnas de nyid du rnam par snang mdzad dam spyan ma'i ngo bo/ rnam pa sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po lte ba la laṃ dang zur bzhir rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa/ phyi rol du 'byung bzhi'i ri rab yod pa ni sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sgal tshigs re re yang ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i phyir shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa re re sgom/ phyi rol ri rab kyi steng du lcogs yod pa ni thod rus zur bzhi rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i lcogs bzhi'am kha dog gi sgo nas brgyad du bsgom/ sbyang gzhi lag mthil nas lag mthil/ rkang mthil nas rkang mthil/ rkang mthil nas spyi bo'i bar lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi sbyong byed byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo gzhal yas khang gru bzhi'i rnam par sgom/ sbyang gzhi snying kha'i phyogs bzhi pa la sogs pa'i 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'i bu ga bzhi ni gsung gi sgo bzhi/ sbyong byed gzhal yas khang gi sgo ba'i ya them ma them sgo glegs gnyis 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan par bsgom/

sbyang gzhi mig gi cha shas rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed gnas de nyid du grub pa'i rin po che'i rtsig pa lnga yi rnam par sgom/ sbyang gzhi sna'i 'doms so'i sha rus rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed gnas de dag tu rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra tshom gyis spras pa sgom/ sbyang gzhi so sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed gnas de dag tu rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa'i rnam par bsgom/ sbyang gzhi lce dang mchu rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed gnas de dag tu 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i rnam par bsgom/ sbyang gzhi rna ba gnyis kyi sha rus rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed gnas de nyid du gzhal yas khang mdzes par byed pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa 'degs byed kyi ka ba bzhi bzhi ka rgyan dang bcas pa'i rnam par sgom/ sbyang gzhi rkang chen brgyad rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sbyong byed gnas de dag tu ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi gdung 'degs byed kyi ka chen brgyad zhu ring thung dang bcas pa'i rnam par bsgom/ mdor na gang dang gang bsgoms kyang gcig gis gcig ma bsgribs shing go sa ma bkag pa/ phyi mtshan dpe'i cha shas ma bsgribs shing / nang me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar dwangs shing thogs pa med par bsgom/ gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la phung po lnga lha brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun du gsal 'debs tshul dang / yul yul can gyi lha mo bcu gnyis dang khro bo bcu gsal btab ste lus dkyil du bsgom pa'i tshul gnyis yod pa'i dang po la/ gang nas gsal 'debs pa'i go rim dang / ji ltar gsal 'debs pa'i tshul dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhung bshad sras don ma dang / dmar ma dang / rje btsun rin po che'i bskyed rim gyi yig chung rnams las mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa/

dang por bskyed pa lus chags tshul gyi dbang du byas nas lte ba nas gsal 'debs/ sems 'dzin pa'i tshe sems gtso bo gang na gnas pa dang / thugs rdo rje lus dkyil gyi gtso bo yin pa la dgongs nas snying kha nas 'dzin pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ji ltar gsal 'debs tshul dngos ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i zhes pa nas/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de yang tshig rnams ngag tu brjod cing phra ba'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo sprad nas nyams su len pa yin te/ de yang kun gzhi'i steng na tshe thog med kyi phung po lnga'i nang nas tshor ba'i phung po/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i nang nas nga rgyal dang ser sna/ bdud rtsi lnga'i nang nas rak+ta/ 'byung ba bzhi'i nang nas sa/ skye gnas bzhi'i skye ba len tshul gyi rim pa las khrag drod gsal ba ste ma'i phyogs kyi bag chags ji snyed yod pa rnams lte ba'i thad sgal tshigs la nye ba'i dbus su rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi thag brgyangs pa lta bu'i dbus su rtsa yig aṃ gi rnam par gnas pa'i nang du khams dmar cha'i rnam par gnas pa ni/ sbyong byed rigs lnga'i nang nas rin chen 'byung ldan/ yum bzhi'i nang nas spyan ma/ ye shes lnga'i nang nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ mngon byang lnga'i nang nas mngon byang gnyis pa/ tshad med bzhi'i nang nas snying rje/ phar phyin bzhi'i nang nas thabs kyi phar phyin gyi ngo bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gtso 'khor gyi rnam par gsal btab ste sgom pa yin/ de yang rtsa 'khor gyi rtsa yi ge nang gi khams dmar po rin chen 'byung ldan gyi zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ phyi shun gyi rtsa gtso mo ste yum rin chen sgrol ma g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab dang mnyam par sbyor/

phyi skor gyi 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi ni 'khor gyi lha mo ste gtso bo la zhal phyogs pa drug cu rtsa bzhi nor bu'i phreng ba bstar la brgyus pa ltar khor yug tu bskor ba gsal bar sgom pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser lta bu la 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'o/ /bzhugs tshul ni gzhung bshad sras don ma las/ yab rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang dang / yum rnams g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs par bzhed/ lte ba sprul pa zhes pa ni dang po rdo rje'i lus bskyed pa'i sprul gzhi yin pas der gnad du bsnun pas mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad gcod pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor lo gnyis pa gsang gnas bde skyong ni rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng du thog ma med pa nas kyi phung po lnga'i nang 'du shes kyi phung po/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i nang nas phrag dog bdud rtsi lnga'i nang nas sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ khams lnga'i nang nas rlung khams/ skye gnas bzhir skye ba len tshul gyi rim pa pha ma'i khams dkar dmar gyi cha dang bar do'i rnam shes ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ ma dag pa'i bag chags ji snyed yod pa rnams gsang gnas kyi dbus drang po nas rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis wa gshor lta bur yod pa'i dbus su rtsa yig haṃ gi rnam par gnas pa'i nang du khams dang bcas te smin pa ni sbyong byed rigs lnga'i nang nas don yod grub pa/ yum bzhi'i nang nas sgrol ma/ ye shes lnga'i nang nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ mngon byang lnga'i nang nas bzhi pa/ tshad med bzhi'i nang nas btang snyoms/ phar phyin bzhi'i nang nas ye shes kyi phar phyin/ rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las kyi ngo bo don yod grub pa yab yum gyi rnam par gsal btab nas sgom pa yin te/ de yang rtsa 'khor gyi dbus kyi rtsa yig gi nang gi khams rnams yab don yod grub pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/

phyi shun gyi rtsa ni gtso mo ste yum dam tshig sgrol ma g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phyi skor gyi 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis ni 'khor gyi lha mo ste nang du gtso bo la zhal phyogs pa sum cu rtsa gnyis khor yug tu bskor bar bsam mo/ /sku mdog rnams ljang zhing 'od 'phro ba'o/ /bzhugs tshul ni 'dra/ rgyan gyi khyad par ni spyi bo pho brang lnga'i yab rnams la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / yum rnams la rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ bye brag tu lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams la rje ga ya dha ra'i gzigs snang ltar rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bzhed do/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gi rgyu mtshan ni phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin spyi bo nas babs te gang du bde ba la longs spyod pa'am skyong bas na de skad ces brjod do/ /'khor lo gsum pa snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo ni rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng na thog ma med pa nas kyi phung po lnga'i nang nas rnam par shes pa'i phung po/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i nang nas zhe sdang / bdud rtsi lnga'i nang nas dri chu/ khams lnga'i nang nas chu khams/ skye gnas bzhir skye ba len tshul gyi rim pa'i nang nas byang sems shes rab stong pa ste pha yi phyogs kyi bag chags ji snyed yod pa rnams nu ma gnyis kyi bar sgal tshigs nye ba'i gnas su rtsa yig hūm̐ gi rnam par gnas pa'i nang du pha ma gnyis kyi khams dkar dmar sran ma tsa na ga'i tshad tsam du smin pa ni/ sbyong byed rigs lnga'i nang nas mi bskyod pa/ yum lnga las mā ma kī/ ye shes lnga las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ mngon byang lnga las dang po/ tshad med bzhi'i nang nas byams pa/ phar phyin bzhi'i nang nas smon lam gyi phar phyin rnams rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par gsal btab ste sgom/

de yang rtsa 'khor dbus kyi rtsa yig gi khams ni yab mi bskyod pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /phyi shun gyi rtsa ni yum mā ma kī gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad ni 'khor gyi lha mo mā ma kī gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gtso bo la zhal phyogs pa brgyad khor yug tu bskor ba'o/ /sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba nam mkha' ltar gsal zhing dwangs pa 'od zer 'phro ba/ bzhugs tshul dang rgyan ni 'dra/ 'khor lo gsum pa 'di la chos kyi 'khor lo zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ der gnad du bsnun pas chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i gsal stong zung 'jug gi ye shes bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'khor lo bzhi pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo ni/ sems kun gzhi'i steng nas thog ma med pa nas kyi phung po lnga las 'du shes kyi phung po/ nyon mongs pa lnga las 'dod chags/ bdud rtsi lnga las byang chub kyi sems/ khams lnga las me'i khams/ skye gnas bzhir skye ba len tshul gyi rim pa'i nang nas bar do'i rnam par shes pa rnams te ma dag pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa mgrin pa'i tog tog po'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug sbrul gcus pa lta bu'i dbus su rtsa yig aṃ gi rnam par gnas pa'i nang du khams dmar po'i rnam par smin pa/ sbyong byed rigs lnga'i nang nas 'od dpag med/ yum bzhi las gos dkar mo/ ye shes lnga las so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ mngon byang lnga las gsum pa/ tshad med bzhi las dga' ba tshad med/ phar phyin bzhi las stobs kyi phar phyin rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje ngo bo 'od dpag med yab yum gyi ngo bo gsal btab nas sgom pa yin te/ de yang rtsa 'khor gyi dbus kyi rtsa yi ge nang gi khams ni yab 'od dpag med g.yas pad+ma/

g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyi shun gyi rtsa ni yum gos dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyi skor gyi 'dab ma bcu drug ni 'khor gyi lha mo ste gos dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nang du gtso bo la zhal phyogs pa khor yug tu bskor ba'o/ /sku mdog ni pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing nor bu me shel ltar gsal zhing dwangs pa 'od 'phro ba'o/ /bzhugs tshul dang rgyan ni 'dra'o/ /'khor lo bzhi pa 'di la longs spyod kyi 'khor lo zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ro drug la longs spyod pas de skad ces bya'o/ /lnga pa bde chen ni rang gi kun gzhi'i steng na thog ma med pa nas kyi phung po lnga las gzugs phung / nyon mongs pa lnga las gti mug bdud rtsi lnga las dri chen/ khams lnga las nam mkha'i khams/ skye gnas bzhir skye ba len tshul gyi rim pa'am tshogs pa lnga las lus yongs su grub pa ma dag pa'i rtog pa ji snyed yod pa rnams lus kyi thod rus kyi nang rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis gdugs phub pa lta bu'i dbus su rtsa yig haṃ mgo thur bstan gyi nang du khams dkar po'i rnam par smin pa ni/ sbyong byed rigs lnga'i nang nas rnam snang / yum bzhi la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ ye shes lnga las chos dbyings ye shes/ mngon byang lnga las phyi ma/ tshad med bzhi las btang snyoms/ phar phyin bzhi las ye shes kyi phar phyin/ phyag rgya bzhi las dam tshig gi phyag rgya rnams rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i ngo bo rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi rnam par gsal btab nas sgom pa yin te/ de yang rtsa 'khor gyi nang gi rtsa yi ge'i nang gi khams ni yab rnam par snang mdzad zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ phyi shun gyi rtsa ni yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis ni 'khor gyi lha mo rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa nang du gtso bo la zhal phyogs pa sum cu rtsa gnyis khor yug tu bskor bar bsgom/ sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba nor bu chu shel ltar dwangs shing 'od 'phro ba'o/ /bzhugs tshul dang rgyan ni 'dra/ 'khor lo lnga pa 'di la bde chen gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bde ba lam du byas pa na bde chen thams cad 'byung ba'i rtsa spyi bo'i haṃ yig yin pas so/ /pho brang lnga'i rtsa 'dab rnams la lha mo rkyang pa 'god pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ der khams rgyu ba rtsa las bskyed pa dang bcas 'bab pa'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir ro/ /pho brang lnga'i gtso bo'i dbu'i gtsug tor rnams lta bas mi mngon pa dang / ljags srab cing mnyen pas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs pa/ phyag zhabs la 'khor lo'i ri mo la sogs pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar zhing snum pa dang zlum pa/ byin gyi phra ba la sogs pa dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'o/ /de ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul gyi gnas de rnams zhib tu na sbyang gzhi rgyu'i rigs brgya/ sbyong byed lam gyi rigs brgya/ sbyangs pa 'bras bu'i rigs brgya'o/ /dang po ni/ sa sogs 'byung ba lnga po re re yang nyon mongs lnga dang ldan pas nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de re re yang sha chen spyi khyab tu btang ba'i bdud rtsi'i rigs bzhi bzhi dang ldan pas rgyu'i rigs brgya/ gnyis pa la bskyed rim gyi rigs brgya dang / rdzogs rim gyi rigs brgya/ dang po ni/ 'dir lam bskyed rim yin pas de'i dbang du byas na rgyal ba rigs lnga po re re yang mngon byang lnga lnga'am/ ye shes lnga lngas phye ba'i nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de re re yang tshad med dam lha mo bzhi bzhi dang ldan pas rigs brgya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/

'di rtsa thig la rlung du bsnun pa'i sgo nas rdzogs rim du yang 'gro bas/ de'i dbang du byas na thig le cung zad zhig gi steng na yang 'byung ba lnga ka tshang bas de re re yang bdud rtsi bzhir phye na nyi shu/ rten thig le re re yang mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes lnga lnga dang ldan pas rdzogs rim gyi rigs brgya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sprul sku rigs lnga po re re yang ye shes lnga lnga dang ldan pas nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de re re dang yum bzhi'am tshad med bzhi bzhi dang ldan pas sbyangs pa 'bras bu'i rigs brgya ste/ zhib par ni pho brang lnga po re re la rigs brgya brgya ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa yul yul can gyi lha mo bcu gnyis dang khro bo bcu gsal btab te lus dkyil du sgom pa'i tshul ni/ rje btsun rin po ches gsung ngag glegs bam gyi bskyed rim yig chung gi mchan bu las/ zhar la dran par bya ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni skye mched bcu gnyis dang khro bo bcu ste bdun cu rtsa dgur dran par bya'o/ /zhes pa tsam dang / de bzhin du gzhung bshad dmar ma las de'i rjes la yul dang yul can gyi lha drug gnyis bcu gnyis dang / yan lag gi hūm̐ bcu'i khro bo bcu'ang dran par bya'o/ /zhes pa tsam las gang du 'god gsal bar ma gsungs so/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gter mdzod la sogs pa'i gzhung bshad 'ga' zhig tu pha rgyud ltar yul can gyi lha sa'i snying po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' brgyad sgom/ yul gyi lha gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug tu sgom pa dang / ma rgyud ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i tshab tu gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs gzugs rdo rje ma'i tshab tu gau rī la sogs pa sgom par bzhed/ lugs gnyis po gang bsgom kyang don la 'gal ba med par bzhed do/ /'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i gzhung bshad dang lus dkyil mngon rtogs las yul gyi lha gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa sgom par bzhed pas gang bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med mod kyi/

'dir phyag len la dkyus na bzhugs pa ltar lugs phyi ma nyid gtso bor mdzad do/ /khro bo bcu 'god tshul ni bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gter mdzod la sogs pa'i gzhung bshad phal cher las khro bo bcu yab rkyang pa sgom par bzhed/ lha mo kun mkhyen dpal gyis gzhung bshad las khro bo khro mor bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med par bshad/ slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal gyis phyag bzhi'i sgrub thabs dang / 'grel pa gur rgyan las khro bo bcu rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas pa sgom par bzhed pa la sogs pa yod cing / 'dir phyag len la dkyus na bzhugs pa ltar yab kyang sgom par mdzad kyang rang 'od kyi yum dang bcas pa sgom na 'gal ba med cing legs pa yin no/ /gang ltar yang / gzhan yang mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan la/ de la lha de rnams gnas de dag tu bkod pa'i dgos pa thun mong ma yin pa bshad/ phra ba'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo sprod de nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ snying kha nas 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa bzhi ste gsung gi sgo bzhi/ lus kyi bu ga dgu dang 'brel ba'i rtsa rnams te sku'i sgo dgu dang / smin mtshams gnas kyi sgo dang / spyi gtsug gser gyi sgo ste thugs kyi sgo gnyis rnams ni spyi gtsug dbu mar 'jug pa'i sgo yin no/ /gnas de dag tu gnad du bsnun pa la brten nas rlung sems dbu mar zhugs nas bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar 'gyur la/ de la gnad du bsnun pa'i tshul ni snying ga'i sgo bzhi ni rten gzhal yas khang gi sgo glegs bzhir sgom pa dang / sku dang thugs kyi sgo rnams la lha nyi shu rtsa gcig po phal cher sgom pas zab pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi kun gzhi'i steng du thog ma med pa nas kyi ma dag pa'i skye mched bcu gnyis dang /

tshigs chen brgyad la sogs pa'i bag chags ji snyed yod pa rnams lam la sogs pa'i rtsa yig gi rnam par smin pa ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyang gzhi de rnams gnas de dang de dag tu lha nyi shu rtsa gnyis su sgom pa sbyong byed yin te/ zhib tu na mig gnyis kyi sgo nang du yid gzugs la 'jug pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rtsa yig maṃ gyis rnam par gnas pa/ rna ba gnyis su yid sgra la 'jug pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rtsa yig ḍaṃ gi rnam par gnas pa/ sna'i 'joms bar yid dri la 'jug pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rtsa yig paṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa/ lce'i rtsa bar yid ro la 'jug pa'i rten du 'gyur ba'i rtsa yig raṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa/ smin mtshams su pha las thob pa'i khams dkar po khyad par can 'dzin cing yid reg bya la 'jug pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rtsa yig aṃ gi rnam par gnas pa/ snying kha'i steng du yid yul sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rtsa yig naṃ gi rnam par gnas pa'i nang du khams dang bcas pa ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed gnas de dang de dag tu rim bzhin/ gti mug rdo rje ma/ zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ ser sna rdo rje ma/ 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ phrag dog rdo rje ma/ bdag med rnal 'byor ma rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan bzhugs tshul la sogs pa dkyus na bzhugs pa ltar yin zhing / g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa thugs khar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa'o/ /yul can gyi lha mo rnams sku mdog sna tshogs su 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang yid yul sna tshogs su 'jug pa'i rnam rtog gi rigs mi 'dra ba du ma 'phro bas kun rdzob spros bcas kyi cha nas bzhag pa yin no/ /maṃ la sogs pa'i rtsa khams de dag la gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa yul la 'jug par bskul ba rnams ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo drug sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs bzhugs tshul rnams dkyus na bzhugs pa ltar ro/

/yul gyi lha mo rnams sku mdog nag mor byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ yul rang ngos na spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'gyur ba med pa don dam chos nyid kyi cha nas bzhag pa yin no/ /de yang yul can gyi lha mo rnams zhal phyir gzigs/ yul gyi lha mo rnams zhal nang du gzigs pa reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul gyis zhal sbyor du bzhugs par sgom mo/ /khro bcu'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul ni rang gi lag mgo gnyis dang lag ngar gyi sbrel mtshams kyi tshigs nang dang / lce'i dbus drang por dang / gsang gnas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse la nye ba'i nang dang / phrag pa gnyis dang dpung pa gnyis kyi sbrel mtshams kyi tshigs nang dang / pus mo gnyis kyi sla nga'i 'og rkang gnyis dang brla rkang gnyis sbrel mtshams kyi tshigs dang rkang 'og gnyis dang / rkang ngar gnyis kyi sbrel mtshams kyi tshigs nang rnams su rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod pa'i dbus su rtsa yig hūm̐ ring po'i rnam par gnas pa'i nang gi khams dang bcas pa ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed gnas de dang de dag tu khro bo gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan rgyan bzhugs tshul la sogs pa rnams ni dkyus na bzhugs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar bskyed rim gsal btab pa'i lha brgya dang bdun cu rtsa dgu mdangs 'gag med zhal phyag gi rnam par gsal gdab pa sku dbyibs bum dbang gi lam/ de yang byang chub kyi sems rang bzhin du gnas pa rnam pa bde ba shes rab kyi ye shes kyi lam/ de yang rtsa yi ge'i rang bzhin gsal stong du gnas pa gsang dbang gi lam/ de yang gsal stong dang bde ba ma bral ba brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar gnas pa ngo bo zung 'jug ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam mo/ /de thams cad kyang sku bzhi'i lam byed kyi sgrub thabs su 'gro ba yin te/ lus rtsa la gnad du bsnun pas sprul sku lam byed/ rtsa yi ge la gnad du bsnun pas longs sku lam byed/

khams bdud rtsi la gnad du bsnun pas chos sku lam byed/ snying po ye shes rlung la gnad du bsnun pas/ ngo bo 'od kyi sku mngon du byed/ lha de rnams re re'i steng du lam byed kyi sgrub thabs re re yod pa ni ches cher zab pa'o/ /de ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshe yan lag drug pa dang 'brel na rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag tu 'dus/ yan lag bzhi pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe sgrub pa'i yan lag tu 'dus/ de nas dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba skabs dang sbyar nas dbang blangs te rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs so/ /rgyas 'debs tshul ni pho brang lnga'i lha rnams la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pa dang / gtso bo rnams la de ltar byas nas 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis rgyas 'debs pa dang / lha gzhan rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re res rgyas 'debs pa dang / yang lha thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyis rgyas 'debs pa rnams las/ 'dir phyi ma nyid dkyus na bzhugs pa ltar phyag len la mdzad cing / de dang mthun par slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal gyi phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs las kyang / kun gzhi dbang bskur gnas su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zla ba'i mdog /shes rab ma dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin par sgom/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa gsal btab pa de la sems 'dzin tshul ni/ dang por rten la sems 'dzin pa yin te/ de yang gsal 'debs pa'i rim pa dang bstun nas thog mar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ de nas rim bzhin 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan phra mo tshun chad la sems 'dzin/ de yang dang po sgrim/ bar du glod/ tha mar res 'jog tu bya/ de yang gsal na gsal bas 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal bas 'phro bcad/ bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung zhing nyams su len no/

/de nas rten pa lha la sems 'dzin pa yin te/ de yang thog mar snying kha nas sems 'dzin pa yin te/ sems gtso bor snying ga nas gnas shing / thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa de sems rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid yin/ der sems bzung bas tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pas mi bskyod cing bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can myur du skye ba'i rten 'brel yod do/ /thugs ka'i mi bskyod pa 'khor bcas gsal thebs nas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ de nas rim bzhin spyi bo/ lte ba/ gsang gnas rnams su sems 'dzin no/ /sems 'dzin tshul gyi go rim de ltar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dang po 'od gsal las sems skye/ de las ngag gi bdag yid rlung skye/ de las 'byung ba gzhan gsum skye/ de la brten nas lus grub/ de la kha dog rang bzhin bzang ngan la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams skye ba yin no/ /de'i rjes su yul yul can gyi lha mo bcu gnyis khro bo dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin cing / sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed zab mo lus dkyil gyi rten dang brten par bcas par bsgoms pas/ sbyang gzhi 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa sbyong byed mi bskyod pa dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs par gnas 'gyur nas 'khor ba mtha' dag rang grol du 'gyur ba yin no/ /'di yan chad rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag yin la/ de rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rtsa ba dang bde chen gyi ye shes kyi ngo bo yin la/ de bzhin du yan lag 'di'ang mngon rtogs kyi rtsa ba bde chen gyi ye shes kyi rdo rje chags pa lam du byed pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag la/ don dngos nyams su blangs pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul gnyis/
