dang po la/ gang las blangs pa'i yul/ gang gis blangs pa'i rten/ ji ltar blangs pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po la dbang lha spyan 'dren pa/ de la mchod bstod bya ba/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa dang gsum/ dang po la gang gis spyan 'dren pa/ gang nas spyan 'dren pa/ gang gi rnam par spyan 'dren pa/ gang du spyan 'dren pa dang bzhi/ dang po dang gnyis pa ni gong du bshad zin pas rtogs sla'o/ /gsum pa la kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa dang / gdan gsum dngos su tshang ba'i lha'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma yin la/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gtso bo'i smin mtshams kyi thad kyi nam mkhar baiḍūr+ya'i lha snam gru bzhi pa rim pa gnyis kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar rang la kyai rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du rnam par snang mdzad/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang don yod grub pa rnams byang chub mchog la sogs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /de'i shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma kī/ nub byang tu gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma ste/ 'khor lo la sogs pa rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol lha snam dang po'i shar du byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang sa yi snying po/ lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang phyag na rdo rje/ nub tu spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs/ byang du sgrib pa rnam sel dang kun tu bzang po ste/ g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /lha snam de nyid kyi shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma/ shar gyi g.yas su reg bya rdo rje ma/

g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma rnams me long la sogs pa'i rang rtags kyi mtshan ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lha snam phyi ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad steng 'og rnams su khro bo bcu rang 'od kyi rig ma dang bcas pa rnams gong du bsrung 'khor gyi bshad pa dang tshul mtshungs so/ /gnyis pa mchod bstod bya ba la gnyis te/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang / bstod pa bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs te gong du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces sogs te/ zhe sdang gti mug sogs ni sbyang gzhi/ rdo rje ni gnas 'gyur ba ste sbyangs 'bras rigs lnga ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog ni sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa de rnams sbyong byed lam rim pa gnyis kyis sbyangs pa la brten nas/ sbyangs 'bras sku lnga ye shes lnga thob pa las mi 'da' ba'i don no/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub ces pa ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad khyed la brten nas 'byung ngo zhes pa'i don no/ /rdo rje can kun zhes pa ni rigs lnga dang / drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang bcas pa'o/ /bdag dges mdzod ces pa ni bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs zhes pa'i don yin no/ /gsum pa gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /zhes dang / a bhi ṣīñtsa tu maṃ zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes pa'i don yin/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab bo/ /gnyis pa gang gis dbang blang ba'i rten ni/ kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med pa'o/ /gsum pa ji ltar blangs pa'i tshul la/ dbang blang ba'i tshul dngos dang / rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs tshul gnyis/ dang po la dbang bzhi yod pa'i/ dang po bum dbang la/

rdo rje slob ma dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis/ dang po la/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang ni/ sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang / rnam shes kyi phung po/ yid chu'i khams la sogs pa ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad swa bhā was stong nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin du sbyangs pas 'chi ba sbyong / stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma gnyis kyis gang du skye ba'i gnas sbyong / de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pas bar do sbyong / de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ yab mi bskyod pa dang / yum mā ma kī gnyis/ sku mdog phyag mtshan zhabs rnams lus dkyil ji lta ba bzhin bskyed pas rigs drug gang du skye ba blangs pa de sbyong / de'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pas lus rgyas te tshar ba sbyong / de la ye shes bcug pas/ de'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa sbyong / de la dbang bskur bas/ rang gi mnga' rigs la dbang bskur te bdag po byed pa sbyong / dang po stong nyid du sbyangs pas chos sku thob/ phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pas longs sku thob/ sku yongs su rdzogs pas chos sku thob/ de la ye shes pa bcug pas ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob/ de lta bu'i chu dbang thob pas zhe sdang gnas gyur ni chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ gzugs phung gnas gyur te mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du byas shing bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa bsgom/ des rigs gzhan rnams la yang 'gre ste/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan/ gzhan rnams phal cher 'dra/ 'od dpag med kyi skabs su/ sa bon dz+riṃ/ phyag mtshan pad+ma/ dbang rdzas rdo rje/ don grub kyi skabs su sa bon khams/ phyag mtshan ral gri/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ rnam snang gi skabs su/ sa bon bh+rūṃ/ phyag mtshan 'khor lo/ dbang rdzas ni rnam snang gi sbyang gzhi/ gzugs phung rags pas dbang rdzas mi 'byung / gzhan rnams kyis dbang rdzas lha de dang der skye ba sogs slob ma ji lta ba bzhin byed/

dbang rnams bskur ba'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi sogs gsungs/ rig ma rnams kyis kau la i ri ṭi sogs brjod pas tshad med kyi rtogs pa skye/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis phun sum tshogs pa rnams brjod cing bkra shis kyi rdzas kyi char phab pas/ dbang gi rtogs pa spel/ mchod pa'i lha rnams kyis gzugs sdug pa sgra snyan pa sogs kyis mchod pa 'bul bas lus sems la zag med kyi bde ba rgyas par bsgom/ khro bo rnams kyis hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bgegs dang bar chad ring du bskrad/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams dang / mgrin pa dang / snying kha dang / rkang mthil rnams gang nas dri ma bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ mchod pa phul/ rtog pa bskyed pa rnams thams cad gong dang 'dra/ rigs lnga po'i dbang thob pa'i brdar/ dngos po kun gang dang gang du snang ba de thams cad rang gi lhag pa'i lha rigs lnga/ yum lnga/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyang gzhi ni/ phung po lnga/ nyon mongs pa lnga/ 'byung ba lnga'i chos nyid du snang ba'i cha rnams stong nyid du sbyang ba sogs gong bzhin/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums sogs yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ldan pa lag pa g.yas su rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi don du byin/ gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba lan gsum btab/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lag pa g.yas su thugs kyi dam tshig tu byin par mos pa tshigs bcad dang sngags brjod pas/ sems nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su byin gyis brlabs par mos la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sogs brjod pas/ sems de nyid kyang ye shes lnga lngar bsgom/

a las byung ba'i dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum dang ldan pa lag pa g.yon du byin pas ngag grags stong dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs par mos te/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma sogs brjod pas/ ngag gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i rang bzhin chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par mos la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag sogs brjod/ de'i ngang nas swa bhā was phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje sngon po las rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa bcug ste phyag rgya sku yi dam tshig gsal gdab/ gang gi rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dang / dril bu gsung gi dam tshig kyang gsal btab ste/ rdo rje che dang sogs dang / shes rab bcu drug sogs brjod/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung sogs brjod pas phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid rgyas par bya/ gong bzhin bum pa'i dbang bskur ba sogs rgyas par byas te rdo rje 'chang gi rgyas btab/ dbang gi lha las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du rang la bstim/ rab gnas mchod pa rtogs pa bskyed pa sogs bya/ yang gsang dbang gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ bstod pa gsol btab gdong bcings/ mdun gyi bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku yi dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba/ gdan gsum tshang ba de phyi nang gi lha thams cad la byin par mos te/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs brjod pas gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la bzhag

de ltar sogs rtogs pa brjod/ gong bzhin maṇ+ḍal gsol btab sogs bya/ gdong bcing slob dpon gyi phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa snang bar mos te/ dga' ster sogs brjod/ phyag rgyas brten par spro'am zhes mos te/ bshang gci sogs brjod/ spro'o zhes lan btab pa'i mos pa byas te/ yang bshang gci sogs brjod/ rig ma mnyes nas pad+ma'i che ba brjod par bsams te/ e ma nga yi sogs brjod/ sgrub pa po yi dam yab yum du bsam/ mkha' gsang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam chos kyi 'du shes skyed/ yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi sgom/ gdong bkrol te rtogs pa brjod/ bzhi pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab/ gdong bcing / ye shes 'di ni sogs brjod/ dbang gsum pa'i ye shes dang / rang sems dbyer med du bsres te bde chen gyi ngang la bzhag gdong bkrol rtogs pa brjod/ gtso bo'i sogs gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang lus longs spyod dbul te deng nas sogs brjod/ mdun gyi dbang lha rnams 'od du zhu/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi spyi bo nas thim pas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang chu lhag ma yar lud pa dang / rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab bo/ /gnyis pa rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs tshul la/ rtsa rgyud las/ phyag rgya rtags dang mtshan ma dang / /'dis ni rigs ni mtshon par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyas 'debs 'dis rdo rje theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad mtshon nus shing / 'di 'chol na dngos grub nyams pa la sogs pa'i nyes dmigs yod pas 'di ma 'chol ba gal che ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ rigs 'chol sgom pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /dngos grub med cing sgrub pa'ang med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di nyid la lnga ste/ ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgya/ lus la sems kyi rgya/ sems la lus kyi rgya/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgya/

'bras bu la rgyu'i rgya'o/ /de yang sems rnam par dag pa la yid kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs pa ni ngo bo nyid la ngo bo nyid kyi rgya/ gau rī gzugs phung rnam par dag pa dang / puk+ka sī la rnam par dag pa lus kyi ngo bo rnam par snang mdzad la sems rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs pa lus la sems kyi rgya/ tsau rī ni tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag pa dang / sha ba ri chu rnam par dag pa dang / yid rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa la lus rnam par dag pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyas 'debs pa ni sems la lus kyi rgya/ bait+ta lī 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang gdol pa mo me rnam par dag pa/ rgyu 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag med la/ 'bras bu ser sna rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rgyas 'debs pa ni rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgya/ ghasma rī 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag pa dang / g.yung mo rlung rnam par dag pa/ 'bras bu'i phrag dog rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo don yod grub pa la/ rgyu 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag med kyi rgyas 'debs pa ni 'bras bu la rgyu yi rgya'o/ /rigs bdag rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje 'chang dang 'khor lo la sogs pa rang rang gi rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyis rgyas 'debs dgos te/ rdo rje gur las/ spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /de yang rdo rje mdog nag po/ /zhes dang / spyi bor chos kyi 'khor lo mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /de ltar na ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched rnams dag pa'i lhar sgom pa ni kun brtags la gzhan dbang gi rgya/ lha de rnams kyi spyi bo rang rang gi rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs pa ni/ gzhan dbang la gzhan dbang gi rgya/ rigs bdag de rnams kyi spyi bo rang rang gi rigs kyi phyag mtshan gyis rgyas 'debs pa ni gzhan dbang la yongs grub kyi rgya'o/

/rigs bdag de rnams dus kyi 'khor lo sprul sku'i rnam pa can du bshad kyang / 'dir yum dang zhal sbyor gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam pa can du bzhed do/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi rnam par shes pa'i phung po sa yi khams kha dog sngon po mi bskyod pa'i rigs/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa'i bar dang / rang gi mnga' thang gzhis 'byor pa ci tsam yod pa la dbang bsgyur ba sngar byas pa/ ma 'ongs pa na byed par 'gyur ba/ da ltar byed bzhin pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad/ sbyong byed mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo dbang bskur ba'i yan yag tu bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dbang gi gtso bo chu yi dbang yin pa dang / mi bskyod pa yang chu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar dbang bskur zhing thob pa na gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas mi bskyod pa de bzhin du/ mi bskyod pa yang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pas mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa bdud rtsi myong ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag la/ don dngos bshad pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de sngags don la nga rgyal bzung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ na dang ga ha dang po dang / /mtha' yi sha dang dang po'i sha /kyai rdo rje'i dngos grub phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga yang de bzhin bza'/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ bdud rtsi byin gyis rlob pa dang / brlabs pa de myong ba'i tshul dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdud rtsi dngos su bshams pa'am med kyang rung / bsam pa tsam gyi'ang rung ste/ de la a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i rlung du snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed don grub kyi ngo bo rnam pa yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor/

de yi steng du sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i mer snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad/ sbyong byed 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo rnam pa raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten/ sbyong byed a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par bsam/ de yi steng du bdud rtsi lnga bskyed pa ni mngon byang lngas bsdus pa las thod pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes las mngon par byang chub pa/ de yi steng du go ku la sogs pa'i yig 'bru lnga las ba glang la sogs pa sha lnga sgom pa ni/ sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i bcud kyi sems can mtshon/ sems can re re yang bdud rtsi lnga lnga dang ldan pas de rnams re re'i steng du rigs lnga sa bon dang bcas te bsgom pa'i bdud rtsi lnga ni sbyong byed kyi lam mtshon/ de rnams kyi steng du ye shes lnga yi ngo bo rigs lnga'i sa bon bsam pa ni sbyangs 'bras mthar thug pa mtshon/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi mtha' bskor du thabs shes ā li kā li g.yas skor g.yon skor du bsam pa ni thabs shes gnyis kyis bsdus pa mtshon/ de rnams so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkhar bdud rtsi'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lhung la khad pa bsam/ de yi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las mngon par byang chub pa/ de yi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan par sgom pa yang so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes la mngon par byang chub pa/ de yi lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas me rlung sbud pa sogs ni mngon rtogs kyi dkyus bzhin no/ /bdud rtsi sems dpa' spyan 'dren pa rnams la kha cig bdud rtsi rkyang pa'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa/

yig 'bru'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa/ bdud rtsi rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa rnams las/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rnams he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa'i rnam par spyan 'dren par bzhed do/ /de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la mngon par byang chub pa/ de ltar bdud rtsi yongs su rdzogs pa kha dog phun sum tshogs pa bltas pas tshim pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa mnams pas tshim pa/ ro phun sum tshogs pa myang bas tshim pa/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zag med bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed nus par gyur pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la mngon par byang chub pa'o/ /gnyis pa myong ba'i tshul ni bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ sbom dang mtha' ltag rtse sbyar ba/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /ces gsungs pa'i don ro gzugs kyi ngo bo rang gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi lan gsum dkrugs pa'i dbus nas len pa yin no/ /de yang sngon lha dang lha ma yin rnams kyi gser gyi sa gzhi la bsrub brten/ ri rab la bsrub shing klu dga' bo dang nyer dga' bo gnyis kyis bsrub thabs byas te rgya mtsho chen po bsrubs pa'i dwangs ma bdud rtsi byung ba dang mthun no/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de sngags don la nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ sbyang gzhi 'du shes kyi phung po dang / ma'i khams kha dog dmar po/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags la sogs pa thams cad dang / rang gi ma dag pa'i zas la longs spyod pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad/ sbyong byed 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas/

sbyangs 'bras gsung rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /sngags don ni phal cher 'dra la/ a mṛ ta bdud rtsi/ swā da bzang po'o/ /bdud rtsi myong ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bdud rtsi gsung 'byung ba'i gnas mgrin par myong ba dang / 'od dpag med kyang gsung rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag la/ rdo rje gur las/ lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i don la/ mchod pa'i lha mo spro ba/ spros nas dkyil 'khor la mchod pa bya ba/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod de sngags don la nga rgyal bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po dang gnyis pa ni gong du tshogs zhing mchod pa'i skabs su bstan zin la/ de yang sgrub thabs rin chen 'bar ba las/ mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs spros te/ /zla nyi chu sman rdo rje dang / /te'u'i sgra dang 'khyud pa nyid/ /gtso bo nas brtsams rim bzhin mchod/ /ces gsungs pa dang mthun no/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi phung po rlung gi khams kha dog ljang khu don yod grub pa'i rigs nyon mongs pa phrag dog la sogs pa dang / 'jig rten na rang nyid la gnyen bshes sogs kyi bsnyen bkur ba dang mchod pa sogs/ sbyong byed don yod grub pa'i ngo bo mchod pa'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras don yod grub pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur bas so/ /de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas sngags brjod pa yin la/ sngags don ni phal cher 'dra la/ pū tsas mchod pa'o/ /mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mchod pa phrin las kyi cha yin la/ don yod grub pa'ang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ni/

rdo rje gur las/ 'khor lo'i 'dren pa bstod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ bstod pa dngos/ bstod byed kyi lha mo bsdu ba/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod de sngags don la nga rgyal bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rnams yongs su bskor/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas bstod pa yin la/ de yang tshig rkang dang pos longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / kha sbyor dang / bde ba chen po ste/ longs sku'i yan lag gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ de nas tshig rkang gcig gis rang bzhin med pa ste chos sku'i yan lag gcig gis bstod/ de nas tshig rkang gcig gis rgyun mi chad pa snying rje rgyud yongs su gang bas 'gog pa med pa ste sprul sku'i yan lag nyid kyis bstod/ de nas tshig tha mas yi ge bzhi'i don dang ldan pa zung 'jug gi sku'i bstod pa'o/ /gnyis pa bstod byed kyi lha mo bsdu ba ni/ rlung nang du rngub pa dang lhan cig tu rang gi sna bug g.yon nas bsdus te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de sngags don la nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ sbyang gzhi tshor ba'i phung po nam mkha'i khams/ kha dog ser po rin 'byung gi rigs/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna sogs dang 'jig rten dang bstod bkur dang snyan pa brjod pa sogs/ sbyong byed rin 'byung gi ngo bo bstod pa'i yan lag tu bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras rin 'byung gi go 'phangs thob par bsams nas de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas sngags brjod pa yin la/ sngags don phal cher 'dra la/ stu ti rang bzhin bstod pa'o/ /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag tu 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bstod pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan brjod pa yin la/ rin chen 'byung ldan yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/

/de ltar yan lag drug rdzogs pa'i rjes su rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin te/ de yang tha mal gyi zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir nga rgyal la bslabs pa dang / tha mal snang ba dgag pa'i phyir rnam pa gsal ba la bslab pa'o/ /de rnams kyang ye shes tshogs bsag gi don 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du sngar gyi sems bskyed kyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par shar bar sgom pa ni bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim dbyer med de/ zab gsal gnyis med kyi bskyed rim zhes bya ste bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i lam 'khrul med kho na yin no/ /de lta bu'i gnad mi shes pa dag gis nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te gzung 'dzin dang bcas pa'i lha yi nga rgyal 'dun pa drag pos sgom pa ni/ bsgoms pa'i lha de dang rnam pa 'dra ba'i ngan song gsum gyi lus rten thob par bshad pas bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa ni mi dgos ka med kyi gnad chen po yin pas blun po rnams bag yod par byos shig de ltar las dang po pa'i gang zag gi ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mngon byang las bskyed pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi drug gang rung thun bzhir sgom zhing sems 'dzin la 'bad rtsol drag po byas pa la brten nas/ rdo rje gur las/ dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba nyid/ /gsum pa srin bu me khyer 'dra/ /bzhi pa mar me nyer 'bar ba/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ste/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar du ba/ mig rgyu/ srin bu me khyer/ mar me 'bar ba/ nam mkha' sprin med lta bu ste 'od gsal gyi rtags lnga mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag mnyam rjes gang mthong yang rung / de mthong ba'i gang zag gnyis par na 'phos pa yin no/

/de ltar bde ba cung zad skyes pa'i gang zag des ā li kā li spangs pa'i mngon byang lnga la mngon par rtogs pa yan lag bzhi drug gang rung thun bzhi sgom zhing sems can la nan tan byas pa la brten nas sems cher brten zhing rlung sems kyi 'phro 'du'i 'phel ba'i stabs kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis dus su lus la bde ba 'bar/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyis dus su sems la stong shas che/ bskyed rdzogs dngos gzhi'i dus su bde stong zung du chud/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu lha'i rnam pa stong zhing 'gro/ rmi lam mngon shes dang 'dra ba 'byung / de tsam na gang zag gsum par na 'phos pa yin/ de ltar bde stong gi nyams skyes pa'i gang zag des sa bon las skyes pa'i mngon par rtogs pa thun bzhir sgom zhing sems 'dzin la nan tan du byas pa'i stabs kyis lha yi snang ba bas kyang rdzogs rim shas che bar 'char/ skabs su lha'i rnam pa mi gsal/ kyai rdo rje bsgoms kyang 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa'i rnam pa du mar 'gyur zhing / 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas la sogs pa 'khrul snang du ma mthong / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang du ba la sogs pa bzhin za zi ban bun du yal nas 'gro/ de tsam na gang zag bzhi par na 'phos pa yin pas/ de ltar bde stong gi nyams cher skyes pa'i gang zag des skad cig gis bskyed pa'i mngon par rtogs pa thun bzhir bsgom zhing sems 'dzin la 'bad rtsol drag po byas pas/ 'khor ba rigs drug gi grong khyer dang / mya ngan las 'das pa sprul sku'i zhing khams kyang mthong / ting nge 'dzin la mnyam rjes cher med/ lus sems la bde stong brten par zung du chud de/ de tsam na mkha' 'gro ma'i bar chad kyi rtsol bas nam mkha' thams cad mkha' 'gro mas gang nas dngos grub byin gyi long zer ba dang / mtshon cha'i char chen po 'bab pa dang / srin po pho mo dang sha za pho mos bsdigs shing gson por za ba snyam byed pa dang /

phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad du me phung chen po 'bar nas bsregs pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po gting mtha' yas pa'i nang du skyur ba la sogs bsdigs shing bred pa'i snang ba du byung na/ brda bstan pas bzlog gal te brda shes shing mkha' 'gro ma mtshan ldan gyis rang gzugs ston pa byung na de dang snyoms par zhugs pas skad cig de nyid la bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bsgoms pas yud tsam de nyid la dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i snang ba gsal bar 'char nus pa 'byung la/ de yi tshe skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa sogs mi dgos te/ rang gi ngang gis cho ga thams cad mi dmigs par 'gyur zhing / snang ba lha'i 'khor lor shar bas bskyed chog gi sgo nas sgom rgyu med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu skad cig la lus kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur te lus kyi rtsa thams cad lha'i rnam par 'char zhing / de la yang dang yang du brtags shing bsams pas sngon bla mas bstan pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur te dngos grub thob/ ces bya ba'ang bden pa mthong zhes kyang bya ste/ don la zag med pa dang po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ skabs 'dir rdzogs rim 'chad pa la mchog dbang gong ma gsum gyi lam rnam pa gsum las 'dir gsang dbang gi lam ston/ de la yang rlung gtum mo 'phrul 'khor gsum las bar pa gtun mo'i rnal 'byor ston/ de la yang 'khor lo la ma brten pa dang brten pa dang man ngag gi gnad la brten pa dang gsum las/ 'dir bar pa 'khor lo la brten pa ston/ de la yang 'khor lo gcig la brten pa/ gnyis la brten pa/ bzhi la brten pa dang gsum las/ 'dir phyi ma bzhi la brten pa 'chad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sreg cing / /spyan la sogs pa yang sreg ste/ /bsregs pas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag

/ces gsungs pa'i don la/ don dngos nyams su blangs pa dang / sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du btang nas lus skyil krung gis 'dug kyai rdo rje yab yum du gsal gdab/ thog mar srog rtsol drug brgya'am stong la sogs pa gang rung zhig nyams su blangs/ de nas lha yi nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas rtsa gsum gsal gdab pa/ 'khor lo bzhi gsal gdab pa/ las byed pa'i 'khor lo gnyis gsal gdab pa/ 'bar 'dzag la shes pa gtad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar la g.yas su rtsa ro ma kha dog dmar po rak+tas gang ba drang por thal gyi yod pa gcig gsal gdab/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po khu bas gang ba drang por thal gyi yod pa gcig gsal gdab/ rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar skya sbom phra ba thag tsam pa drang por thal gyi yod pa mar me ltar gsal ba shin tu dwangs pa gcig gsal gdab so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'khor lo bzhi las dang po lte ba'i 'khor lo gsal gdab pa ni/ lte ba'i gnas su ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma la phan tshun 'khril ba'i 'khril mtshams de lte ba dang de las gyes pa'i phyogs mtshams rtsa cung zad sbom pa brgya dang / de las phyi rol tu gyes pa'i rtsa nang ma brgya las cung zad phra ba drug cu rtsa bzhi thig ler dmar chas gang ba/ rtsa thams cad kha dog dmar shas che ba thag brgyangs pa lta bu shad shad yod pa drug cu rtsa bzhi po'i rtsa mgo rnams cung zad mtho ba/ rtse mo phar kyog tshur kyog byas pa yi ge'i gzugs su yod pa/ thog ma med pa nas 'gro ba so so'i bag chags bsags pas yi ge mi 'dra ba drug cu rtsa bzhi tsam gyi tshul du yod kyang / rang re da lta nyams su len pa'i tshe yi ge sgom tshul 'di ltar byas pas khyab pa yin te/ de yang lte ba'i phyi'i mdun gyi phyed nas dbu bzung ste ā li phrag gnyis g.yon skor du bkod pas rgyab kyi phyed du sleb bo/

/yang mdun gyi phyed nas dbu bzung ste kā li ha dang k+ṣa spangs pa phrag gcig g.yas skor du bkod/ haṃ yig spyi bor yod pa dang k+ṣa lte 'og na yod pas 'dir mi dgos pa yin zhing / yi ge thams cad kyang mgo cung zad mtho ba kha dog dmar ser gsal gdab bo/ /lte bar aṃ yig dmar po dang nang skor 'dab ma brgyad la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha zhes pa'i yi ge brgyad gsal gdab/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab thams cad dang yi ge rnams kha gyen la yar bstan pa/ lte bar thig le dmar ba'i cha 'du bas kha dog dmar shas che ba gsal gdab bo/ /gnyis pa snying kha'i 'khor lo gsal gdab pa ni/ de yang nu ma gnyis kyi bar snying kha'i dkyil na rtsa dbu ma la ro rkyang gnyis phar 'khril tshur 'khril byas yod pa'i lte ba cung sbom pa'i rnam pa can gyi nang du hūm̐ yig mgo thur bstan pa kha dog dngul chu lta bu dbus sngo ba mtha' skya ba thigs la khad pa gcig gsal gdab/ lte ba las ro rkyang gnyis las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab brgyad shad shad gyes pa/ rtsa'i rtse mo phar kyog tshur kyog byas pa yi ge'i dbyibs su gnas pa ni phyogs bzhir/ bh+rūm̐ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir mam̐ lam̐ pam̐ tam̐ zhes pa rnams g.yon skor gyi dngul chu'i mdog lta bur gnas pa/ rtsa yig thams cad kha dog dkar sngo rtsa mgo yi ge dang bcas pa rnams cung dma' ba kha 'og tu bstan pa gsal gdab bo/ /gsum pa mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gsal gdab pa ni/ de yang ol gong pa'i gong tsam gyi thad ka'i nang tsam na sbrul gcus pa lta bu'i rtsa mang du yod pa las/ de rnams kyi nang nas las byed pa'i rtsa bcu drug lte ba dang bcas par grangs nges/ de la ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma la phar 'khril tshur 'khril byas pa'i lte ba sbom por oṃ mgo gyen bstan/ de las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug rtse mo phar kyog tshur kyog byas pa yi ge'i dbyibs su grub pa/ mdun nas dbu bzung ste g.yas skor du ā li bcu drug

rtsa yig thams cad kha dog dmar po mgo cung mtho ba kha spyi bo la bstan pa gsal gdab bo/ /bzhi pa spyi bo'i 'khor lo ni/ de yang skra mtshams kyi nang thad dbu ma la ro rkyang gnyis phar 'khril tshur 'khril byas pa'i lte ba cung sbom pa'i rnam pa can mdun gyi phyed drang po nas dbu bzung ste g.yon phyogs su phrag gcig g.yas phyogs nas bzung ste kā li ta yan phrag gcig gsal gdab/ lte ba haṃ yig thig les gang ba/ yi ge rnams mgo thur du 'phyang ba/ rtsa yig thams cad kha dog shin tu dkar ba/ mgo bo rnams thur du blta ba gsal btab/ mdor na dbu ma na srog shing gi tshul ltar drang por tal gyi yod pa/ ro ma dang rkyang ma gnyis kyang tal gyi yod pa la spyi bo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying kha dang / lte ba rnams su dbu ma la phar 'khril tshur 'khril byas pa las rtsa 'dab so sor gyes pa yin no/ /snying kha dang lte ba gnyis thabs shes rab yin zhing gcig la gcig gisakha bstan pa yin la/ mgrin pa dang spyi bo gnyis kyang thabs shes gcig la gcig kha bstan pa yin no/ /sgom pa'i tshe rtsa gsum sngon la tal gyis yod pa gsal gdab/ de la dbus kyi oṃ hūm̐ oṃ ham̐ ste yi ge bzhi po re re nas gsal gdab/ de nas lte ba'i 'khor lo nas bzung ste rtsa re dang / rtsa yi dbyibs yi ger gnas pa re re nas gsal btab bo/ /ji srid lag pa'i ri mo ltar du gsal bar ma gyur gyi bar du gsal btab cing bsgoms par bya'o/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo dang bcas pa 'di rtsa la grub pas na lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor zhes brjod/ rtsa rnams yi ge'i dbyibs su grub pas yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes brjod pa yin no/ /gsum pa las byed pa'i 'khor lo gnyis gsal gdab pa ni/ bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / sum mdor me yi dkyil 'khor gnyis yod par snyam du bsam pas chog pa yin no/ /bzhi pa 'bar 'dzag la shes pa gtad pa ni/

de nas 'og sgo cung zad bsdams la sna gnyis nas rlung dal bus drangs pas me ma dang gnyid ma gnyis nas song ste lte bar sib kyis song bar bsam/ de nas 'og sgo dam du btang la 'og rlung bsdams pas 'og rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me dmar nag 'bar/ me yi rtse mo lte ba'i yi ge rnams la phog pas/ yi ge rnams me stag phra mo mang po byung ste thams cad gcig tu 'dus nas g.yas ro ma'i lam nas song / snying ga'i rtsa 'dab la bskor ba lan gsum byas/ de dag gi rtsa nang na yod pa'i bad kan dang ljan ljin thams cad bsregs pa'am sbyangs nas med par byas/ rtsa lam thams cad bde sangs kyi gyur par sgom/ de nas yang me de ro ma'i lam nas song mgrin par sleb/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi rtsa 'dab nang nas zhugs bskor ba lan gsum byas/ rtsa nang gi bad kan dang ljan ljin thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs nas rtsa lam thams cad bde sangs kyis gyur par sgom/ de nas yang me de ro ma'i lam nas sangs spyi bor sleb spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi nang nas zhugs bskor ba lan gsum byas/ rtsa nang gi bad kan ljan ljin thams cad bsregs sbyangs nas ro ma'i lam nas song ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig la me'i rtse mo reg pa gcig phog pas/ haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun phra mo gcig g.yon rkyang ma'i nang na tshur na ra ra byung ste spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab thams cad gang bar bsam/ yang na spyi bo yi ge thams cad gsos btab/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun rkyang ma'i nang na mar na ra ra byung ste mgrin pa'i rtsa yi ge thams cad gsos btab/ yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun g.yon rkyang ma'i nang na mar na ra ra byung ste snying kha'i rtsa 'dab rnams gsos btab/ yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun rkyang ma'i nang na mar na ra ra byung ste lte ba'i rtsa 'dab dang yi ge thams cad gang zhing gsos btab/ de nas thigs pa phra mo gcig lte ba'i aṃ la phog pas/ aṃ las me shin tu cha phra ba dwangs pa gcig dbu ma nas mar song /

snying kha'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ gyi ljan ljin dang ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i gegs byed pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs nas spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun ba thag tsam byung ste mgrin pa'i oṃ gsos btab/ oṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun na ra ra byung nas snying kha'i hūm̐ gsos btab/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun phra mo gcig byung ste lte ba'i aṃ la tig tig thigs par bsam zhing thig pas oṃ la'ang me phra mo shin tu gsal zhing dwangs pa gcig 'bar nas hūm̐ la reg par bsam/ de la 'bar ba dang 'dzag pa dkar dmar gyi rnam pa skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la shes pa gtad nas rlung bum pa can ji tsam thub thub kyi bar du bzung / mi thub par gyur pa dang dal bus phyi rol du btang / de lta bu thun re la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa bya/ de ltar gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i dus nad gdon mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs par bsam/ bdud rtsi babs pa'i dus su byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gyis lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad gang bas lus la bde ba dang sems la ye shes skyes par bsam la/ de rgyun ring du goms pa la brten nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar 'gyur ro/ /des kyang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang snang ba thams cad la rgyas btab ste bsgoms pas/ mthar snang ba thams cad bde chen gyi ye shes 'ba' zhig tu 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa/ bcud kyis sems can 'chi ba/ gsal stong gnyis kyi stong pa'i cha/ lus rtsa yi ge khams bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad/ sbyong byed rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pa/ sbyangs 'bras chos sku thob par 'gyur te/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/

/mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dag pa dran pa/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang dgu/ dang po ni/ spyir ngo bo nyid la dag par bzhag pa dang / rtags sam mtshon byed la dag par bzhag pa dang / dri ma gcig tsam dag pa la dag par bzhag pa dang gsum las/ 'dir rtags sam mtshon byed la dag par bzhag pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ de la'ang rgyas pa dang / 'bring po dang / bsdus pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi dag pa dran pa ni/ slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs yan lag bzhi pa nasa'abyung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha yi dag pa tsam rgyas par dran par byed pa ni/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i yan lag drug pa chung ba nas 'byung ba bzhin yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhung 'di nas 'byung ba ltar lha yi dag pa tsam mdor bsdus nas bstan pa yin te/ de yang snying rje chen pos sems can la rjes su chags na spyan rtsa dmar ba/ byams pa chen pos thugs mi 'gyur bas na sku dang yan lag gnag pa/ sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod pa dang / don mthun pa dang / bsdu dngos bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pas na zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal brgyad ni rnam par thar pa brgyad mtshon te/ de la yang 'jig rten pa'i/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i rnam par thar pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ khyad par sdug pa'i gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/

ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi rnam thar/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sgron gsal las/ sku yi dbang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun tu 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod bskyed dang yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /phyag bcu drug ni stong nyid bcu drug mtshon pa yin la/ de yang nang stong pa nyid/ phyi stong pa nyid/ phyi nang stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid/ chen po stong pa nyid/ don dam stong pa nyid/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid/ dor ba med pa stong pa nyid/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid/ mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid/ dngos po med pa stong pa nyid de bcu drug go /gug skyed kyi don ni man+d+ra la rkyen u byin pas mu dra ste phyag rgyar 'gyur la/ de nas sangs rgyas lnga rnam par dag pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas shes par bya'o/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo ni/ /gdul byar gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir snying rje chen po'i khro bo'i skur ston pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ gdug cing gtum pa'i sems can la/ /zhi bar nye bar mi sbyor te/ /'di mkhyen rdo rje can gyi ni/ /rang nyid kyai rdo rjer gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de nyid gsum gyi rdo rje gsum dag pa'i spyan gsum ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje gsum ni dag pa'i spyan/

/zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i dag pa'i gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kyis ni sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyong ba yin no/ /gzhan yang rang gi sems la ma dag pa'i sha'i rnam par snang ba'i sha rnam par dag pa byams pa tshad med pa'i ngo bo lha mo puk+ka sī yin la/ de bzhin du 'og ma gsum gyi sbyor tshul yang rim pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /rang gi pags pa rim pa bdun gyis byang chub kyi yan lag bdun rnam par dag pa yin te/ de yang dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag brtson 'grus dang / dga' ba dang / shin tu sbyong ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / btang snyoms yang dag pa byang chub kyi yan lag mgo rus/ tshigs rus/ rtsib rus/ rkang rus te rus pa'i rigs bzhi ni sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam byed kyi bden pa ste/ bden pa bzhi rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar sbyong byed byang phyogs so bdun des sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyong ba yin te/ sbyang gzhi rang gi ma dag pa'i khams bzhi la sogs bzhi tshan gyi chos rnams sbyong byed rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi la sogs pas sbyong ngo / /sbyang gzhi re re la'ang 'byung ba lnga lnga dang ldan pa ni/ dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga la sogs pa rnams kyis sbyong ngo / /rkang rus brgyad la sogs pa ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad la sogs pa sbyang ngo / /de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /dag bya dang dag byed dam sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed de rnams 'khor 'das dbyer med du bsres nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la/ bzlas pa'i yul/ bzlas pa'i bsam gtan/ bzlas bya'i sngags dngos dang gsum/ dang po la/ phreng ba'i rgyu/ phreng ba'i grangs/ phreng thag mdud 'dzin/ brgyu ba'i tshul/ byin gyis brlabs pa/

bgrang ba'i tshul dang bdun/ dang po ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ shel dang nya phyis mu tig dang / /khams ni dkar po la sogs pa/ /zhi ba'i las la khyad par du/ /phreng ba yi ni mtshan nyid do/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma dang / /pad+ma'i sa bon khyad par du/ /rgyas pa la ni phreng ba nyid/ /rnam par mkhas pas bgrang bar bya/ /gur gum la sogs dri sogs kyi/ /dri ni thams cad khyad par du/ /bsgrub cing ril bu byas nas su/ /dbang la yongs su rab tu grags/ /ru rak+ṣa dang lung thang dang / /de bzhin skyes pa'i rus pa nyid/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /mngon spyod la ni rab tu grags/ /zhes gsungs/ las gang bsgrubs kyang thun mong gi phreng ba ni de nyid las/ zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las/ /bho dhi tses ni las kun grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa grangs ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ sngags kyi sgrub pa lnga bcu ste/ /dbang lha de yi phyed nyid do/ /brgya phrag gcig ni zhi ba la/ /de bzhin rgyas la lhag par brgyad/ /mngon spyod la ni drug cu nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i phreng thag ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gser gyi skud pas brgyu bar bya/ /yang na ras bal dag gis so/ /zhes gsungs la/ phyag len ras bal gyis mdzad do/ /las bzhi so so'i phreng thag ni/ sdom 'byung las/ bong bu rnga mong spu dang ni/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'khal mkhan ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ gzhon nu ma yis bkal ba'o/ /de yang gzugs mdzes lus rdzogs shing / /gtsang zhing dran ldan snyan par smra/ /de yis bkal ba'i phreng thag ni/ /grol ba'i dngos grub skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nyag ma'i grangs ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ phyogs rnams tshad ni brgyad rnams su/ /dbus su dgu pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /lha ni dgu pa srad bu la/ /lha dgur byin gyis brlabs par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dbus kyi nyag ma rdo rje 'chang /

phyogs mtshams brgyad du byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad mtshon par bsam/ bzhi pa mdud 'dzin ni/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ mchod rten chos kyi dbang po'i phyir/ /steng du yang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /zhes gsungs pas mdud 'dzin gnyis brtsegs su byed pa yin la/ de yang 'og ma ye shes/ gong ma chos dbyings mtshon pa yin no/ /yang na 'og ma gzugs sku/ gong ma chos sku mtshon pa yin no/ /lnga pa brgyu ba'i tshul ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ ā li kā li sa bon nyid/ /hūm̐ gi srad bu brgyu bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas phreng thag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la phreng ba dgra bcom pas bskor bar bsam zhing hūm̐ glu blangs nas brgyu bar bya'o/ /drug pa phreng ba byin gyis rlobs pa ni/ saṃ bu ṭi las/ lag mthil nyi mar bsam byas na/ /dbyangs yig dang po la sogs pa/ /lag pa'i dbus su rnal 'byor pas/ /sgom zhing bdud rtsi'i yi ge ni/ /'od zer 'phro ba du ma nyid/ /kha dog dkar po bsam nas ni/ /g.yon pa pad+ma 'dzin pa nyid/ /pad+mar rdo rje 'jug pa yis/ /yang dag sbyor ba nyi ma'i lam/ /kun gyi de nyid bsgom bya zhing / /phreng ba byin gyis brlabs par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la/ rang yi dam gyi lha yi nga rgyal dran par byas nas thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bcug ste/ de la dmigs nas a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lag pa g.yon pa pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i ze'u 'bru la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su a yig gi mthar dbyangs yig g.yon skor du bsam/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig gi mthar gsal byed kā li g.yas skor du bsam/ de gnyis kyi bar du bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin suṃ yig dkar po dbus su oṃ dkar po/ aḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po/ zla nyi la sogs pa'i thabs shes kyi ngo bo de rnams snyoms par zhugs shing yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer dkar po grangs med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la ngo bo ā li kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs nas suṃ yig 'bru dang bcas par thim/

zla nyi la sogs pa thabs shes kyi ngo bo de rnams rim bzhin du 'od du zhu suṃ yig la thim/ de 'bru gsum la thim pas oṃ las mdud 'dzin chos sku'i ngo bo/ a las phreng rdog rnams dgra bcom pa'i rang bzhin/ hūm̐ las phreng thag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bo/ bgrangs pa tsam gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad thogs med du 'grub pa'i nus can du gyur ces brjod nas/ oṃ pa te pa te ma hā dz+nyā na sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha we te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ sngags 'di dang po/ phreng ba la rab gnas kyi dus su phreng skor gcig tsam bzla zhing / bzlas pa nam byed dus bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig bar bzla'o/ /de'i rjes su oṃ ru tse ra ma na pra war+dha na ye swāhā/ zhes pa 'di bdun yan chad bzlas na/ phreng ba de la gang bzlas pa'i sngags 'bum 'gyur du 'gro bar gsungs/ bdun pa bgrang ba'i tshul ni/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ g.yon pa rdo rje can gyi ngos/ /zhes dang / saṃ bu ṭa las/ g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag pa yis/ /bskur zhing mkha' 'gro ma de yi/ /zhes gsungs pas/ phreng ba lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/ g.yon snying kha'i thad nang du bsgreng ngo / /de yi dmigs pa ni mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyus 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad thogs med du 'gugs par bsam/ las bzhi so so la ni/ dpal saṃ bu ṭa las/ zhi ba khro bo dgod par bya/ /rgyas pa dbu ma'i de nyid las/ /srin lag la ni dbang du gsungs/ /kun gyi mtha' ni mngon spyod las/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa 'das pa'i bsam gtan ni/ rdo rje gur las/ bsam gtan ldan par sngags bzlas bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ 'khor ba'i bzlas pa/ spros bsdu'i bzlas pa/ bkod pa'i bzlas pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ 'das pa 'khor ba byed pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/

phal cher mngon par rtogs pa dkyus bzhin/ de yang rlung brtan par bya ba'i phyir tshur 'khor dang / khams brtan par bya ba'i phyir phar 'khor du byed pa ni man ngag gi gnad khyad par can yin no/ /'od zer gyi dbyibs dang kha dog ni/ rgyun gyi bzlas pa dang / zhi ba'i bzlas pa la kha dog dkar po mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu'am mda'i shugs kyis 'jug cing 'gro ba'o/ /rgyas pa la kha dog ser po sgro chun lta bu/ dbang la kha dog dmar po lcags sgrog lta bu/ mngon spyod la kha dog nag po srad bu bsgril ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas lus thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas bde chen gyi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes par bsam/ yang 'od zer phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang / slar yang tshur 'dus rang gi snying kha'i sa bon la thim par bsam mo/ /de lta bu 'phro 'du yang yang du byas/ sngags brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar bzla bya'i sngags gang yin pa de mgo gyen la bstan cing mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du 'khod par bsam mo/ /g.yon yang a bha ya ka ras sngags kyi sgra tsam la sems gtad de bzlas pa gsang sngags kyi bzlas pa/ lha'i rnam pa tsam la sems gtad de bzlas pa gzungs sngags kyi bzlas pa/ lta ba'i ngang nas bzlas pa rnal 'byor gyi bzlas pa bcas gsungs la/ bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros las/ rab 'khor ba sogs kyi bzlas/ 'bring lha yi rnam pa tsam sems gtad de bzlas pa/ tha ma sngags kyi sgra tsam la sems gtad de bzlas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bsam gtan dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bzla dgos te/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ gzhan du mi 'gro'i sems kyis ni/ /de lta'i tshul gyi bzlas par bya/ /yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba yis/

/bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa bzlas bya'i sngags la/ bzlas bya'i sngags dngos/ bzlas pa'i go rim/ ji ltar bzla ba'i tshul/ bzlas pa'i grangs/ bzlas pa'i phan yon dang lnga/ dang po la don dam pa'i sngags/ nang ltar bshad pa'i sngags/ phyi don du bshad pa'i sngags dang gsum mo/ /'dir phyi ma'i nang tshan du gtogs pa yin no/ /de la gtso bo'i sngags dang / yum dang 'khor gyi sngags gnyis las/ dang po la rtsa sngags kyi don ni/ oṃ mchog ster ba/ aṣ+ṭa na nā ya ni brgyad pa'i zhal can/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha warta ma ne ni dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne trā ya ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i spyan can/ sho ḍa sha bhu dzā ya ni bcu drug gi phyag can/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mu ta wa pu ṣe ni sku mdog char sprin ltar gnag pa/ ka pā la mā la a ne kan dhā ri ṇe thod pa'i phreng ba du ma 'dzin la/ at+ma ta krū ra tsit+ta ya ni rang gi sems khong nas 'khrugs pa/ a dhen du daṃṣ+ṭi ṇe ni mche ba zla ba phyed pa can/ zhes pa ni sku bskul ba'i sngags so/ /de nas 'phrin las bskul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ dam bca' ba/ mā ra ya gnyis sod sod/ kā ra ya gnyis ni gyis gnyis/ gardza ya gnyis sgrogs gnyis/ tardza ya gnyis rtogs gnyis/ sho ṣa ya gnyis skam gnyis/ gang skam na sap+ta sā ga ran zhes rgya mtsho bdun/ bhan+dha gnyis 'ching gnyis/ gang 'ching na/ nā gā aṣ+ṭa kān klu brgyad/ ghṛh+ṇa gnyis zung gnyis/ gang bzung na sha trun te dgra bo/ ha hā sogs yi ge bcu gnyis ni yum gyi ā li bcu gnyis pho rtags kyi yi ge ha la sbyar bas bzhad pa'i nyams bcu gnyis mtshon/ phaṭa ni nyes pa dag pa/ swāhā ni gzhi tshugs zhes pa'o/ /snying po ni/ oṃ ni gong dang 'dra/ de wa ni bde ba la rol ba'i don gyi na lha/ pi tsu ni 'jam pa/ hūm̐ gsum ni rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa/ phaṭa man gong dang 'dra/ nye snying gi oṃ gong dang 'dra/

badz+ra kirti ni rdo rje gri gug he badz+ra ya ni rdo rje'i bkas/ hūm̐ man gong dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa yum dang 'khor rnams kyi sngags ni/ rtsa rgyud las dbyangs bco lnga rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sa bon du bshad pa dang / phyi ma'i lnga par aṃ yum gyi sa bon dang / gaṃ tsaṃ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon du bshad la/ dang po gnyis par sngags thams cad kyi rkang pa dang por oṃ gyi rnam pa dang / mthar ni swāhā dang hūm̐ phaṭa kyi rnam pa ni nang du gzhug go /zhes mgo bor oṃ dang mjug tu hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā zhes pa sbyor bar gsungs pa la brten nas rje btsun rtse mos 'khor rnams kyi sngags mdzad pa ni rgyud dang shin tu mthun no/ /de la oṃḥ.a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ bdag med ma'i 'o/ /oṃ āḥgaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ gau ri+ā'o/ /oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ tsau rī'o/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ bait+ta lī'o/ /oṃ aḥghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ghasma rī'o/ /oṃ āḥpaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ puk+ka sī'o/ /oṃ āḥshaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ sha wa rī'o/ /oṃ aḥlaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī'o/ /oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ḍom bhi nī'o/ /rgyas par spro na oṃ āḥgaṃ gau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa sa bon gyi rtsa bar ming gzhug par byas la bzla'o/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i go rim ni/ sngags gsum gyis sku gsung thugs bskul bar bshad pa ltar/ thog mar rtsa sngags bzla ste/ de nas sku skul byed du gsungs pa/ sku de ni rags pa yin pas bskul sla ba'i phyir ro/ /gsung phra ba de'i rjes dang / thugs shin tu phra bas bskul dka' bas thams cad kyi rjes su bskul ba yin zhes bla ma dag gsung ngo / /gsum pa ji ltar bzla ba'i tshul ni/ sngags tshig ngag tu mi brjod par yid bzlas/ de nyid rlung kha sbyor dang bstun te yid kyis bzlas pa 'gog bzlas/

mchu dang lce g.yo ba tsam gyis bzlas pa ni shib bu'i bzlas pa/ skad gsang bskyed cing ring thung phyed par bzlas pa ni bram ze rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i bzlas pa ste bzhi las/ 'dir ni skabs thob dang bstun nas phyi ma gnyis ci rigs pa byed do/ /bzhi pa bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ rgyud las/ 'khor lo'i bdag po'i bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni de bzhin khri/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa rin po ches/ gtso bo'i rtsa sngags 'bum phrag brgyad/ snying po la 'bum phrag bcu gsum/ nye snying la 'bum phrag bcu drug 'khor gyi lha rnams la khri phrag brgyad bzla bar gsungs/ rje btsun sku mched kyis gzhung las dgu gsungs pa de yang mtshan ma dang / dus dang / grangs te/ re re la'ang gsum gsum gyi dbye bas dgu ste/ mtshan ma rab yi dam lhas dngos su snang ba thob pa/ 'bring rdo rje dril bu nam mkhar 'jog nus pa/ tha ma nyams sam rmi lam du snang ba thob pa/ dus ni rab lo drug 'bring zla ba drug tha ma zhag bdun/ grangs ni rab gtso bo la bzhi 'bum/ 'khor la bzhi khri yin/ 'bring gtso bo la bzhi khri/ 'khor la bzhi stong / tha ma gtso bo la bzhi stong / 'khor la bzhi brgya rnams su yod pa las mtshan ma'i gsum dang / dus kyi rab 'bring gnyis dang / grangs kyi rab rnams gzhi bsnyen du rung la/ gzhan dus kyi tha ma dang / grangs kyi tha ma gnyis bsnyen pa kha gso sgrub bsnyen tsam du dgongs pa yin la/ de yang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor du bcad nas/ dngos gzhi mi tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rjes su bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas te bya'o/ /lnga pa bzlas pa'i phan yon bshad pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ mkha' 'gro ma dang rang btsun mo/ /mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir/ /sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par mdzod/ /dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa na/ /mngon sum du ni 'ong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin de bzhin gshegs kun gshegs/

/zhes gzungs sngags kyi bzlas pas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas bdag nyid kyis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhar byung sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i smra brjod byed pa/ sbyong byed bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras dag pa'i gsung mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor la/ don dngos bshad pa dang / phan yon dang dgos pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa las/ /sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gtor ma bstan/ /ces gsungs pa'i don la/ dus/ yo byad/ cho ga dngos dang gsum/ dang po la/ rgyun gyi dus dang / khyad par gyi dus gnyis/ dang po ni/ thun mtshams dang 'brel ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ zla ba re'i nang du brgyad gnyis la sogs pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen brgyad do/ /gnyis pa yo byad ni rab skyes pa'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa/ de ma 'byor na gser dngul la sogs pa rin po che'i snod ci rigs pa/ tha ma rdza dang shing la sogs pa'i snod gtsang zhing gas chag med pa'i nang du/ 'bras phye'am nas phye la rdo rje mchu'i gzungs bzlas nas/ nas kyi zan la gtor ma pad+ma'i dbyibs can byas nas zhes gsungs pas/ de yang gtor ma pad+ma'i dbyibs can zlum po rtse mo ha cang mi rno ba'i mthar mtheb skyu pad 'dab kyi tshul du bskor ba'i gtor ma gnyis nas bdun gyi bar ci rigs pa bsham mo/ /de rnams la nang mchod chu chang gi rim pa bzhin sbyangs pa'i mdun du chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga bsham mo/ /gsum pa cho ga dngos bshad pa la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dngos gzhi bdag bskyed dang 'brel ba rgyas pa'am bsdu na rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar skad cig gis bskyed pa nges par sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rdzas kyi ting nge 'dzin/ mgron gyi ting nge 'dzin/ 'bul ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ dang po la/ bsang ba/ sbyang ba/ bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlab pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang ste rang yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba me 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa spros pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas mchod rdzas rnams sbyangs/ gsum pa bskyed pa ni/ me rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa nas rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i bar ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas me rlung gis bdud rtsi bskol ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi bzhu btul byas te bdud rtsi'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa nas ha ho hriḥbar ro/ /gnyis pa mgron gyi ting nge 'dzin la/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba dang / ma 'brel ba gnyis/ dang po la/ lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad du 'bul ba dang / tha dad du 'bul ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad las phyogs skyong brgyad bskyed/ mdun bskyed kyi byang shar gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi nam mkha' la e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad bskyed/ mdun bskyed kyi lho nub kyi dur khrod kyi 'og gi nam mkha' la e las chos 'byung gi nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la a dgu las gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad bskyed/ spyan 'dren gyi skabs su phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan 'dren no/ /rgyas 'debs kyi skabs su sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/

chos skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan no/ /gzhan rnams ni 'og tu 'byung ba'i dbang bzhi'i skabs dang mtshungs so/ /gnyis pa la yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor kho na la 'bul tshul dang / sku gsung thugs rdo rje gtso bo byas pa'i 'byung po nyer bzhi la 'bul tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs ltar ro/ /'bul sngags bha ga wan nas/ sa pa ri wa ra dang / i daṃ man brjod/ bha ga wan sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ de nas dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis mchod cing bstod/ phrin las 'chol ba'i skabs su/ kyai rdo rje 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di zhes la/ /zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkha' e las chos 'byung gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi nang paṃ paṃ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ steng gi 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad/ bar gyi pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ dgu las thugs rdo rje dang phyogs skyong brgyad bskyed/ 'og gi pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu las gsung rdo rje dang klu chen brgyad bskyed do/ /spyan 'dren rgyas gdab rnams gong 'jig rten pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ gtor ma in+d+ra man gyis 'bul/ ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje man gyis bstod cing phrin las bcol lo/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel ba la/ lha dang 'byung po tha dad du 'bul ba dang / lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad du 'bul ba gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa kho nar 'bul ba dang / 'jig rten pa kho na la 'bul ba gnyis/

dang po ni gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ aṃ la sogs pa'i rang rang gi sa bon las kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed/ mchod bstod sogs ni gong gi 'jig rten pa'i skabs dang khyad par med/ gnyis pa yang gong gi 'jig rten pa'i skabs dang khyad par med/ gnyis pa lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad du 'bul ba la/ mgron bskyed pa yin no/ /'gug pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkha'i e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa ste/ rje btsun sku mched kyi gzhung rnams las/ chos 'byung sum brtsegs su gsal bar bshad pa yin/ gnyis pa dgug pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ zhes pa nas/ steng gi lha thams cad ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa byin gyi brlab pa ni/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /zhes sogs kyis skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab cing dgug gzhug bya'o/ /bzhi pa dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa 'bul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ bstod pa bya ba/ 'phrin las bcol ba dang bzhi/ dang po la/ phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin sngags dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gtor mgron gsal gdab pa'i sngags kyi tshe/ lag pa g.yas g.yon pad kor bya/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags la rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du bstan pa'i mthar se gol gdab pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mgron rnams kyi ljags rdo rje 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bas mnyes par bsam mo/ /gsum pa sngags don ni/ oṃ ni sngags kyi 'go 'dren pa/ bha ga wan bcom ldan 'das/ ma hā ni chen po/ ka rū ṇi ka ni snying rje/

he badz+ra ni kyai rdo rje/ sa pa ri wā ra ni 'khor dang bcas pa/ ka ya sku/ wak+ka gsung / tsit+ta thugs so/ /'di yan chad saṃskṛ ta'i skad/ oṃ sngar dang 'dra/ in+d+ra dbang po/ dza ma gshin rje/ dza la chu lha/ dzak+kha gnod sbyin/ bhu ta 'byung po/ bha hin me lha/ bha u rlung lha/ rak+ṣa srin po ste phyogs skyong brgyad/ tsaṇ+ḍa zla ba/ sudz+nya nyi ma/ mā da sa'i lha mo/ bhap+pa tshangs pa ste/ des mtshon nas lha chen brgyad do/ /ta la pa ta la rkang 'og na gnas pa/ aṣ+ṭa brgyad/ sap+pa sbrul te/ des mtshon pa'i klu chen po brgyad do/ /swāhā gong dang mtshungs so/ /i daṃ 'di/ ba liṃ ta gtor ma/ bhu dza zo/ dzi gha snoms/ gang bsnoms na/ phu la me tog dhū pe bdug spos/ maṃ sa sha chen/ piṃ ga nya sha ste de dag go /bsnoms nas 'dod don gsol ba ni/ am+bha sarba kadz+dza pā da 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs/ khaṇ+ḍi khu ni bzod par gsol/ phe ta ga ta ni gnod pa thams cad sel ba 'di yan ni saṃskṛ ta'i skad do/ /oṃ sngar dang 'dra/ a gdod ma nas ma skyes pa mtshon/ ka ro bya ba'am byed pa/ mu khaṃ sgo/ sarba thams cad/ dhar+m+ma ṇa ni chos/ ad+ya nut+pan+nā swa gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sku gsung thugs sam lus ngag yid gsum mtshon/ de ltar na bsgrub po rang nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang / mgron gyi sku gsung thugs de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed pa mtshon/ phaṭa swāhā ni sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba la/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ yid byung gi mchod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bha ga wan sogs sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni gong gi mtshan sngags sam/ yang na lha rang gi sa bon gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags te bdud rtsis mchod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni dkar mo ri dwags sogs bshad zin to/ /gsum pa bstod pa bya ba la/ lha dgu tsam la bstod pa dang / lha thams cad la bstod pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs yan lag bdun ldan gyi sgo nas bstod pa ste gong du rgyas par bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni mgron gyi lha thams cad rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bor mos nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod do/ /bzhi pa phrin las 'chol ba ni/ lha chen brgyad po zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan cing / de dag gi don ni go sla'o/ /gsum pa rjes la/ rdo rje'i glu/ dges pa bskyed pa'i phyir shis pa brjod pa/ smon lam gdab pa/ bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba dang bzhi/ dang po rdo rje'i glu yi don ni/ kol+la i reṣ+ṭha a bo lā ni gnas dang gnas pa rdo rje'i/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko lā ni zhing 'bad pa pad+ma/ gha ṇe kri pi ṭa o badz+dza i ni ni dus der cang te'u dkrol ba'o/ /ka ru ṇai ki a i na ro lā ni snying rje chen pos ca co mi bya'o/ /ta hiṃ ba la khadz+dza i ni sha chen po za bar byed pa'o/ /gha dheṃ ma a ṇe pi dza a i ni 'bad pas btung bar bya'o/ /ha le ka liñdza ra pa ṇi a i ni skal ba dang ldan pa 'ong du gzhug go /dud dhu ra badz+dza a i ni skal med 'ong du mi gzhug tsa u sa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la ni bzhi mnyam dang gla rtsi du ru ka kap+pu ra lā i a i ni ga bur byug ma la in+da ṇa sā li dza ni sha chen po'i tshod ma/ ta hiṃ bha ru kha i a i ni la du za'o/ /phreṃ kha ṇa kha ṭa ka ran+ta ni 'gro dang 'ong ba la/ shud+dha a shud+dha ṇa ma ṇi a i ni dag pa dang ma dag pa mi lta'o/ /ni rāṃ su aṃ ge tsa ḍa wi ni rus pa'i rgyan lus la gdags so/ /ta hiṃ dzi pa ra wa pa ṇi a i ni dus der skyes pa'i ro dbul ba'o/ /ma la a tse kun+dhu ru bā ḍa i ni 'du ba'i tshe snyoms 'jug bya'o/ /ḍin+ḍi ma ta hi na badz+dzi a i ni reg min dus der brtag pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi shis pa brjod pa yin la/

de'i tshig don go sla'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rigs su skye sogs sh+lau ka gnyis gsungs pa'i don la 'phags pa rin po ches sh+lau ka dang po bskyed rim la sbyar/ phyi ma rdzogs rim la sbyor ba mdzad cing / rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos sh+lau ka gnyis char dbang bzhi la sbyar ba'i mdzad pa bshad kyang / 'dir skabs su babs pa bskyed rim la sbyar te bshad na/ rigs su skyes ni bum dbang rdzogs par thob cing / de'i 'jug pa'i tshe me tog dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa la phog pa'o/ /dam tshig ni spyir rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig mtha' dag bye brag bskyed pa'i rim pa thun bzhir nyams su len pa las mi 'da' ba'o/ /smyo med ni ma 'khrul pa ste snang stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu gnas shing / tha mal gyi rnam rtog gis bskyed par mi nus pa'o/ /kyai rdo rje ston ni de'i rgyud kyi man ngag rang nyid kyis thos bsam sgom gsum gyis nyams su blangs shing gzhan la yang ston nus pa'o/ /bla ma la gus pa ni spyir dbang bzhi thob pa'i bla ma la sku bzhi'i ngo bo shes shing / khyad par bum dbang thob pa'i bla ma la sprul sku'i ngo bor dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo rigs thams cad kyi bdag por the tshom med par shes pa'o/ /snying rjer ldan zhes pa ni sngon 'gro'i skabs su sems bskyed pa dang / tshad med bzhi sgom pa dang / dngos gzhi'i skabs su snod bcud sbyong ba/ rjes kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo zhing / mdor na ci byed thams cad sems can gyi don du spyod pa'o/ /skye zhing ni de ltar rnal 'byor pas/ tshe 'di'am 'chi kha bar do gsum du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par ma nus na/ skye ba phyi ma gong du bstan pa'i de rnams spyod pa'i skal ba can du shog ces pa'o/

/des kyang ma nus na skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun la gong du bstan pa'i lam de rnams spyod pa'i skal ba can du shog ces pa'i don no/ /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol ba ni dam tshig rdo rje dril bu phyag mtshan dang ldan pa lha yi de kho na nyid dran pa'i sgo nas 'khrol zhing mi 'bral bar 'chang ba'o/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang zhes pa ni spyir kyai rdo rje rgyud dang 'brel ba'i chos/ bye brag rtsa ba'i rkang pa brgyad la sogs pa'i sngags brjod pa'o/ /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can ni dngos gzhi'i skabs su rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su kun tu rgyu'i rnal 'byor la spyod pa'o/ /skye zhing man gong dang 'dra'o/ /de'i rjes su saṃ bu ṭa las/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces sogs sh+lau ka gcig gsungs pa'i don ni/ sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la 'god par smon pa'o/ /bzhi pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes su/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gshegs su gsol ba ni rdo rje gur las/ phyi nang mchod yon phul nas ni/ /sngags 'di yis ni gshegs su gsol/ /ces gsungs pa'i don dkyus bzhin las/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs phyi yi go cha bgo zhing nga rgyal bzung ba'o/ /gsum pa phan yon dang dgos pa bshad pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'di'i gtor mas 'byung po rnams/ mchod par byed na rnal 'byor pa rnams legs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ zhi ba dang rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnas skabs su nad zhi ba dang / gdon bgegs kyi bar chad las grol zhing tshe dang / bsod nams dang / ye shes la sogs pa gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang / mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i grogs su 'gyur ba'o/

/de ltar gtor ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa bstan nas/ de las mdor bsdus te nyams su len par 'dod pa/ gtor ma mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa sogs gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ gtor mgron bskyed pa ni gtor ma'i steng du e las chos 'byung gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi nang du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re bsam/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i 'khor gyis bskor bar bsam/ de rnams skad cig gis rang rang gi gdan la 'khod par bsam/ gtor sngags man gong dang 'dra'o/ /'di ni grub chen ḍom+bhi ba'i 'di nyid bcu pa'i dgongs pa yin no/ /de las kyang bsdus par 'dod na gtor ma sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mgron bskyed pa gong dang 'dra/ gtor sngags la oṃ bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wa ra'i rjes su a kā ro btags te 'bul/ phyi nang gis mchod nas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang man brjod/ 'di ni rje btsun ga ya dha ra nas brgyud de rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi man ngag gi brgyud pa las byung ngo / /bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bza' dang btung dang blug pa dang / /ces gsungs te/ de la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ dang po ni/ kha zas rnams mngon byang lnga las gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i kha thab khung / lag pa gnyis dgang gzar dgang blugs/ bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar gtum mo'i a thung gsal btab/ de nas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos lte ba'i a thung me 'bar bas/ lus kyi nang thams cad mer 'bar ba'i khrod du lte bar 'byung po nyer bzhi dang rang gi sgos kyi chos skyong rnams dang / snying rjer pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su hūm̐ tsam las kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab/

de nas bza' ba'i tshe kha zas bdud rtsir bsam nas phul bas/ phud kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyis gsol zhing / lhag ma 'og gi 'jig rten pa rnams kyis gsol bas/ de rnams kyi thugs zag med bde chen gyi ye shes kyis mnyes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsam/ gnyis pa 'bring po ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / dmigs pa dang bcas pas kha zas rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lngar ro gcig tu 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs khar kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab la mchod par bsam mo/ /gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis kha zas la reg nas 'bru gsum brjod pas/ skad cig gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la/ rang gi thugs khar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon po de la phul bas/ de gzi brjid ches cher 'bar bar bsam zhing longs spyod cing rol lo/ /de ltar kha zas kyi rnal 'byor gang yang rung ba nyams su blangs pas nang gi gtor mar 'gyur zhing / sbyin sreg du yang 'gyur ba yin no/ /phan yon ni rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams mchod par 'gyur ba dang / rang nyid kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su 'phel zhing / sbyin bdag sogs kyi yon yongs su sbyong bar 'gyur ba dang / bdag nyid la bu lon du mi 'gyur zhing byang chub bsgrub pa'i grogs su 'gyur ba yin no/ /sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i tha mal pa'i kha zas/ bza' ba po/ bza' ba'i tshul rnams sbyong byed kha zas kyi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin/ lnga pa rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ khyim pa'i phyogs kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis gtso cher nyams su len pa yin la/

de yang rang dang phyag rgya gnyis ka kyai rdo rje yab yum du gsal gdab pa ni lha yi 'du shes/ mkha' gsang dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs de la brten nas yi dam gyi lha la mchod pa bya snyam pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes khyad par can mngon du byed snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas thabs shes snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /phan yon ni/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ 'dod chags lta bu bde ba med/ /de bas sangs rgyas rnams la dbul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tha mal gyi 'khrig pa byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba'o/ /drug pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la/ rang bzhin lhan skyes stong pa'i ngang la nyal ba dang / zhu bde lhan skyes bde ba'i ngang du nyal ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar dkyil 'khor ma bsdus na rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ de nas rim bzhin gtso bo yab yum la bsdu/ de yang yum yab la/ de snying kha'i hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu la/ de khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de na da la thim/ de nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang la sems gtad de nyal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ snod bcud thams cad bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ bsrung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang mi bsdu bar bzhag lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim/ de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kyai rdo rje yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes phung khams skye mched thams cad 'od du zhu nas ngo bo bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ rnam pa thig le sngo skya mthe bong tsam la sems gtad de nyal lo/ /phan yon ni/ tha mal pa'i gnyid kyis brdzi bar mi nus shing 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhar byung sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa ni/ sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i tha mal pa'i gnyid/

gnyid log pa po/ log pa'i tshul rnams sbyong byed ma dag pa'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur te nyams su blangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nyal lugs gnyis byung dang rjes su mthun par ldang lugs gnyis 'byung ba las/ dang po ni/ mdang nub mo rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi ngang la nyal na/ tho rangs nam gyi brgyad cha tsam lus pa na ldang ba'i tshe 'od gsal gyi ngang nas chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin zab gsal gnyis med dam snang stong dbyer med kyi kyai rdo rje yab yum nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba bzhin langs par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ngang la nyal na/ ldang ba'i tshe rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo puk+ka sī la sogs mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /ces sogs kyi glus bskul bas rang nyid thig le las hūm̐ dang aṃ gnyis su gyur pa las rje btsun yab yum gyi skur bzhengs par bsam mo/ /de nas srod thun gyi 'phro thun byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir rdo rje'i glu blangs pa dang / bkra shis kyis dges pa bskyed pa dang / smon lam la sogs pa bya'o/ /dgos pa ni tha mal gyi rnam rtog las ldog pa dang / bar chad bgegs las grol ba dang / lhas lha la tshogs bsags pas tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /sbyang gzhi ma dag pa tha mal pas ldang ba/ ldang ba po/ ldang ba'i tshul rnams/ sbyong byed ldang ba'i rnal 'byor 'dir bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /brgyad par khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ tho rangs bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya ba'am dus gzhan du'ang rung ste/ de yi tshe rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ mchod bstod gsol ba gdab pa sogs dbang len pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bya/ de nas dbang lha rigs lngas zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

smin mtshams yan chad sogs gang bas bum pa'i dbang la sogs pa dbang bzhi thob par bsam zhing / ngag tu he ru ka'i yig brgya bzla zhing khrus bya'o/ /dgos pa ni bsam gtan gyi yan lag cha tshang bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nyin zhag gcig gi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa thams cad 'dag pa'o/ /sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i khrus dang / khrus byed pa po/ khrus byed pa'i tshul rnams/ sbyong byed khrus kyi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /dgu pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la/ gang gis byed pa'i rnal 'byor dang / ji ltar bya ba'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ langs te lha yi gzugs su bzhag go /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rim gnyis mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor las langs te snang stong dbyer med kyi kyai rdo rje rang bzhin du shes par byas nas longs spyod pa dang nga rgyal dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lha yi sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ji ltar snang ba'i dngos po thams cad kyai rdo rje'i rang bzhin du shes par byas nas longs spyod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phung khams skye mched kyi dbye ba mtha' yas pa shes par byas nas/ phyi yi yul drug gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo drug dang / nang rnam par shes pa drug gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa drug shes par byas nas/ lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod pa'o/ /de las rgyas par spro na/ dam pa rigs brgya nas grangs nges pa'i bar shes par byas nas/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo sprad de/ nyams su len pa'o/ /phan yon ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ yan lag ji snyed bsgyur ba dang / /tshig rnams rab tu rgyas pa nyid/ /he ru ka dpal gnas bzhugs pas/ /de nyid sngags dang phyag rgya yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor gnyis dang /

mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dgu ste/ mnyam rjes kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig po 'di nyin mtshan khor yug tu/ nyams su len dgos te/ rtsa rgyud las/ chu bo'i rgyun ni rab 'bab dang / /mar me'i rtse mo rab bcings ltar/ /rtag tu de nyid rnal 'byor gyis/ /nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par bzhag /ces gsungs pa'i don gyi gtso bo yin no/ /de dag gis ni dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad mdor bsdus kyi sgo nas brjod pa bstan zin to/ /zhes sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung rab dges rdor chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed rje btsun yab kyi sgrub thabs phyi nang bskyed rim gyi rnam par bshad pa zur bkol khyer bde 'di bzhin dam pa gang gi zhal slob rtsod bral zhig gis mdzad par snang yang / mdzad byang mi gsal bas dbang bskur bshad pa dam bca' ba'i sh+lau ka gcig gsar rtsom dang / mtshan dge legs nor bu'i phreng ba gsang sngags mdzes rgyan du gsol te/ sa skya pa kun blos lung rgyun spel ba 'di'i dge bas sngags 'chang bla ma'i gsung gi nying khu phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
